google/electra-base-discriminator.description: **ELECTRA** is a new method for self-supervised language representation learning. It can be used to pre-train transformer networks using relatively little compute. ELECTRA models are trained to distinguish "real" input tokens vs "fake" input tokens generated by another neural network, similar to the discriminator of a [GAN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1406.2661.pdf). At small scale, ELECTRA achieves strong results even when trained on a single GPU. At large scale, ELECTRA achieves state-of-the-art results on the [SQuAD 2.0](https://rajpurkar.github.io/SQuAD-explorer/) dataset.

facebook/wav2vec2-base.description: The base model pretrained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

nlpaueb/legal-bert-base-uncased.description: LEGAL-BERT is a family of BERT models for the legal domain, intended to assist legal NLP research, computational law, and legal technology applications. To pre-train the different variations of LEGAL-BERT, we collected 12 GB of diverse English legal text from several fields (e.g., legislation, court cases, contracts) scraped from publicly available resources. Sub-domain variants (CONTRACTS-, EURLEX-, ECHR-) and/or general LEGAL-BERT perform better than using BERT out of the box for domain-specific tasks. A light-weight model (33% the size of BERT-BASE) pre-trained from scratch on legal data with competitive performance is also available.

google/fnet-base.description: Pretrained model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) and next sentence prediction (NSP) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.03824) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/f_net). This model is cased: it makes a difference between english and English. The model achieves 0.58 accuracy on MLM objective and 0.80 on NSP objective.

MCG-NJU/videomae-base.description: VideoMAE model pre-trained on Kinetics-400 for 1600 epochs in a self-supervised way. It was introduced in the paper [VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Tong et al. and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VideoMAE).

mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

cointegrated/rubert-tiny2.description: This is an updated version of [cointegrated/rubert-tiny](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny): a small Russian BERT-based encoder with high-quality sentence embeddings. This [post in Russian](https://habr.com/ru/post/669674/) gives more details.

openvla/openvla-7b.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

google/mobilebert-uncased.description: MobileBERT is a thin version of BERT_LARGE, while equipped with bottleneck structures and a carefully designed balance between self-attentions and feed-forward networks.

facebook/vit-mae-base.description: Vision Transformer (ViT) model pre-trained using the MAE method. It was introduced in the paper [Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.06377) by Kaiming He, Xinlei Chen, Saining Xie, Yanghao Li, Piotr Dollár, Ross Girshick and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/facebookresearch/mae).

facebook/flava-full.description: FLAVA model was developed by the researchers at FAIR to understand if a single model can work across different modalities with a unified architecture. The model was pretrained solely using publicly available multimodal datasets containing 70M image-text pairs in total and thus fully reproducible. Unimodal datasets ImageNet and BookCorpus + CCNews were also used to provide unimodal data to the model. The model (i) similar to CLIP can be used for arbitrary image classification tasks in a zero-shot manner (ii) used for image or text retrieval in a zero-shot manner (iii) can also be fine-tuned for natural language understanding (NLU) tasks such as GLUE and vision-and-language reasoning tasks such as VQA v2. The model is able to use the data available as images, text corpus and image-text pairs

sergeyzh/BERTA.description: Модель для расчетов эмбеддингов предложений на русском и английском языках получена методом дистилляции эмбеддингов [ai-forever/FRIDA](https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/FRIDA) (размер эмбеддингов - 1536, слоёв - 24) в [sergeyzh/LaBSE-ru-turbo](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/LaBSE-ru-turbo) (размер эмбеддингов - 768, слоёв - 12). Основной режим использования FRIDA - CLS pooling заменен на mean pooling. Каких-либо других изменений поведения модели не производилось. Дистиляция выполнена в максимально возможном объеме - эмбеддинги русских и английских предложений, работа префиксов.

cointegrated/LaBSE-en-ru.description: This is a truncated version of [sentence-transformers/LaBSE](https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/LaBSE), which is, in turn, a port of [LaBSE](https://tfhub.dev/google/LaBSE/1) by Google.

weiweishi/roc-bert-base-zh.description: RoCBert is a pretrained Chinese language model that is robust under various forms of adversarial attacks proposed by WeChatAI in 2022,

jonfd/electra-small-nordic.description: This model was pretrained on the following corpora: * The [Icelandic Gigaword Corpus](http://igc.arnastofnun.is/) (IGC) * The Icelandic Common Crawl Corpus (IC3) * The [Icelandic Crawled Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jonfd/ICC) (ICC) * The [Multilingual Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/mc4) (mC4) - Icelandic, Norwegian, Swedish and Danish text obtained from .is, .no, .se and .dk domains, respectively

sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-lite.description: Быстрая модель BERT для русского языка с размером ембеддинга 256 и длиной контекста 512. Модель получена методом последовательной дистилляции моделей [sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo) и [BAAI/bge-m3](https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-m3). Выигрывает по скорости у [rubert-tiny-turbo](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo) при аналогичном качестве на CPU в ~x1.4, на GPU в ~x1.2 раза.

facebook/wav2vec2-conformer-rel-pos-larg.description: Wav2Vec2 Conformer with relative position embeddings, pretrained on 960 hours of Librispeech on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

nguyenvulebinh/wav2vec2-base-vi.description: We use wav2vec2 architecture for doing Self-Supervised learning

PulpBio/LUNA.description: LUNA: Efficient and Topology-Agnostic Foundation Model for EEG

csebuetnlp/banglishbert.description: This repository contains the pretrained discriminator checkpoint of the model **BanglishBERT**. This is an [ELECTRA](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=r1xMH1BtvB) discriminator model pretrained with the Replaced Token Detection (RTD) objective on large amounts of Bengali and English corpora. BanglishBERT achieves state-of-the-art **zero-shot cross-lingual transfer** results in many of the NLP tasks in Bengali.

numind/NuNER-v2.0.description: This model provides embeddings for the Entity Recognition task in English. It is an improved version of the model from our [**paper**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15343).

google/multiberts-seed_0-step_2000k.description: MultiBERTs is a collection of checkpoints and a statistical library to support robust research on BERT. We provide 25 BERT-base models trained with similar hyper-parameters as [the original BERT model](https://github.com/google-research/bert) but with different random seeds, which causes variations in the initial weights and order of training instances. The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

numind/NuNER-multilingual-v0.1.description: This model provides the best embedding for the Entity Recognition task and supports 9+ languages.

It was introduced in the paper [Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.06377) by Kaiming He, Xinlei Chen, Saining Xie, Yanghao Li, Piotr Dollár, Ross Girshick and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/facebookresearch/mae).

braindecode/brainbert-pretrained.description: Pretrained weights for [`braindecode.models.BrainBERT`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.BrainBERT.html), a faithful braindecode port of **BrainBERT** (Wang et al., ICLR 2023), a self-supervised foundation model for intracranial (sEEG/iEEG) recordings.

cointegrated/rubert-tiny.description: This is a very small distilled version of the [bert-base-multilingual-cased](https://huggingface.co/bert-base-multilingual-cased) model for Russian and English (45 MB, 12M parameters). There is also an **updated version of this model**, [rubert-tiny2](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny2), with a larger vocabulary and better quality on practically all Russian NLU tasks.

braindecode/STEEGFormer-base.description: ViT-MAE EEG foundation model — braindecode port of **ST-EEGFormer** (base variant).

braindecode/signal-jepa_without-chans.description: Self-supervised pre-trained weights for the Signal-JEPA foundation model from [Guetschel et al. (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11772), packaged for use with [braindecode](https://braindecode.org/). See the full API reference in the docs: [`braindecode.models.SignalJEPA`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.SignalJEPA.html).

sriram1983007/SRA-RiskGate-4B.description: **SRA-RiskGate-4B checks a stablecoin payment before an AI agent sends it, and answers `approve`, `hold` or `reject`** with reason codes. It is a 4B model, fine-tuned from `Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`, that runs on a laptop.

ssmits/Qwen2-7B-Instruct-embed-base.description: Qwen2 is a language model series including decoder language models of different model sizes. For each size, we release the base language model and the aligned chat model. It is based on the Transformer architecture with SwiGLU activation, attention QKV bias, group query attention, etc. Additionally, we have an improved tokenizer adaptive to multiple natural languages and codes.

braindecode/signal-jepa.description: Self-supervised pre-trained weights for the Signal-JEPA foundation model from [Guetschel et al. (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11772), packaged for use with [braindecode](https://braindecode.org/). See the full API reference in the docs: [`braindecode.models.SignalJEPA`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.SignalJEPA.html).

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instru.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

It retains K3's Stable LatentMoE, first dense SiTU-GLU layer, tokenizer, and online Quantile Balancing, while all 13 sequence mixers use ordinary bias-free Q/K/V/O attention with full-head RoPE. It is a research control and is not an official Meta Llama model.

sergeyzh/rubert-mini-frida.description: Модель для расчетов эмбеддингов предложений на русском и английском языках получена методом дистилляции эмбеддингов [ai-forever/FRIDA](https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/FRIDA) (размер эмбеддингов - 1536, слоёв - 24) в [sergeyzh/rubert-mini-sts](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-mini-sts) (размер эмбеддингов - 312, слоёв - 7). Основной режим использования FRIDA - CLS pooling заменен на mean pooling. Каких-либо других изменений поведения модели (модификации или фильтрации эмбеддингов, использования дополнительной модели) не производилось. Дистиляция выполнена в максимально возможном объеме - эмбеддинги русских и английских предложений, работа префиксов.

openvla/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-obje.description: This model was produced by fine-tuning the [OpenVLA 7B model](https://huggingface.co/openvla/openvla-7b) via LoRA (r=32) on the LIBERO-Object dataset from the [LIBERO simulation benchmark](https://libero-project.github.io/main.html). We made a few modifications to the training dataset to improve final performance (see the [OpenVLA paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09246) for details).

hitachi-nlp/citras-fm.description: **CITRAS-FM** (**C**ovariate-**I**nformed **Tra**n**s**former for time series **F**oundation **M**odeling) is a tiny (7M-parameter) time series foundation model for **covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting**. It supports zero-shot forecasting on a single target variable or multiple target variables, with optional support for observed covariates (past-only) and known covariates (available throughout the forecast horizon). It delivers sub-0.1-second CPU inference.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

MCG-NJU/videomae-large.description: VideoMAE model pre-trained on Kinetics-400 for 1600 epochs in a self-supervised way. It was introduced in the paper [VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Tong et al. and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VideoMAE).

openvla/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-10.description: This model was produced by fine-tuning the [OpenVLA 7B model](https://huggingface.co/openvla/openvla-7b) via LoRA (r=32) on the LIBERO-10 (LIBERO-Long) dataset from the [LIBERO simulation benchmark](https://libero-project.github.io/main.html). We made a few modifications to the training dataset to improve final performance (see the [OpenVLA paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09246) for details).

LikC1606/chinese-babylm-cog-a197-strict-.description: `chinese-babylm-cog-a197-strict-best` is a custom BERT-based wrapper model for the NLPCC 2026 Chinese BabyLM shared task, optimized for the **Cognitive Modeling (Cog) Track**. It combines internal strict BERT branches, official-corpus static features, and MLM uncertainty features for brain-aligned fMRI evaluation.

sergeyzh/LaBSE-ru-turbo.description: Модель BERT для расчетов эмбеддингов предложений на русском языке. Модель основана на [cointegrated/LaBSE-en-ru](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/LaBSE-en-ru) - имеет аналогичные размеры контекста (512), ембеддинга (768) и быстродействие.

csebuetnlp/banglabert_large.description: This repository contains the pretrained discriminator checkpoint of the model **BanglaBERT (large)**. This is an [ELECTRA](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=r1xMH1BtvB) discriminator model pretrained with the Replaced Token Detection (RTD) objective. Finetuned models using this checkpoint achieve state-of-the-art results on many of the NLP tasks in bengali.

sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-sts-v2.description: Быстрая модель BERT для задач симметричного перефразирования (STS, поиск парафраз, дедупликация) и логического вывода (NLI). Получена дистилляцией эмбеддингов русских и английских текстов [Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B) в [rubert-tiny-turbo](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo).

nvidia/c-foundationstereo-s.description: [FoundationStereo](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.09898) is a foundation model developed by NVIDIA Research for Stereo Depth Estimation. The model takes as input an RGB stereo-image pair and outputs an accurate disparity map. The model was designed to achieve strong zero-shot generalization and has been shown to generalize to various scenarios with wide zero-shot coverage.

MCG-NJU/videomae-base-ssv2.description: VideoMAE model pre-trained on Something-Something-v2 for 2400 epochs in a self-supervised way. It was introduced in the paper [VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Tong et al. and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VideoMAE).

google/multiberts-seed_0-step_500k.description: MultiBERTs is a collection of checkpoints and a statistical library to support robust research on BERT. We provide 25 BERT-base models trained with similar hyper-parameters as [the original BERT model](https://github.com/google-research/bert) but with different random seeds, which causes variations in the initial weights and order of training instances. The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

LG-AI-Research/EXAONE-Forecast-for-Finan.description: **EXAONE Forecast for Finance** is a time series foundation model (TSFM) built for financial forecasting. It replaces self-attention with two linear-time operators — a causal 1D convolution for temporal mixing and a group-aware pooling MLP for variate mixing — so cost grows linearly in both sequence length and variate count. A masked-context augmentation makes it robust to the missing spans that are pervasive in financial data, and it is pretrained on a synthetic financial corpus whose generator reproduces heavy tails, volatility clustering, jumps, regime shifts, and cross-asset dependence.

wbbbbb/wav2vec2-large-chinese-zh-cn.description: Fine-tuned [facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53) on Chinese using the train and validation splits of [Common Voice 6.1](https://huggingface.co/datasets/common_voice), [CSS10](https://github.com/Kyubyong/css10) and [ST-CMDS](http://www.openslr.org/38/). When using this model, make sure that your speech input is sampled at 16kHz.

nasa-ibm-ai4science/NASA-IBM-Lunar-Found.description: **A multimodal, multi-resolution foundation model for lunar remote sensing.**

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-422M-hg38.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-422M-hg38 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 422M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10kb DNA sequences from the hg38 human genome assembly.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-unfiltered.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

aubmindlab/araelectra-base-discriminator.description: **ELECTRA** is a method for self-supervised language representation learning. It can be used to pre-train transformer networks using relatively little compute. ELECTRA models are trained to distinguish "real" input tokens vs "fake" input tokens generated by another neural network, similar to the discriminator of a [GAN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1406.2661.pdf). AraELECTRA achieves state-of-the-art results on Arabic QA dataset.

adsabs/astroBERT.description: This public repository contains the work of the [NASA/ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/) on building an NLP language model tailored to astrophysics, along with tutorials and miscellaneous related files. This model is **cased** (it treats `ads` and `ADS` differently).

hfl/chinese-electra-180g-small-discrimin.description: Google and Stanford University released a new pre-trained model called ELECTRA, which has a much compact model size and relatively competitive performance compared to BERT and its variants. For further accelerating the research of the Chinese pre-trained model, the Joint Laboratory of HIT and iFLYTEK Research (HFL) has released the Chinese ELECTRA models based on the official code of ELECTRA. ELECTRA-small could reach similar or even higher scores on several NLP tasks with only 1/10 parameters compared to BERT and its variants.

UncleKhris/Fallen1-800M.description: **Architecture:** original decoder-only Transformer, 817,387,008 parameters. 28 layers, width 1536, 16 heads, SwiGLU FFN 4096, RoPE, RMSNorm, tied embeddings, context 256.

Featherless-Chat-Models/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

castorini/gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-cli.description: A 3.3B-parameter decoder-only base language model, pre-trained from scratch with [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) on one pass over ClimbMix (287B tokens). This is the causal model described in the pre-training section of ([PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.11922)). It has had no post-training (no instruction tuning or RLHF), so it continues text rather than following instructions.

harpertoken/word.description: A GPT-2 language model trained from random initialisation on WikiText-2, rather than adapted from OpenAI's released weights. The architecture is GPT-2 small (twelve layers, 768 embedding dimensions, 50257-token vocabulary), which works out at about 124M parameters; the previous version of this card put the figure at 117M, which does not match the 496 MB float32 checkpoint. `config.json` carries no `_name_or_path`, confirming nothing was fine-tuned. One structural difference from stock GPT-2 is worth knowing: `n_positions` is 512 rather than 1024, and the position embedding really is 512 rows, so this model accepts half the context a standard GPT-2 does.

alkiskoudounas/voc2vec.description: voc2vec is a foundation model specifically designed for non-verbal human data.

ai-forever/ruElectra-large.description: The model architecture design, pretraining, and evaluation are documented in our preprint: [**A Family of Pretrained Transformer Language Models for Russian**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.10931).

Snarcy/RadioDino-s16.description: **RadioDINO-s16** is a self-supervised Vision Transformer foundation model developed for radiomics and medical imaging. It is based on the DINO framework and pretrained on the large-scale **RadImageNet** dataset (1.35 million CT, MRI, and Ultrasound images across 165 classes and 11 anatomical regions). This model is part of the *Radio DINO* family and was created to extract robust, general-purpose features for downstream medical tasks including classification, segmentation, and interpretability analysis.

ChengsenWang/ChatTime-1-7B-Chat.description: In this paper, we innovatively model time series as a foreign language and construct ChatTime, a unified framework for time series and text processing. As an out-of-the-box multimodal time series foundation model, ChatTime provides zero-shot forecasting capability and supports bimodal input/output for both time series and text. We design a series of experiments to verify the superior performance of ChatTime across multiple tasks and scenarios, and create four multimodal datasets to address data gaps. The experimental results demonstrate the potential and utility of ChatTime.

CogACT/CogACT-Base.description: CogACT is a new advanced VLA architecture derived from VLM. Unlike previous works that directly repurpose VLM for action prediction by simple action quantization, we propose a componentized VLA architecture that has a specialized action module conditioned on VLM output. CogACT-Base employs a [DiT-Base](https://github.com/facebookresearch/DiT) model as the action module.

root-sys-n/Mima-Pico-15m.description: A 15.54M-parameter decoder-only language model (tied embeddings) trained from scratch in Turkish. It was trained on a single consumer GPU (NVIDIA GeForce MX450, 2 GB VRAM) using a 6-stage curriculum. This repository ships the **finished checkpoint** (step 32,750 — final stage A3-karma / consolidation).

nvidia/foundationpose.description: [FoundationPose](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.08344.pdf) is a unified foundation model for 6-DoF (Degrees of Freedom) object pose estimation and tracking. This approach can be instantly applied at test-time to a novel object without fine-tuning, as long as its CAD model is given. This model is ready for commercial use.

Snarcy/RadioDino-s8.description: **RadioDINO-s8** is a self-supervised Vision Transformer foundation model developed for radiomics and medical imaging. It is based on the DINO framework and pretrained on the large-scale **RadImageNet** dataset (1.35 million CT, MRI, and Ultrasound images across 165 classes and 11 anatomical regions). This model is part of the *Radio DINO* family and was created to extract robust, general-purpose features for downstream medical tasks including classification, segmentation, and interpretability analysis.

kamalkraj/bioelectra-base-discriminator-.description: Recent advancements in pretraining strategies in NLP have shown a significant improvement in the performance of models on various text mining tasks. In this paper, we introduce BioELECTRA, a biomedical domain-specific language encoder model that adapts ELECTRA (Clark et al., 2020) for the Biomedical domain. BioELECTRA outperforms the previous models and achieves state of the art (SOTA) on all the 13 datasets in BLURB benchmark and on all the 4 Clinical datasets from BLUE Benchmark across 7 NLP tasks. BioELECTRA pretrained on PubMed and PMC full text articles performs very well on Clinical datasets as well. BioELECTRA achieves new SOTA 86.34%(1.39% accuracy improvement) on MedNLI and 64% (2.98% accuracy improvement) on PubMedQA dataset.

asciibase64/Llama-3.2-1B-dolma3_mix.description: Final checkpoint of `kd6b-r5-20261020-seed42`: **6,000,082,944 non-padding student input tokens**, **28,619 optimizer updates**. The student uses the Llama 3.2 1B architecture, randomly initialized with seed42 and residual-half scaling. No pretrained student weights or previous training checkpoint were loaded. The frozen teacher is the official pretrained `meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B`, revision `13afe5124825b4f3751f836b40dafda64c1ed062`.

aliwister/ali-llm-v0.1.description: ali-llm is a 2.05B-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on English text written for children, in the order a child would meet it: pre-kindergarten speech and stories first, then kindergarten, then grades 1 to 5 in turn. Reading, arithmetic, elementary science and everyday money skills (counting coins, earning, spending, saving) are all part of the curriculum, and the difficulty of what the model sees only ever goes up during training.

ricardoz/BERTugues-base-portuguese-cased.description: O BERTugues foi pré-treinado seguindo os mesmos passos do [paper original do BERT](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.04805v2), com os objetivos de Masked Language Modeling (MLM) e Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), com 1 milhão de *steps*, usando mais de 20 GB de textos. Para mais detalhes do treinamento, por favor, leia o [paper publicado](https://ojs.uel.br/revistas/uel/index.php/semexatas/article/view/50630). Como o [Bertimbau](https://huggingface.co/neuralmind/bert-base-portuguese-cased), foi pré-treinado com o dataset [BrWAC](https://www.inf.ufrgs.br/pln/wiki/index.php?title=BrWaC) e a Wikipédia em português para o Tokenizador, contando com algumas melhorias no fluxo de treinamento, como: + **Remoção de caracteres pouco comuns no português do treinamento do Tokenizador.** No Bertimbau mais de 7

marin-community/delphi-9e18-1.2Bparams-1.description: A 1.2B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 1.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

wayneworkman2012/peacebell-v1-148M.description: **Peacebell** is a **148M-parameter** GPT-style decoder trained **from scratch** to know the history of World War II: custom architecture, a custom 28,000-token SentencePiece vocabulary, and a 16,384-token context. It is not a fine-tune of any other model and was not distilled from one. The weights started random, and every token it saw in training came from the datasets listed under "Datasets used to train."

IvmeLabs/Ivme-Conversate-v3-Base.description: **İvme** (Turkish: *acceleration*) is a series of stupidly small language models built to punch above their weight. This is the third release: a 24.79M parameter decoder-only base model trained from scratch, with a deeper/narrower architecture, two new attention-level changes, a digit-atomic tokenizer, and a revised data mix.

d0rj/looped-51M-base.description: A **50,869,760-parameter** English base model trained from random initialization in the [Tiny llm ablation](https://huggingface.co/collections/d0rj/tiny-llm-ablation-6aafca336122dd2c2868f923) experiment.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instru.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

BrCamp/bee-350m-pt-base.description: Modelo de linguagem de **345,4M parametros** pre-treinado **do zero em portugues**, com tokenizador proprio de 32k. Nao e' fine-tune de nada: pesos aleatorios -> 21,75B tokens.

csebuetnlp/banglabert_small.description: This repository contains the pretrained discriminator checkpoint of the model **BanglaBERT (small)**. This is an [ELECTRA](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=r1xMH1BtvB) discriminator model pretrained with the Replaced Token Detection (RTD) objective. Finetuned models using this checkpoint achieve state-of-the-art results on many of the NLP tasks in bengali.

MCG-NJU/videomae-base-short.description: VideoMAE model pre-trained on Kinetics-400 for 800 epochs in a self-supervised way. It was introduced in the paper [VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Tong et al. and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VideoMAE).

raihan-js/medllm-10m.description: A lightweight **GPT-2-style causal language model trained from scratch** on medical literature. Designed for research and education in the medical domain.

google/fnet-large.description: Pretrained model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) and next sentence prediction (NSP) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.03824) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/f_net). This model is cased: it makes a difference between english and English. The model achieves 0.58 accuracy on MLM objective and 0.80 on NSP objective.

akoumpa/Moonlight-V4-16B-A3B.description: **A proposed, untrained DeepSeek-V4-architecture configuration at Moonlight-16B-A3B scale** (no weights). [Moonlight-16B-A3B](https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Moonlight-16B-A3B) is the DeepSeek-V3 architecture at "DeepSeek-V3-Small" scale (2048 hidden, 27 layers, 64 experts), trained by Moonshot with Muon. This config is the same idea for **DeepSeek-V4**: it keeps Moonlight's width, depth, expert count and expert size, and swaps in every V4 architectural change: hybrid Compressed Sparse / Heavily Compressed Attention, manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC), a hash-routed first MoE layer, shared-KV MQA with a grouped low-rank output projection, sqrt-softplus routing, attention sinks and clamped SwiGLU. `COMPARISON.md` in this repo is the full side-by-side analysis against Moonlight;

VertexAGI/quartz-micro-preview-v2.description: A tiny language model trained **from scratch** by Vertex AGI on a single GTX 1660 Ti: a 100.09M-parameter dense Llama-architecture decoder (12 layers, hidden 768, 12 heads / 4 KV heads, SwiGLU 2048, RoPE, tied 32K byte-level BPE, 1,024 context). This is **Quartz Micro Preview V2**, the instruction-tuned chat model. The raw pretrained model is [Quartz Micro Preview V2 Base (VertexAGI/quartz-micro-preview-v2-base)](https://huggingface.co/VertexAGI/quartz-micro-preview-v2-base).

manus4oHER/aster-live-transformer.description: This repository contains the actual materialized float32 parameter tensors and signed continuity evidence for Aster's step-132 state. It is a custom conventional block-dense transformer trained from random initialization with an intrinsic objective: predict its own next internal state and next error signal. A learned internal controller chooses adaptation and append growth.

sriram1983007/SRA-RiskGate-4B-Q4_K_M-GGU.description: This repository contains the **Q4_K_M** GGUF weights (~2.5 GB) for [SRA-RiskGate-4B](https://huggingface.co/sriram1983007/SRA-RiskGate-4B), a risk scoring and dispute adjudication model for stablecoin payments (EIP-3009, x402, ERC-20, escrow).

SKocur/wieszcz-xix-349m.description: A 349M-parameter decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** on a corpus of Polish text catalogued as published between 1800 and 1918. It writes in the language of that period and keeps the period spelling of the text it continues. It is a base model: it continues text and does not answer questions.

osjayaprakash/llm-0.5b-fineweb-edu.description: A 489M-parameter Llama-style base model pretrained from scratch on 4.19B tokens of [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu), on a **single rented RTX 5090** for **$13.70** of GPU time.

PursuitOfDataScience/argonne-4.5-base-ct.description: **A 2.06B-parameter base model trained from scratch on 145.21B tokens, with a trained 13,568-token context.** It is the final base checkpoint of the Argonne 4.5 line.

mykor/mmBERT-base-GGUF.description: > TL;DR: A state-of-the-art multilingual encoder trained on 3T+ tokens across 1800+ languages, introducing novel techniques for learning low-resource languages during the decay phase.

empulse/KiCAD-MCP-Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF.description: A fine-tuned Qwen3.5-4B model specialized for KiCAD PCB design assistance via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Trained to select and invoke the correct tools from a 159-tool KiCAD MCP server covering schematic capture, PCB layout, DRC, export, library management, and more.

aradmanamnaoon/persian-lm-from-scratch.description: A decoder-only transformer language model trained **entirely from scratch** on Persian Wikipedia text. No pretrained weights, no pretrained tokenizer, no distillation — the model, the tokenizer, and the training corpus were all built for this project.

Compactbot/storylm-10m.description: A ~12.6M parameter LLaMA-style causal language model trained from scratch on TinyStories.

BananaMind/BananaMind-2.1-Pico-Preview.description: BananaMind-2.1-Pico-Preview is a **1,480,516-parameter** decoder-only base language model trained from scratch by BananaMind on **2B tokens** of FineWeb-Edu. It is the first public checkpoint of the BananaMind 2.1 architecture line and is released as a preview: the architecture, not the checkpoint, is the point of the release.

DedeProGames/Wisp-15M.description: **Wisp-15M** is a tiny decoder-only language model from the **Wisp** family, trained from scratch on **3.00B tokens** of English web text, code and math. It uses a plain LLaMA architecture, so it loads with `transformers` (`LlamaForCausalLM`) with no custom code.

PursuitOfDataScience/argonne-4.5-base.description: **A 2.06B-parameter base model trained from scratch on 128.07B tokens, with a 1,024-token context.** It is the Argonne 4.5 base *before* long-context extension.

colorfulscoop/bert-base-ja.description: This repository contains a BERT base model trained on Japanese Wikipedia dataset.

d0rj/q-51M-base.description: A **50,878,208-parameter** English base model in the **Tiny llm ablation** experiment. Trained from scratch on exactly **3,932,160,000 source tokens** over **15,000 optimizer steps**. The token count measures processed input blocks, not unique text or supervised target tokens.

Mostafa8Mehrabi/qwen3-71M-c4-final.description: Pretrained Qwen3-50M model on C4 dataset using FP16 precision in notebook environment.

Maggio33/GoLLeM-110M-PL-v3.description: Polski model językowy **110M** (GPT-2-class), trenowany **od zera** na AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (ROCm/WSL2). Model **bazowy (completion)** — kontynuuje tekst, **nie jest chatbotem** (nie odpowiada na pytania; daj mu początek zdania).

Kepler182ab/llama2-15m-tinystories.description: A 15M parameter Llama 2 model pretrained on the [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) dataset. Pretrained by [Andrej Karpathy](https://github.com/karpathy/llama2.c) (stories15M checkpoint), uploaded here for easy loading and fine-tuning.

prabakaranchandran/baby-pooh-46m-midtrai.description: > **Experimental, work in progress.** A mid-trained version of > [Baby Pooh 46M v1](https://huggingface.co/prabakaranchandran/baby-pooh-46m), a 46M-parameter causal LM trained > from scratch on a child-scale corpus. It is **not** instruction-tuned and **not** a chat model. Mid-training adds > knowledge of A. A. Milne's Pooh world; the character itself (chat, persona, safety) comes in later post-training.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-25m-v4-base.description: A **25M-parameter** language model trained from scratch on **11B tokens**, part of the TinyBrainBot v4 series. 25.2M parameters in the transformer itself, plus a 5.4M tied embedding for its 14k vocabulary (30.6M total). It is a base model: it continues text.

Crawlnet/queen-v1.5.description: A small language model trained **from scratch**. **Pretraining data and tokenizer: only pages the Crawlnet crawlers read on the crypto web** (real browsers). No pretrained weights, no FineWeb, no other corpus. **Chat tuning: question/answer pairs generated by `deepseek-flash` from those crawler pages** (details below). Expect a dumb, funny, confidently-wrong model; that is the point.

codelion/gpt-2-70m.description: A 70M parameter GPT-2 model trained on 1 billion tokens using an optimized 50-30-20 dataset mixing strategy.

nkkbr/Mini-K3-1H-kda-kernel-64-v2.description: This repository contains a text-only Mini-K3-1H v2 pretraining checkpoint from a controlled 20-architecture comparison. The family retains Kimi-K3's KDA and Gated MLA operators, block Attention Residuals, Stable LatentMoE, SiTU activations, output gates, and Quantile Balancing at approximately one billion logical parameters. The exact architecture for this repository is listed below; some ablations deliberately replace the baseline KDA/MLA ratio, decay granularity, convolution length, or positional encoding.

Cion-lab/ounce100m-v1.description: A **106,194,240-parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch on 999,817,216 tokens** of `Cion-lab/ounce100m-mix-v1`, in 3814 optimiser steps on **2×Nvidia Tesla T4** inside Kaggle notebook sessions. It is the deliverable of a project whose whole point was to find out what a ~100 M-parameter model reaches from ~1 B tokens of a curated public mix, and to report it honestly, including where that is near chance.

stunmuffin/TinyTurk-v2.7d.description: **TinyTurk v2.7d** is a 1.12M-parameter Turkish causal language model trained from scratch on a curated corpus of Turkish short stories. It is designed for research on tiny-scale language modeling, Turkish morphosyntax, and on-device inference.

DhruvParmar051/syrinx-10m.description: The smallest Syrinx model: a decoder-only transformer trained from scratch on TinyStories, a corpus of short synthetic children's stories. It is the first of three models (10M, 50M, 125M) in a scaling series and exists to validate the training, evaluation and export pipeline end to end.

Diamegs/PIT-4B-201312.description: **Point-In-Time (PIT)** is a family of GPT-style language models trained on chronologically-ordered monthly snapshots of [FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb). Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

Snarcy/RadioDino-b16.description: **RadioDINO-b16** is a self-supervised Vision Transformer foundation model developed for radiomics and medical imaging. It is based on the DINO framework and pretrained on the large-scale **RadImageNet** dataset (1.35 million CT, MRI, and Ultrasound images across 165 classes and 11 anatomical regions). This model is part of the *Radio DINO* family and was created to extract robust, general-purpose features for downstream medical tasks including classification, segmentation, and interpretability analysis.

Charangan/MedBERT.description: **MedBERT** is a newly pre-trained transformer-based language model for biomedical named entity recognition: initialized with [Bio_ClinicalBERT](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.03323) & pre-trained on N2C2, BioNLP, and CRAFT community datasets.

Compactbot/bananamind3-lft-2.5m.description: A **2.5M-parameter** language model trained **from scratch** by @Compactbot, requested by **@Banaxi-Tech** in [model-requests#4](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Compactbot/model-requests/discussions/4).

Diamegs/PIT-4B-202012.description: **Point-In-Time (PIT)** is a family of GPT-style language models trained on chronologically-ordered monthly snapshots of [FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb). Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

Flexan/MohammedSabry-biinduct-1b-baselin.description: These are the GGUF files for [MohammedSabry/biinduct-1b-baseline](https://huggingface.co/MohammedSabry/biinduct-1b-baseline).

antichronology/orthrus-4-track.description: 10M-param Mamba RNA encoder, contrastive pretrained on 45M+ mature mRNA transcripts. 4-track one-hot input.

Every weight was trained on Azerbaijani text; no third-party model was used as a starting point. It uses SIBA's own 262,144-piece Azerbaijani tokenizer, which needs about 1.7 pieces per Azerbaijani word.

capemox/ettin-encoder-32m-pretrain-50m.description: A retrieval encoder pretrained from [jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-32m](https://huggingface.co/jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-32m) on **a 50M-pair balanced split of the DenseOn embeddings pre-training dataset**.

Compactbot/catgirl-1m.description: A **1,064,737-parameter** tsundere-catgirl conversational persona model. A full fine-tune of the community's [Glint-2](https://huggingface.co/Glint-Research/Glint-2) looped-block base, trained on a ~216 KB synthetic `User:`/`Cat:` dialogue corpus of tsundere-catgirl chatter.

Crawlnet/queen-v6.description: A small language model trained **from scratch**. **Pretraining data: pages the Crawlnet crawlers read on the crypto web** (real browsers; 65% of the tokens trained), **public market, funding and on-chain records written out as plain-text pages** (4%), **study notes a general-purpose LLM wrote for 153,245 of those pages** (24%) and **question/answer pairs a general-purpose LLM generated from those pages** (7%); details in Pretraining data below. **Tokenizer: trained on this dataset's pages only (crawler pages and record pages).** No pretrained weights, no FineWeb, no other corpus. **Chat tuning: question/answer pairs generated by a general-purpose LLM from those pages (with the study notes' own Q&A), pairs cut from the pages and open-book conversations that answer from retrieved pages with

wayneworkman2012/peacebell-v1-291M.description: **Peacebell** is a **291M-parameter** GPT-style decoder trained **from scratch** to know the history of World War II: custom architecture, a custom 28,000-token SentencePiece vocabulary, and a 32,768-token context. It is not a fine-tune of any other model and was not distilled from one. The weights started random, and every token it saw in training came from the datasets listed under "Datasets used to train."

AwaisAdilKhokhar/ravaan-ar-70m.description: 70M parameters, trained from scratch on a purpose-built 85.4M-token Urdu corpus. On its own terms it is a competent small Urdu language model. **Its reason for existing is to be the matched baseline** for [`ravaan-diff-70m`](https://huggingface.co/AwaisAdilKhokhar/ravaan-diff-70m) — identical corpus, identical model, identical task mixture and tokenizer, so that the two can be compared without confounds.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-pretraining-st.description: This model suite is presented in the paper [Deep Ignorance: Filtering Pretraining Data Builds Tamper-Resistant Safeguards into Open-Weight LLMs](https://huggingface.co/papers/2508.06601). **Project Page**: https://deepignorance.ai/ **Code**: https://github.com/EleutherAI/deep-ignorance

AneekC/quipu-114m.description: A 114,114,048-parameter language model trained from scratch on a single 8 GB laptop GPU (RTX 5060 Laptop): own weights, own data pipeline, no fine-tuned base.

VADRK155/Cortex-1-Code.description: A small GPT model for code generation, trained completely from scratch (custom PyTorch architecture, no `transformers` library involved).

jfrick/scholarly-code-modern-gpt-124m-st.description: This is the **completed 5B-token experiment checkpoint**, trained from random initialization. Completed training: **4,999,981,176 nonpadding next-token exposures / 64,227 optimizer updates**. The target is 5,000,000,000 exposures; a complete global batch may finish slightly below it. This is not instruction-tuned, and no downstream capability or full-8K effectiveness is claimed.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking-GGUF.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

dccuchile/albert-tiny-spanish.description: This is an [ALBERT](https://github.com/google-research/albert) model trained on a [big spanish corpora](https://github.com/josecannete/spanish-corpora). The model was trained on a single TPU v3-8 with the following hyperparameters and steps/time: - LR: 0.00125 - Batch Size: 2048 - Warmup ratio: 0.0125 - Warmup steps: 125000 - Goal steps: 10000000 - Total steps: 8300000 - Total training time (aprox): 58.2 days

Compactbot/hypernix-3.1-mini.description: Pretraining continuation of [ray0rf1re/HyperNix.3-mini](https://huggingface.co/ray0rf1re/HyperNix.3-mini), trained by @Compactbot on behalf of the model-requests board (#9).

davemaxuellkr/scglm-v2-46m.description: SCG-LM V2 is a **46,346,752-parameter** Llama-style language model trained **from random initialization** on **45.0 billion tokens** of human-written English. Training took 31.9 hours on a single H100. It is a **base model**: it continues text, and it has not been instruction-tuned or safety-tuned. It was built for Track 01 of the Global Innovation Build Challenge V2 (train a language model from scratch with at most 50M parameters).

VertexResearch/Vertex-0.6-200M-Base.description: A 198M-parameter decoder-only transformer (Qwen3 architecture), pretrained from scratch by Vertex Research on 20B tokens of filtered English web text (Ultra-FineWeb). It is the largest model in the Vertex 0.6 family and the strongest base we have trained so far. Apache 2.0, weights and tokenizer included.

AwaisAdilKhokhar/ravaan-diff-70m.description: **To our knowledge this is the first masked diffusion language model trained for Urdu** (literature searched 2026-09-23; see *Novelty* below for what that claim does and does not cover). 70M parameters, trained from scratch on a purpose-built 85.4M-token Urdu corpus.

google/multiberts-seed_1.description: MultiBERTs is a collection of checkpoints and a statistical library to support robust research on BERT. We provide 25 BERT-base models trained with similar hyper-parameters as [the original BERT model](https://github.com/google-research/bert) but with different random seeds, which causes variations in the initial weights and order of training instances. The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

davemaxuellkr/Global-Innovation-Build-Ch.description: SCG-LM V2.1 is a **46,346,752-parameter** Llama-style language model trained **from random initialization**. It is our [SCG-LM V2](https://huggingface.co/davemaxuellkr/scglm-v2-46m) base model, pretrained on 45.0 billion tokens of human-written English, with one more short training stage. That stage fine-tuned it for 20 minutes on the **training splits** of the four benchmarks it is evaluated on: HellaSwag, ARC, PIQA and WinoGrande. It was built for Track 01 of the Global Innovation Build Challenge V2 (train a language model from scratch with at most 50M parameters). No pretrained weights from any other model and no distillation were used.

OPENGCM/GTM-v2-chat.description: A ~120M parameter, decoder-only GPT-style model, base-pretrained from scratch and then fine-tuned (SFT) on UltraChat to behave like a chat assistant. Single RTX Pro 6000, ~4.16B pretraining tokens + ~1B SFT tokens.

vijaymohan/gpt2-tinystories-from-scratch.description: This repository contains a GPT-2–style language model trained from scratch on the [roneneldan/TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) dataset using Hugging Face’s Transformers library on Google Colab Pro+ A100 GPU. The training objective was to build a small, educational, and easily reproducible transformer LM for story generation.

edededdy/ShallowSeek-mini-it.description: `ShallowSeek-mini-it` is the **instruction-tuned (chat) version of [ShallowSeek-mini-base](https://huggingface.co/edededdy/ShallowSeek-mini-base)**, a tiny DeepSeek-V3-style Mixture-of-Experts model trained from scratch on a laptop CPU. It has **11.0M parameters**, of which **6.3M are active per token**.

Given language instruction and RGB images of up to three views, RDT can predict the next 64 robot actions. RDT is compatible with almost all modern mobile manipulators, from single-arm to dual-arm, joint to EEF, position to velocity, and even wheeled locomotion.

Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

IvmeLabs/Ivme-Conversate-v2-Base.description: **İvme** (Turkish: *acceleration*) is a series of stupidly small language models built to punch above their weight. This is the second release: a 24M parameter decoder-only base model trained from scratch, this time with a much heavier training diet.

ajesujoba/AfriHuBERT.description: This is a compact multilingual self-supervised speech encoder based on mHuBERT-147. We performed continued pretraining through multilingual adaptive finetuning (MAFT) on over 10,000 hours of African language data aggregated from various sources. This model can be considered the fourth iteration of mHuBERT-147, specifically trained on African languages. According to the paper, this is the **AfriHuBERT-*n*** model. You can click [here](https://huggingface.co/ajesujoba/AfriHuBERTs) for the **AfriHuBERT-*s*** model, and [here](https://huggingface.co/ajesujoba/AfriHuBERTo) for the **AfriHuBERT-*o*** model.

google/multiberts-seed_0.description: MultiBERTs is a collection of checkpoints and a statistical library to support robust research on BERT. We provide 25 BERT-base models trained with similar hyper-parameters as [the original BERT model](https://github.com/google-research/bert) but with different random seeds, which causes variations in the initial weights and order of training instances. The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

ai-forever/ruElectra-small.description: The model architecture design, pretraining, and evaluation are documented in our preprint: [**A Family of Pretrained Transformer Language Models for Russian**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.10931).

PrometheanStudio/styx-100m.description: Styx is a 96.48-million-parameter language model developed by Promethean Studios as part of the Talos model family.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-360m-a75m-v4.1-mo.description: A **mixture-of-experts** language model trained from scratch on two Tesla V100s. Every layer holds **24 experts** and each token uses **4** of them, so the model stores **359M** parameters but runs only **75.7M per token** (non-embedding; plus a 24.6M tied embedding, 383M in total). It was trained on **18.2B tokens** with a **2,048-token** context, then given one **expert-tuned patch** for factual question answering (below).

Maltehb/aelaectra-danish-electra-small-u.description: **Ælæctra** is a Danish Transformer-based language model created to enhance the variety of Danish NLP resources with a more efficient model compared to previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. Initially a cased and an uncased model are released. It was created as part of a Cognitive Science bachelor's thesis.

Compactbot/testr-100k.description: A **100,936-parameter** character-level GPT trained from scratch. Fulfils model request [#17](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Compactbot/model-requests/discussions/17) from @GGUFGuy.

sultan/BioM-ELECTRA-Large-Discriminator.description: The impact of design choices on the performance of biomedical language models recently has been a subject for investigation. In this paper, we empirically study biomedical domain adaptation with large transformer models using different design choices. We evaluate the performance of our pretrained models against other existing biomedical language models in the literature. Our results show that we achieve state-of-the-art results on several biomedical domain tasks despite using similar or less computational cost compared to other models in the literature. Our findings highlight the significant effect of design choices on improving the performance of biomedical language models.

shalev396/tiny-shakespeare-chat.description: A small GPT written and trained **from scratch** (no pretrained weights, no tokenizer library). It is a character-level, nanoGPT-style decoder with 10,751,232 parameters. It was first pretrained on the Tiny Shakespeare corpus to predict the next character, then chat-tuned on 7,096 consecutive dialogue-line pairs, so it answers a message with the "next line" of an imaginary play. Its replies are play-style verse, not facts.

It is a deliberately minimal, self-contained GPT-2-style transformer — small enough to fit on a floppy disk, honest about what it can and cannot do.

hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-cyber-pr.description: An **offensive-security / agentic tool-calling** LoRA merge on top of — the training-free abliterated build of [Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B). The LoRA is **merged** into the base at **scale 1.0** (PEFT `alpha/r = 64/32 = 2.0`, i.e. the exact strength the scale sweep below found optimal), and the **MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) head is preserved**, so the GGUF build supports self-speculative decoding.

It is the larger sibling of [JugnuLM-53M](https://huggingface.co/altslate/JugnuLM-53M) and the **baseline rung of an ongoing ablation study** on what improves sub-150M models. *Jugnu* (जुगनू) = firefly.

DedeProGames/Wisp-5M.description: **Wisp-5M** is a tiny decoder-only language model from the **Wisp** family, trained from scratch on **3.00B tokens** of English web text, code and math. It uses a plain LLaMA architecture, so it loads with `transformers` (`LlamaForCausalLM`) with no custom code.

Modujo-AI/ModujoMoE.description: This repository keeps model variants in self-contained subdirectories. The repository name is retained for compatibility, but the repository root no longer contains model weights and must not be loaded directly.

Snarcy/RedDino-base.description: **RedDino** is a self-supervised Vision Transformer foundation model specifically designed for **red blood cell (RBC)** image analysis. It leverages a tailored version of the **DINOv2** framework, trained on a meticulously curated dataset of **1.25 million RBC images** from diverse acquisition modalities and sources. This model excels at extracting robust, general-purpose features for downstream hematology tasks such as **shape classification**, **morphological subtype recognition**, and **batch-effect–robust analysis**.

Ayaka157/RetNet-0.5B-ep1.description: First training leg of the 0.5B model, run on a rented RTX 3090 24 GB. Validation loss **2.1035**. The final model is [RetNet-0.5B](https://huggingface.co/Ayaka157/RetNet-0.5B) at 1.9459.

metavoiceio/metavoice-1B-v0.1.description: MetaVoice-1B is a 1.2B parameter base model trained on 100K hours of speech for TTS (text-to-speech). It has been built with the following priorities: * Emotional speech rhythm and tone in English. No hallucinations. * Support for voice cloning with finetuning. * We have had success with as little as 1 minute training data for Indian speakers. * Zero-shot cloning for American & British voices, with 30s reference audio. * Support for long-form synthesis.

Atharva31/indicslm-from-scratch.description: A ~22M-parameter decoder-only transformer built **fully from scratch** — no HF `Trainer`, no `tokenizers` library, no library RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU/attention implementations — for Indian government/legal-domain Q&A (RTI Act 2005, Consumer Protection Act 2019, myscheme.gov.in scheme eligibility) in English, Hindi, and Marathi. EnergyFM/energy-ttm.description: **Energy-TTM** is a domain-specific **Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM)** for energy meter data analytics, pretrained on large-scale real-world smart meter data from the **EnergyBench** corpus. Built upon IBM Research's **Tiny Time Mixer (TTM)** architecture, it learns transferable representations of electricity consumption patterns across diverse residential and commercial buildings.

OPENGCM/GTM-v2-base.description: A ~120M parameter, decoder-only GPT-style **base** language model, trained from scratch on a single RTX Pro 6000, on roughly 4 billion tokens streamed from a mix of open web/educational/math corpora.

karolnowakowski/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-p.description: This is a [wav2vec-large-xlsr-53](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53) model adapted for the Ainu language by performing continued pretraining for 100k steps on 234 hours of speech data in Hokkaido Ainu and Sakhalin Ainu. Модель содержит **10,523,520 параметров**: шесть слоёв, размер скрытого состояния 384, шесть голов запросов и три KV-головы. Используются **ALiBi, GQA, RMSNorm и SwiGLU**. Словарь содержит 1 024 токена, длина контекста — 128 токенов. В коде также реализованы бонусные RoPE и MLA с отдельными RoPE-компонентами. Они проверены численно; опубликованные обученные веса используют ALiBi/GQA.

Exquisique/BabyLangModel.description: A tiny GPT-style language model trained from scratch on the [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) dataset. Built using PyTorch and a custom architecture inspired by [nanoGPT](https://github.com/karpathy/nanoGPT). omartra999/tlm-xs-refactor.description: TLM-XS is a small encoder-decoder transformer trained **from scratch, with no pretrained weights**. Given a Python function and a task, it produces the edit as a SEARCH/REPLACE block that can be applied to the source.

TevunahAi/Chochmah-1B-Instruct-DPO.description: This is [Chochmah-1B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/TevunahAi/Chochmah-1B-Instruct) with one more pass: direct preference optimization on UltraFeedback, on top of the SFT weights. The base, [Chochmah-1B](https://huggingface.co/TevunahAi/Chochmah-1B), is our 1.18B-parameter model pretrained from scratch on 45 billion tokens on a single workstation GPU; the instruct model taught it to answer; this one taught it which of two answers is better. All three stages ran on the same RTX 5000 Ada, and every number below comes from those runs.

google/multiberts-seed_2.description: MultiBERTs is a collection of checkpoints and a statistical library to support robust research on BERT. We provide 25 BERT-base models trained with similar hyper-parameters as [the original BERT model](https://github.com/google-research/bert) but with different random seeds, which causes variations in the initial weights and order of training instances. The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

omurberaisik/NoTokenLM-Gen-4.6.description: **A 36.8-million-parameter, byte-level, tokenizer-free language model trained on an English text mix that includes about 20% math. No subword vocabulary, no BPE — just raw UTF-8 bytes in, raw UTF-8 bytes out.**

NadevA23/Kronumos.description: **Kronumos** is the foundational release of the Kronumos Dual-Brain automated program repair ecosystem.

cinmodel/electra-small-japanese-discrimi.description: We provide a Japanese **ELECTRA-Small** model, as described in [ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather Than Generators](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=r1xMH1BtvB).

sraivante/LMLM_97M_1.description: A **97.6M-parameter language model trained from scratch**, then fine-tuned for short, polite, everyday English conversation. It is a small, open research and learning model: you can read every line of its training code, run it on a laptop CPU, and see exactly where a model of this size is good and where it fails.

SLM-Archive/AppleMind-1.0-Mini.description: AppleMind-1.0-Mini is a compact decoder-only causal language model trained from scratch by AppleMind on a 300M-token curriculum.

tohio/slm-gpt-127m-dpo.description: `tohio/slm-gpt-127m-dpo` is a preference-aligned small language model (127M, ~126.8M parameters) aligned with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on pairwise conversational preferences.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-1.4Bparams-1.description: A 1.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 10.6B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

MinimaLabs/KeyLM-75M.description: KeyLM-75M is a 75M parameter base language model trained from scratch on approximately 18 billion tokens. That training budget is a small fraction of what comparable small models use (SmolLM-135M was trained on roughly 600B tokens, SmolLM2-135M on roughly 2T).

d0rj/q-prefixlm-51M-base.description: A **50,866,688-parameter** English base model trained from random initialization in the [Tiny llm ablation](https://huggingface.co/collections/d0rj/tiny-llm-ablation-6aafca336122dd2c2868f923) experiment.

mokshjain/pico.description: **Pico** is a **48.2M-parameter** decoder-only transformer trained from scratch in pure JAX (no Flax, no optax), following Karpathy's [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) recipe and extending it to build a complete **tool-calling agent** from pretraining through on-policy reinforcement learning—without any distillation or synthetic LLM-generated data.

It is a plain next-token predictor: **not instruction-tuned, not safety-tuned**, and it will continue text, not answer questions. It is a research and baseline model.

mys/timesfm-3.0-GGUF.description: **Google TimesFM 3.0** foundation time-series forecaster compiled from (20 mixing layers, 1280 hidden, patch 32→64).

thebajajra/RexBERT-base.description: > **TL;DR**: An encoder-only transformer (ModernBERT-style) for **e-commerce** applications, trained in three phases—**Pre-training**, **Context Extension**, and **Decay**—to power product search, attribute extraction, classification, and embeddings use cases. The model has been trained on 2.3T+ tokens along with 350B+ e-commerce-specific tokens

izumi-lab/electra-small-japanese-fin-dis.description: This is a [ELECTRA](https://github.com/google-research/electra) model pretrained on texts in the Japanese language.

mssfj/qwen25-0.5b-finemath-4plus-lit.description: The LitGPT-format export of a baseline model for TDT comparison experiments, trained on FineWeb-Edu and then FineMath-4plus. It contains the same weights as the Transformers-format model.

Compactbot/swordies-22m.description: **A 22.49M-parameter from-scratch BPE GPT trained on the *lowest-quality* decile of FineWeb-Edu.** This is a **data-quality ablation**, not a usable language model. It was built to answer one question: *what does a small model learn when you feed it only the worst-scoring text?*

Diamegs/PIT-4B-201912.description: **Point-In-Time (PIT)** is a family of GPT-style language models trained on chronologically-ordered monthly snapshots of [FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb). Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

Eugleo/climbmix-d26-10tpp-noright.description: One of four **identically trained** d26 base models (depth 26, ~918M scaling parameters, nanochat CLEAN family) whose training corpora differ only in which documents were replaced. Ilides/cortex-0.3-0.02b.description: **GPT conversacional de 20,6M parámetros, entrenado desde cero en NumPy puro** (sin PyTorch durante el entrenamiento) sobre un corpus bilingüe ES/EN de 473M tokens y afinado en español para conversación.

Ayaka157/RetNet-0.5B-ep2.description: Intermediate checkpoint of the three-leg run. Validation loss **1.9865**. The final model is [RetNet-0.5B](https://huggingface.co/Ayaka157/RetNet-0.5B) at 1.9459.

Bur3hani/MuchKnow-Foundation-8B.description: **MuchKnow-Foundation-8B** is a high-performance bilingual (Tanzanian Kiswahili 🇹🇿 + English 🇬🇧) enterprise base model fine-tuned on top of `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B`.

omartra999/tlm-m-refactor.description: TLM-M is a small encoder-decoder transformer trained **from scratch, with no pretrained weights**. Given a Python function and a task, it produces the edit as a SEARCH/REPLACE block that can be applied to the source.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-350mV3-math.description: **[Try it in your browser](https://huggingface.co/spaces/nkthebass/tinybrainbot-350m-math)**: the new `tinybrainbot-350mV3-math-Q8_0.gguf` (371 MB) runs locally on your device with WebGPU, and nothing you type is sent anywhere.

MinimaLabs/KLM-1.1.description: **KLM 1.1 is an 88M-parameter base language model, the continued training of KeyLM-75M.** It scores 17.40 on the Open SLM Intelligence Index, up from KeyLM-75M's 10.44. That moves it from 38th to 9th among models under 100M parameters on the Open SLM leaderboard.

tohoku-nlp/bert-large-japanese-char-v2.description: This is a [BERT](https://github.com/google-research/bert) model pretrained on texts in the Japanese language.

Huypero/AgentContentVietnamese-110m.description: Base language model tiếng Việt, train từ đầu trên corpus báo chí tiếng Việt. Đây là bản **final**, đã hoàn thành một epoch tại bước **14,411**.

mii-llm/zagreus-0.4B-ita.description: **Zagreus-0.4B-ita** is a bilingual English/Italian foundational Small Language Model (SLM) trained **from scratch** by the [mii-llm](https://mii-llm.ai) community (*Made in Italy – Large Language Model*) on the [Seeweb](https://www.seeweb.it) HPC infrastructure.

It produces probabilistic forecasts from historical observations, with optional covariates and input-output demonstrations that provide additional context at inference time, without updating model parameters.

nkkbr/Mini-K3-1H-attn-4kda-v2.description: This repository contains a text-only Mini-K3-1H v2 pretraining checkpoint from a controlled 20-architecture comparison. The family retains Kimi-K3's KDA and Gated MLA operators, block Attention Residuals, Stable LatentMoE, SiTU activations, output gates, and Quantile Balancing at approximately one billion logical parameters. The exact architecture for this repository is listed below; some ablations deliberately replace the baseline KDA/MLA ratio, decay granularity, convolution length, or positional encoding.

XiaoduoAILab/Xmodel_LM.description: Xmodel-LM is a **1.1-billion-parameter causal language model** pretrained from scratch by [XiaoduoAI](https://github.com/XiaoduoAILab) on ~**2 trillion tokens** of bilingual (Chinese & English) data. Despite its compact size, it **outperforms** many open-source 1B-scale models (e.g. TinyLlama-1.1B, OPT-1.3B, Pythia-1.4B) on both English and Chinese benchmarks.

Diamegs/PIT-4B-201812.description: **Point-In-Time (PIT)** is a family of GPT-style language models trained on chronologically-ordered monthly snapshots of [FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb). Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

izumi-lab/electra-base-japanese-discrimi.description: This is a [ELECTRA](https://github.com/google-research/electra) model pretrained on texts in the Japanese language.

Mercity/pretrain-longcat-ngram-25pct.description: A ~1B-parameter Llama 3-style decoder that spends about 25% of its parameter budget on hashed n-gram embedding tables, following the [LongCat n-gram embedding module](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21204). To keep the total near 1B, it has 23 transformer layers instead of the [baseline's](https://huggingface.co/Mercity/pretrain-baseline-qknorm) 32. Everything else matches the baseline, including the 6B FineWeb training tokens.

hsanyyasyn97gmail/cosmos-v2.description: Cosmos-v2 is a 2.1 billion parameter causal language model trained **from scratch**. It is based on a Qwen-like architecture and was developed over a period of 3 years through extensive experimentation (more than 116 training runs, of which 113 failed).

tohio/slm-gpt-127m-sft.description: `tohio/slm-gpt-127m-sft` is an instruction-tuned small language model (127M, ~126.8M parameters) fine-tuned on multi-turn reasoning and instruction dialogues formatted in ChatML.

ivanmikhnenkov/tinydit-256.description: A 210M-parameter text-to-image diffusion transformer trained from scratch on one GPU (3.5 days, 400k steps, 4.2M images at 256² area with aspect-ratio buckets). Frozen FLUX.2 autoencoder (32-channel latent) and frozen flan-t5-base text encoder; the transformer, recipe, data pipeline and evaluation are original.

maf1oz1/llm-course-hw1-rope.description: Вариант модели из домашнего задания №1 курса по LLM (HSE), в котором позиционное кодирование **ALiBi заменено на Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE)**. Всё остальное — архитектура, токенизатор, данные и гиперпараметры — совпадает с основной моделью: [maf1oz1/llm-course-hw1](https://huggingface.co/maf1oz1/llm-course-hw1).

BerkayRA/egemen-turkish-124m.description: A small **Llama-style decoder-only** language model trained **from scratch on Turkish**, as the headline run of an A/B pre-training experiment ("Config A"). It is a research / educational base model — a demonstration that a coherent Turkish LM can be trained on a single 8 GB GPU — **not** an instruction-tuned or aligned assistant. Developed at, and on the infrastructure of, **Mega Bilgisayar Tic. Ltd. Şti.**

Mathieu680/Rastignac-1.0-126M.description: Rastignac 1.0 est un modèle de langage causal français de **126 481 920 paramètres**, entraîné entièrement depuis zéro sur **3 348 livres de la littérature française**. La date de publication indiquée pour les œuvres datées est en moyenne d’environ **1898**. Le modèle est destiné à la complétion de texte : à partir d’un début de phrase ou de paragraphe, il génère la suite dans un registre français à dominante littéraire.

maf1oz1/llm-course-hw1-mla.description: Вариант модели из домашнего задания №1 курса по LLM (HSE), в котором Grouped-Query Attention **заменён на Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA)** — механизм из DeepSeek-V2. izumi-lab/electra-small-japanese-discrim.description: This is a [ELECTRA](https://github.com/google-research/electra) model pretrained on texts in the Japanese language.

Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

Mercity/pretrain-kda-1b.description: A dense ~1B-parameter Llama 3-style decoder where one attention layer in every four is Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a linear-attention layer from [Kimi Linear](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26692). It is otherwise identical to the [QK-norm baseline](https://huggingface.co/Mercity/pretrain-baseline-qknorm) and was trained on the same 6B FineWeb tokens.

Mercity/pretrain-longcat-ngram-50pct.description: A ~1B-parameter Llama 3-style decoder that spends about 48% of its parameter budget on hashed n-gram embedding tables, following the [LongCat n-gram embedding module](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21204). To keep the total near 1B, it has 16 transformer layers instead of the [baseline's](https://huggingface.co/Mercity/pretrain-baseline-qknorm) 32. Everything else matches the baseline, including the 6B FineWeb training tokens.

tohio/slm-gpt-127m-base.description: `tohio/slm-gpt-127m-base` is a pre-trained base language model (127M, ~126.8M parameters) trained from scratch on a 10B token educational and reasoning curriculum. This checkpoint serves as the foundational base and has **not** undergone instruction tuning or alignment.

TevunahAi/Chochmah-1B-Instruct.description: This is the instruct version of [Chochmah-1B](https://huggingface.co/TevunahAi/Chochmah-1B), our 1.18B-parameter model pretrained from scratch on 45 billion tokens on a single workstation GPU. The base model learned to write; this one learned to answer. It was made with one supervised fine-tuning pass on SmolTalk, full-parameter, on the same RTX 5000 Ada the base was trained on, and every number below comes from that run.

NlpHUST/electra-base-vn.description: **ELECTRA** is a method for self-supervised language representation learning. It can be used to pre-train transformer networks using relatively little compute. ELECTRA models are trained to distinguish "real" input tokens vs "fake" input tokens generated by another neural network, similar to the discriminator of a [GAN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1406.2661.pdf). At small scale, ELECTRA achieves strong results even when trained on a single GPU. At large scale, ELECTRA achieves state-of-the-art results on the [SQuAD 2.0](https://rajpurkar.github.io/SQuAD-explorer/) dataset.

fausap/pico-165m.description: Pico is a 165M-parameter model trained from scratch on about 2.7B tokens on a single TPU chip. It is built for **multi-turn memory**: remembering what the user said, keeping standing instructions ("call me Captain", "end every reply with 'cheers'") and noticing false premises. Instead of reading the whole conversation, it works as a **resident agent**: - a note-taker turns each user message into `rule:` and `fact:` notes; - the answerer sees only those notes and the last two exchanges.

nvidia/C-RADIOv4-1D-H.description: This model performs visual feature extraction. Unlike standard Vision Transformers that produce a fixed 2D grid of patch features, RADIO1D compresses an input image into a compact, **variable-length 1D sequence of tokens**. The number of output tokens (from 1 up to 256) can be selected by the user at inference time, providing a continuous accuracy/efficiency trade-off. For example, an image can be summarized into a single token for retrieval, or expanded to 256 tokens for fine-grained tasks such as OCR.

Its gradient norm stayed high and wavy for the whole run, so we reran it with QK-norm on; that [QK-norm baseline](https://huggingface.co/Mercity/pretrain-baseline-qknorm) is the reference model for the rest of our ablations. We release this checkpoint so the effect of QK-norm can be compared directly.

tunib/electra-ko-base.description: We release several new versions of the [ELECTRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.10555) model, which we name TUNiB-Electra. There are two motivations. EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-pretraining-st.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

MannasAI/axon-eeg.description: AXON (**AX**is-factorized **O**perator **N**etwork) is a transformer encoder for EEG, pretrained with masked autoencoding. Each recording window is cut into tokens, one per electrode per one-second patch, so the tokens form a grid of electrodes by time steps. Instead of dense attention over all tokens, every layer runs two attention paths in parallel: a **temporal path** (each token attends to its own electrode across time) and a **spatial path** (each token attends to all electrodes at the same time step). A small per-token gate mixes the two.

sultan/BioM-ELECTRA-Base-Discriminator.description: The impact of design choices on the performance of biomedical language models recently has been a subject for investigation. In this paper, we empirically study biomedical domain adaptation with large transformer models using different design choices. We evaluate the performance of our pretrained models against other existing biomedical language models in the literature. Our results show that we achieve state-of-the-art results on several biomedical domain tasks despite using similar or less computational cost compared to other models in the literature. Our findings highlight the significant effect of design choices on improving the performance of biomedical language models.

The aim is to distinguish findings that apply to a specific artifact (i.e., a particular instance of the model) from those that apply to the more general procedure.

hfl/chinese-legal-electra-small-discrimi.description: Google and Stanford University released a new pre-trained model called ELECTRA, which has a much compact model size and relatively competitive performance compared to BERT and its variants. For further accelerating the research of the Chinese pre-trained model, the Joint Laboratory of HIT and iFLYTEK Research (HFL) has released the Chinese ELECTRA models based on the official code of ELECTRA. ELECTRA-small could reach similar or even higher scores on several NLP tasks with only 1/10 parameters compared to BERT and its variants.
