weights-and-wires/smol-llama.description: This repository contains **smol-llama**, a **~360M parameter LLaMA-architecture causal LM** trained **from scratch** for **next-token prediction**. This project was primarily an educational + engineering effort to reproduce a **SmolLM-like training setup** at a smaller scale.

BananaMind/BananaMind-1.5-Base.description: BananaMind-1.5-Base is a small English causal language model trained from scratch by BananaMind.

jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b.description: A sub-2B **vision–language model** specialized for cybersecurity imagery — disassembly/decompiler panes (IDA, Ghidra), packet captures (Wireshark), scanner and post-exploitation terminals (Nmap, Metasploit), and memory-forensics dumps (Volatility) — that answers in Spanish, emits **structured visual reasoning** via native `<|think|>` tokens before its answer, invokes external tools through the Model Context Protocol using native `<|tool_call|>` tokens, and exports cleanly to `llama.cpp`'s LLaVA `mmproj` format for fully on-premise, air-gapped deployment.

kamalkraj/bioelectra-base-discriminator-.description: Recent advancements in pretraining strategies in NLP have shown a significant improvement in the performance of models on various text mining tasks. In this paper, we introduce BioELECTRA, a biomedical domain-specific language encoder model that adapts ELECTRA (Clark et al., 2020) for the Biomedical domain. BioELECTRA outperforms the previous models and achieves state of the art (SOTA) on all the 13 datasets in BLURB benchmark and on all the 4 Clinical datasets from BLUE Benchmark across 7 NLP tasks. BioELECTRA pretrained on PubMed and PMC full text articles performs very well on Clinical datasets as well. BioELECTRA achieves new SOTA 86.34%(1.39% accuracy improvement) on MedNLI and 64% (2.98% accuracy improvement) on PubMedQA dataset.

Intel/bert-base-uncased-sparse-90-unstru.description: This model is a sparse pre-trained model that can be fine-tuned for a wide range of language tasks. The process of weight pruning is forcing some of the weights of the neural network to zero. Setting some of the weights to zero results in sparser matrices. Updating neural network weights does involve matrix multiplication, and if we can keep the matrices sparse while retaining enough important information, we can reduce the overall computational overhead. The term "sparse" in the title of the model indicates a ratio of sparsity in the weights; for more details, you can read [Zafrir et al. (2021)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.05754).

kamalkraj/bioelectra-base-discriminator-.description: Recent advancements in pretraining strategies in NLP have shown a significant improvement in the performance of models on various text mining tasks. In this paper, we introduce BioELECTRA, a biomedical domain-specific language encoder model that adapts ELECTRA (Clark et al., 2020) for the Biomedical domain. BioELECTRA outperforms the previous models and achieves state of the art (SOTA) on all the 13 datasets in BLURB benchmark and on all the 4 Clinical datasets from BLUE Benchmark across 7 NLP tasks. BioELECTRA pretrained on PubMed and PMC full text articles performs very well on Clinical datasets as well. BioELECTRA achieves new SOTA 86.34%(1.39% accuracy improvement) on MedNLI and 64% (2.98% accuracy improvement) on PubMedQA dataset.

Kymaris/ArzLM-300M-Base.description: **303,353,856**-parameter decoder-only **base** model trained from scratch on **6,000,214,016** tokens.

braindecode/BaRISTA-lobes.description: The released BaRISTA encoder of [Oganesian, Hashemi and Shanechi (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12135) for the **lobes** spatial scale, converted to [`braindecode.models.BaRISTA`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.BaRISTA.html).

sofieneb/omni-small.description: **OMNI-S** is a 28.7M-parameter pathology vision encoder distilled from **10 state-of-the-art pathology foundation models** at once. Instead of compressing all teachers into a single CLS token (vanilla multi-teacher distillation), OMNI learns **one token per teacher**, together with a structured attention mask, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers and a per-teacher contrastive loss. This lets distillation keep improving as more teachers are added.

sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-retriever.description: Быстрая модель BERT для задач текстового поиска (retrieval). Модель получена дистилляцией эмбеддингов русских и английских текстов [BAAI/bge-m3](https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-m3) в [rubert-tiny-turbo](https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo).

karuppusamym/slm-125m-legal-financial.description: A **125.8M-parameter** Llama-style causal language model, **pretrained from random weights** on a corpus of US case law, SEC filings, and educational web text. This is a **base text completer**, not an instruction-tuned chat model — it continues text plausibly but was never trained to follow instructions or hold a conversation, and it has no factual grounding beyond patterns in its training data.

AZERDSQ/G2-nano-base.description: A 60.03M-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on a single 8GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano with **twice** the tokens of G1-nano. Gains on short benchmarks are small. This is the base checkpoint: it completes text.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-yeast.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-yeast Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA text model with 17.31M parameters x 8 experts = 138.5M parameters. It is derived from Mistral-7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using around 1000 yeast genomes with 10kb DNA sequences.

zachwallace/bonsai-sapling-v1-290m-hf.description: Hi guys, I'm a high school student with a strong interest in AI and ML, and I wanted to create a model myself to better understand the process. IvmeLabs/ExpIvme-DiffusionConversate-v1.description: **İvme** (Turkish: *acceleration*) is normally a series of small autoregressive language models. This is not one of those. This is the same architecture family run through a different objective entirely: a masked/absorbing-state discrete diffusion language model instead of next-token prediction. "Exp" is doing real work in the name — this is an experiment to see what a small dSLM (diffusion small language model) can do at a scale we can train on one GPU in an afternoon, not a production model.

tegancao/tinystories-22m.description: A **22.7M parameter** language model trained **from scratch** on [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) (V2, GPT-4-generated short children's stories), as a learning project. It is a small **educational** model: useful for learning how language models work and for quick experiments, **not** for any real application. Its stories are fluent and usually complete, with simple plots and morals.

crp94/terranova.description: A defining problem of the Anthropocene is to model the physical Earth and human societies as one coupled system, yet no learned representation spans their observational breadth. We argue the obstacle is geometric: the physical Earth is measured as continuous fields that ignore political borders, whereas societies are reported for administrative units. Earth-system foundation models serve the first geometry; coupling it to the second has required lossy averaging over borders. TerraNova is trained on 1,024 physical and societal records in their native geometries: 512 gridded Earth-system fields and 512 national indicators.

zachwallace/bonsai-sapling-v1-290m-instr.description: Hi guys, I'm a high school student with a strong interest in AI and ML, and I wanted to create a model myself to better understand the process. EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-e2e-weak-filte.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

LG-AI-Research/EXAONE-Forecast-for-Deman.description: **EXAONE Forecast for Demand** is a time series foundation model (TSFM) built for demand forecasting. It keeps a general-domain backbone frozen and adapts it with a demand-aware adapter: five low-rank branches, one shared and one for each of the four demand classes (smooth, intermittent, erratic, lumpy), mixed by a router that reads eight scale-free statistics of the input series. classla/bcms-bertic-generator.description: * The name should resemble the facts (1) that the model was trained in Zagreb, Croatia, where diminutives ending in -ić (as in fotić, smajlić, hengić etc.) are very popular, and (2) that most surnames in the countries where these languages are spoken end in -ić (with diminutive etymology as well).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-es-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained on the es unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

sultan/BioM-BERT-PubMed-PMC-Large.description: The impact of design choices on the performance of biomedical language models recently has been a subject for investigation. In this paper, we empirically study biomedical domain adaptation with large transformer models using different design choices. We evaluate the performance of our pretrained models against other existing biomedical language models in the literature. Our results show that we achieve state-of-the-art results on several biomedical domain tasks despite using similar or less computational cost compared to other models in the literature. Our findings highlight the significant effect of design choices on improving the performance of biomedical language models.

thepowerfuldeez/imu1_base.description: This repository contains the IMU-1 Base model, a sample-efficient 430M parameter language model introduced in the paper [IMU-1: Sample-Efficient Pre-training of Small Language Models](https://huggingface.co/papers/2602.02522).

nabeelshan/distilbert-finetuned-agnews.description: This is a `distilbert-base-uncased` model fine-tuned for text classification on the **AG News** dataset. It classifies news headlines into one of four categories: **World**, **Sports**, **Business**, and **Sci/Tech**.

jetbabareal/Sabir-60M.description: **Sabır-60M**, sıfırdan Türkçe olarak eğitilmiş, yaklaşık **60 milyon parametreli**, kompakt bir dil modelidir. Adını, standart 'erken durdurma' kuralları yerine, eğitim verisindeki dilsel kalıpları derinlemesine öğrenene kadar "sabırla" eğitilmesinden alır.

ichangzii/pit2022-gpt2-124m.description: GPT-2 (124 M) trained **from scratch on only ≤2022 data**, giving a **certified lookahead-free knowledge cutoff**. Built for reliable time-sensitive evaluation (e.g. trading backtests) where the model must *not* know the future — the cutoff is clean **by construction** (never trained on post-2022 text), not by unlearning or suppression.

OpenLLM-France/Claire-7B-0.1.description: **Claire-7B-0.1 is a 7B parameter causal decoder-only model built by [LINAGORA](https://labs.linagora.com/) with the support of [OpenLLM-France](https://github.com/OpenLLM-France)** **adapted from [Falcon-7b](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/falcon-7b) on French conversational data.**

marin-community/delphi-3e19-1.4Bparams-3.description: A 1.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 3.5B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v1-base.description: A 353M-parameter decoder-only transformer, built and trained from scratch — no Hugging Face Trainer, raw PyTorch. This is the **base pretrained model**: strong English fluency, but not instruction-tuned. It completes text; it does not follow instructions or answer questions like a chatbot.

MaliosDark/Nexus-Erebus-50M.description: **Nexus-Erebus-50M** is a compact ~54M-parameter language model trained from scratch by **Ideoa Labs**, combining strong commonsense reasoning with genuine integer arithmetic ability at tiny scale.

IvmeLabs/Ivme-Conversate-N-v2-Instruct.description: 9,021,600 parameters. Standard decoder-only Transformer (tied embeddings, multi-head attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm) -- matching Ivme-Conversate-v2-Base's proven recipe exactly, deliberately with zero architectural novelty.

ChengsenWang/ChatTime-1-7B-Base.description: In this paper, we innovatively model time series as a foreign language and construct ChatTime, a unified framework for time series and text processing. As an out-of-the-box multimodal time series foundation model, ChatTime provides zero-shot forecasting capability and supports bimodal input/output for both time series and text. We design a series of experiments to verify the superior performance of ChatTime across multiple tasks and scenarios, and create four multimodal datasets to address data gaps. The experimental results demonstrate the potential and utility of ChatTime.

LIA-AvignonUniversity/IWSLT2022-tamasheq.description: This is a wav2vec 2.0 base model pre-trained on 243 hours of Tamasheq speech from the corpus presented in [Boito et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.05051). **This is not an ASR fine-tuned model. There is no vocabulary file.**

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-large-fi-150k.description: The large model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

codelion/sprog-9m.description: SPROG (Symbolic PROGram solver) is a 9.37M-parameter, from-scratch model that solves grade-school math word problems without any LLM at inference time.

molfe/molfe.description: This model was trained from scratch in the EveryonesLLM GPU workshop.

al24124/everyones-llm-workshop.description: This model was trained from scratch in the EveryonesLLM GPU workshop.

nicolasramos/odooclaw-light-1.2b-ft-mlx-.description: **An AI agent for Odoo that anyone can run — even on a Mac Mini with 8GB of RAM.**

CogACT/CogACT-Small.description: CogACT is a new advanced VLA architecture derived from VLM. Unlike previous works that directly repurpose VLM for action prediction by simple action quantization, we propose a componentized VLA architecture that has a specialized action module conditioned on VLM output. CogACT-Small employs a [DiT-S](https://github.com/facebookresearch/DiT) model as the action module.

DruidTheGetafix/apiary-7B-A1B.description: A 64-expert Mixture-of-Experts language model pretrained **from scratch** on 9.84B tokens of FineWeb-Edu in 5.24 hours on one 8xB200 node (41.9 B200 GPU-hours). Architecture is exactly `Qwen3MoeForCausalLM` (16 layers, d=2048, 16/8 heads, 64 experts top-8, expert size 1024, vocab 49152): 6.85B total / 1.21B active parameters. Code, training log and configs: https://github.com/Gaurav-Shah05/apiary

ibraheemmoosa/xlmindic-base-uniscript.description: This model is pretrained on a subset of the [OSCAR](https://huggingface.co/datasets/oscar) corpus spanning 14 Indo-Aryan languages. **Before pretraining this model we transliterate the text to [ISO-15919](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_15919) format using the [Aksharamukha](https://pypi.org/project/aksharamukha/) library.** A demo of Aksharamukha library is hosted [here](https://aksharamukha.appspot.com/converter) where you can transliterate your text and use it on our model on the inference widget.

AlexWortega/moe-600m-qwen3-upcycle.description: A ~600M-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model created by **sparse upcycling** of [Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base), then continually pretrained on [Ultra-FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/Ultra-FineWeb).

Welmia/welmia-2.0-103m-instruct.description: A 103M-parameter GPT-style language model (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings), pretrained from scratch on ~5B tokens (OpenWebText), then instruction-tuned on the Alpaca dataset.

wilsonramos/estiva-250m-ptbr-base.description: > Modelo **base experimental**, pré-treinado do zero para continuação de texto em > português brasileiro. Não é um modelo instruct/chat e não deve ser usado como > assistente, fonte de fatos ou em decisões de alto impacto.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Prot-v1-134M.description: The Mistral-Prot-v1-134M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative protein molecule model with 133.8M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for protein: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10M protein strings from the uniprot 50 database.

marin-community/delphi-2e20-4.3Bparams-6.description: A 4.3B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 6.6B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

fav-kky/wav2vec2-base-cs-80k-ClTRUS.description: **C**zech **l**anguage **TR**ransformer from **U**nlabeled **S**peech (ClTRUS) is a monolingual Czech Wav2Vec 2.0 base model pre-trained from 80 thousand hours of Czech speech.

Every model is a plain next-token predictor trained for 200 tokens per parameter. No instruction tuning, no safety training.

YOON1v/Apex-1-DPO.description: **A from-scratch 1.12B decoder-only LLM, pretrained on ~20B tokens and aligned with DPO.**

Lozens/Luna-Zero-110M.description: Luna Zero là mô hình ngôn ngữ decoder-only tiếng Việt khoảng 110M tham số, **train hoàn toàn từ số 0**; không fine-tune và không nạp trọng số pretrained của mô hình khác.

molfe/everyones-llm-workshop.description: This model was trained from scratch in the EveryonesLLM GPU workshop.

yumiao-dev/ym-translation.description: 从零预训练的 **54.4M 参数**中英双向翻译模型，面向**端侧离线**推理。 FLORES-200 devtest 中译英 **BLEU 17.50 / chrF++ 43.98**。

mlx-community/Qwen2-1.5B-4bit.description: The Model [mlx-community/Qwen2-1.5B-4bit](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen2-1.5B-4bit) was converted to MLX format from [Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B) using mlx-lm version **0.14.0**.

ProCreations/Booper-Big.description: Booper-Big is a from-scratch English MoE language model trained on the English split of `openbmb/Ultra-FineWeb`. It uses the standard Hugging Face Mixtral implementation.

sfanm/d12-pretrain-climbmix15B-dolmino5B.description: The loadable model at this repository's root is the terminal checkpoint of a 124M-parameter decoder trained from scratch on a 20B-token mixture: 75% ClimbMix web-scale pretraining text and 25% of the OLMo-3 Dolmino mid-training mix, interleaved uniformly through the whole run. The run consumed exactly 20,000,014,336 training tokens (38,147 optimizer iterations at 256 × 2,048), of which 15.0B came from ClimbMix and 5.0B from Dolmino.

REKS1337/ExtraAI-75M.description: ExtraAI is a **75,012,480-parameter**, English-only decoder Transformer trained from random initialization. Its 32k byte-level BPE tokenizer is also trained from scratch; no pretrained model or pretrained tokenizer is used.

alexandersdata/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-.description: The Model [ssdataanalysis/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct-mlx-8Bit](https://huggingface.co/ssdataanalysis/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct-mlx-8Bit) was converted to MLX format from [dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct) using mlx-lm version **0.29.1**.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-61m-a10m-v4.1-moe.description: The first **mixture-of-experts** TinyBrainBot and the first model of the v4.1 series. Every layer holds **16 experts** and each token is routed to **2** of them, so the model stores **60.6M** parameters but runs only **10.0M** per token (non-embedding; plus a 3.6M tied embedding).

Ismantic/Summer-0.5B-S0.description: Summer-0.5B-S0 is a **from-scratch** bilingual (Chinese/English) base model: 524,336,128 parameters, trained from random initialization on **14.6B tokens** with a self-trained 81,903-piece tokenizer.

sfanm/d12-pretrain-climbmix30B-dolmino10.description: The loadable model at this repository's root is the terminal checkpoint of a 124M-parameter decoder trained from scratch on a 40B-token mixture: 75% ClimbMix web-scale pretraining text and 25% of the OLMo-3 Dolmino mid-training mix, interleaved uniformly through the whole run. The run consumed exactly 40,000,028,672 training tokens (76,294 optimizer iterations at 256 × 2,048), of which 30.0B came from ClimbMix and 10.0B from Dolmino. It is the same recipe as `sfanm/d12-pretrain-climbmix15B-dolmino5B` with twice the data; that 20B-token model is the natural comparison point.

timothywong731/tim-360m-instruct-GGUF.description: GGUF quantizations of [TIM-360M-instruct](https://huggingface.co/timothywong731/tim-360m-instruct) for [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp), Ollama, and LM Studio. This is the **instruction-tuned** (SFT+DPO) chat model — the one to use for conversation.

j0no12/NeroT-29M.description: A 29M-parameter encoder-decoder Transformer for chat title generation, trained from scratch on Apple Silicon with MLX.

caikybaldo999/webcoder-pro.description: WebCoder-100M é um pequeno modelo decoder-only treinado **do zero** para geração e continuação de HTML, CSS e JavaScript.

christianrss/chris-gpt-2-124m.description: **Chris-GPT-2 124M** is a GPT-2-style causal language model trained from scratch on approximately **10 billion tokens from FineWeb-Edu**.

MineAITechnology/mine-o1-nano.description: **A 124M-parameter GPT-2-style language model, pre-trained from scratch in JAX/Flax NNX on a TPU v5e-8, then supervised fine-tuned in three rounds.**

Crawlnet/queen-v5.description: A small language model trained **from scratch**. **Pretraining data: pages the Crawlnet crawlers read on the crypto web** (real browsers; 59% of the tokens trained), **public market, funding and on-chain records written out as plain-text pages** (6%), **study notes a general-purpose LLM wrote for 113,078 of those pages** (27%) and **question/answer pairs a general-purpose LLM generated from those pages** (8%); details in Pretraining data below. **Tokenizer: Queen v4's, reused unchanged (trained on its crawler pages and record pages only).** No pretrained weights, no FineWeb, no other corpus. **Chat tuning: question/answer pairs generated by a general-purpose LLM from those pages (with the study notes' own Q&A), pairs cut from the pages and open-book conversations that answer from retrieved

adgw/Grendel-v0.1.description: **Grendel v0.1** is a **9.51 million parameter** English language model trained from scratch by **adgw**, followed by checkpoint averaging and supervised fine-tuning. It explores how much language understanding and practical task performance can fit into a very small decoder.

marin-community/delphi-2e20-6.7Bparams-4.description: A 6.7B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 4.2B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

ifx-pse-sys-ml/spark-13m-base.description: A **13.2M-parameter** English base language model, pretrained SmolLM-style on curated educational web + synthetic textbooks. A deliberately tiny model for small-model research, fast experimentation, and as a lightweight decoder backbone. ~10× smaller than SmolLM-135M.

kitsunejb/colpali-qdrant.description: > [!IMPORTANT] > This version of ColPali should be loaded with the `transformers 🤗` release, not with `colpali-engine`. > It was converted using the [`convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py` script](https://github.com/tonywu71/transformers/blob/21c1309637aee97ca4fb8eb3b31830913a0f99a5/src/transformers/models/colpali/convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py) > from the [`vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged`](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged) checkpoint.

thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-4bit.description: The Model [thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-4bit](https://huggingface.co/thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-4bit) was converted to MLX format from [vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-hf](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-hf) using mlx-lm version **0.0.3**.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-weak-filter-pt.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

jkminder/d12_optimized_286m_seed5.description: **Research artifact.** One of 24 base language models (3 sizes x 8 random seeds) trained to study seed-to-seed variance in language-model pretraining. Every model is a plain next-token predictor trained on the same data for 200 tokens per parameter. No instruction tuning, no safety training.

rohitnagareddy/AdbhutMOE.description: **AdbhutMOE** is a miniature, from-scratch Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) autoregressive language model based on the Mixtral architecture. This model was pre-trained on a sample of the `ag_news` dataset as part of a learning exercise to demonstrate the end-to-end pipeline for creating a sparse foundation model.

Badalt/fr-en-transformer-scratch.description: An encoder-decoder Transformer trained **from scratch** (no pretrained weights) for fr→en translation, built for a generalization study: in-domain vs long sentences vs an unseen domain (literature).

Kieran2828/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Q4_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B) for more details on the model.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

SII-GAIR-NLP/RIBOSPAN-1K-40.description: **RIBOSPAN-1K-40** is the **1,024-token, 40%-masking checkpoint** of the [RIBOSPAN](https://huggingface.co/SII-GAIR-NLP/RIBOSPAN-FM) RNA foundation model family.

KuanP/brain-uce-pilot-mix-v2.description: A pilot **Universal Cell Embedding (UCE)-style** model for brain single-cell RNA-seq, trained from scratch on "data mix v2" (the `v2026-09` corpus): **26 caches, 147,675,214 cells, 13 species, 43.1 % brain tissue**. It maps a cell's raw counts to a 512-d, L2-normalised embedding through a chromosome-ordered "cell sentence" of frozen ESM2 gene tokens.

kshitijthakkar/loggenix-moe-0.12B-A0.08B.description: **LoggenixMoE133M** is a small Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Causal Language Model trained **from scratch** on a custom dataset containing root cause analysis (RCA), code generation, and reasoning tasks.

AxionLab-Co/AxionMoE-350k-A250k.description: > **DeepSeek-V3 architecture scaled to /~344k total parameters (/~160k active/token) — runs entirely on CPU.**

oddadmix/Nawah-50M-Egyptian-18y-Persona.description: **Nawah (نواة, "nucleus/seed")** is a **~51.8M-parameter** Arabic small language model fine-tuned to speak with the voice of an **18-year-old Egyptian persona**. It is a proof-of-concept for training capable Arabic models **from scratch at tiny scale** — small enough to run on a CPU, yet coherent in Modern Standard Arabic with an Egyptian cultural frame.

antichronology/orthrus-mlm-6-track.description: 10M-param Mamba RNA encoder, dual-objective pretrained (contrastive + masked LM). Adds a per-position MLM head on top of the standard Orthrus backbone. Use `representation()` / `representation_unpooled()` for embeddings; use `predict_tokens()` for per-position nucleotide log-likelihoods (variant scoring).

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_jepa_rall_L1.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

Intel/bert-base-uncased-sparse-85-unstru.description: This model is a sparse pre-trained model that can be fine-tuned for a wide range of language tasks. The process of weight pruning is forcing some of the weights of the neural network to zero. Setting some of the weights to zero results in sparser matrices. Updating neural network weights does involve matrix multiplication, and if we can keep the matrices sparse while retaining enough important information, we can reduce the overall computational overhead. The term "sparse" in the title of the model indicates a ratio of sparsity in the weights; for more details, you can read [Zafrir et al. (2021)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.05754).

MCG-NJU/videomae-base-short-ssv2.description: VideoMAE model pre-trained on Something-Something-v2 for 800 epochs in a self-supervised way. It was introduced in the paper [VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Tong et al. and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VideoMAE).

ALM/wav2vec2-large-audioset.description: This model card presents information about pre-trained audio representation models released by ALM. These models are pre-trained on the full AudioSet dataset and are intended for general-purpose Audio Representation Learning (ARL) tasks.

Stanford-ILIAD/minivla-vq-bridge-prismat.description: This checkpoint is in a format that is compatible with the training script from the original [Prismatic VLMs project codebase](https://github.com/TRI-ML/prismatic-vlms), which the OpenVLA team built on top of to develop the OpenVLA model.

PursuitOfDataScience/argonne-3.0-base.description: Argonne 3.0-base is a 2.88B-parameter decoder-only transformer language model from the Argonne 3.x family. It is a *base* (foundation) checkpoint trained from scratch on FineWeb-derived web text and is intended as a starting point for further continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, or preference optimization.

Vcecca/mamba-50m.description: A ~50M-parameter [Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00752) (selective state-space) causal language model, **pretrained from scratch on English Wikipedia**. Mamba replaces the attention mechanism of a Transformer with a selective state-space layer, giving linear-time sequence processing instead of the quadratic cost of self-attention.

braindecode/duin-pretrained.description: braindecode-native re-host of the official **Du-IN** pretrained checkpoints (Zheng et al., NeurIPS 2024), converted so they load directly with [`braindecode.models.DuIN`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.DuIN.html).

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-e2e-strong-fil.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

trendmicro-ailab/Llama-Primus-Base.description: > TL;DR: Llama-Primus-Base is a foundation model based on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, continually pre-trained on Primus-Seed (0.2B) and Primus-FineWeb (2.57B). Primus-Seed is a high-quality, manually curated cybersecurity text dataset, while Primus-FineWeb consists of cybersecurity texts filtered from FineWeb, a refined version of Common Crawl. By pretraining on such a large-scale cybersecurity corpus, it achieves a 🚀**15.88%** improvement in aggregated scores across multiple cybersecurity benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of cybersecurity-specific pretraining.

postcn/Jeju-Standard_Korean_Translator.description: A compact (≈88M parameter) decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** for **bidirectional translation between the Jeju dialect (제주 방언, Jejueo) and Standard Korean (표준어)**. The model uses a Qwen3-style architecture with per-head QK-Norm and is served as a single checkpoint that handles both translation directions via a prefix control token.

Skyl4r-Ai/Skylar-390M-Cobol.description: **A 390M-parameter, from-scratch language model specialized in COBOL — small enough to run locally and on-prem, trained entirely in-house, that outperforms 7B general code models on COBOL code generation.**

jackf857/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-DPO-HH.description: `meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct` aligned with **Direct Preference Optimization** on Anthropic HH-RLHF, using a from-scratch DPO implementation — no TRL, no `DPOTrainer`, no Axolotl, no Lightning. The loss, sequence scoring, completion masking, reference handling and training loop are all explicit PyTorch.

jaswanthsanjay88/mara-small.description: A 24.6M parameter GPT trained **from scratch** (random init → coherent children's stories) on the TinyStories corpus. mlx-community/lil-bard.description: This model [mlx-community/lil-bard](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/lil-bard) was converted to MLX format from [N8Programs/lil-bard](https://huggingface.co/N8Programs/lil-bard) using mlx-lm version **0.31.3**.

Zaid-Lakdawala/ZL-300M.description: A ~300M-parameter decoder-only Transformer, **implemented entirely from scratch in PyTorch** (no `transformers` model code, no borrowed architecture) — tokenizer, RoPE attention, SwiGLU feed-forward, RMSNorm, the training loop, and generation were all hand-written for this project.

FrameXlabs/fragment-1.description: **A 9.0M-parameter System-One decision model.** Give it a **state** (any text) and **typed questions**; it returns **typed answers with calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass** — no autoregression, no text generation, no chain-of-thought, nothing to parse and nothing to hallucinate. Trained entirely from scratch on a 2-thread cloud CPU (own BPE tokenizer, own encoder, own RLCD loop — no pretrained weights, no GPU), which is the point: small enough to run anywhere, including a browser tab.

robloxianer/ShitpostGPT-10M.description: A 10M-parameter language model trained **from scratch** on one consumer GPU (RTX 3060 12GB) in about 33 minutes, to write Twitch chat, imageboard posts and Reddit shitposts. It is a toy: tiny, unfiltered and chaotic on purpose. Inspired by Codeically's "ChatGPT-2 on a potato" video.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-virus.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-virus Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA text model with 17.31M parameters x 8 experts = 138.5M parameters. It is derived from Mistral-7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using around 15071 viruses > 1kb. Virus genomes were split into 1kb sequences.

PursuitOfDataScience/argonne-3.5-base.description: Argonne 3.5-base is a 2.88B-parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch. It is the base (foundation) checkpoint of the Argonne 3.5 line and the successor to [argonne-3.0-base](https://huggingface.co/PursuitOfDataScience/argonne-3.0-base).

antichronology/orthrus-small-6-track.description: 1.3M-param compact Mamba RNA encoder, contrastive pretrained. 6-track input.

sofieneb/omni-large.description: **OMNI-L** is a 330M-parameter pathology vision encoder distilled from **10 state-of-the-art pathology foundation models** at once. Instead of compressing all teachers into a single CLS token (vanilla multi-teacher distillation), OMNI learns **one token per teacher**, together with a structured attention mask, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers and a per-teacher contrastive loss. This lets distillation keep improving as more teachers are added.

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_mae_rone_L1.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

kshitijthakkar/loggenix-moe-0.3B-A0.1B-e.description: **LoggenixMoE315M** is a 315M parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Causal Language Model trained **from scratch** on a multi-task dataset featuring **root cause analysis**, **code generation**, **instruction-following**, and **agentic reasoning tasks**.

cooler8/ZeliDesk-sLM-1B.description: > ⚠️ **Work in progress — pretraining at ~22% (4.5B / 20B tokens). Weights are intermediate and will be updated.** > This repository is updated continuously as training progresses. Intermediate checkpoints are pinned with git tags (e.g. `ckpt-step17000`) so any published state remains reproducible.

d0rj/diffusion-51M-base.description: A small English **masked diffusion base model**, trained from random initialization as part of [Tiny llm ablation](https://huggingface.co/collections/d0rj/tiny-llm-ablation-6aafca336122dd2c2868f923). This is the successfully trained **v2** checkpoint: **51,392,512 stored parameters**, **50,867,200 optimized parameters**, exactly **3,932,160,000 processed source tokens**.

Crawlnet/queen-v4.description: A small language model trained **from scratch**. **Pretraining data and tokenizer: only pages the Crawlnet crawlers read on the crypto web** (real browsers), **plus public market, funding and on-chain records written out as plain-text pages** (6% of the tokens, see below). No pretrained weights, no FineWeb, no other corpus. **Chat tuning: question/answer pairs generated by a general-purpose LLM from those pages** (details below). Expect a dumb, funny, confidently-wrong model; that is the point.

Ryosei-Akatsuka/psdel-lm-20m.description: ~20.3M-parameter English causal LM: 12 layers in a 3:1 interleave of **Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)** and **full attention (MQA)**, NoPE, ReLU^2 FFN, tied embedding head. Trained **from scratch** on 1B tokens of FineWeb/FineWeb-Edu, then instruction-tuned on `databricks/databricks-dolly-15k`.

alibaba-pai/pai-dkplm-financial-base-zh.description: For Chinese natural language processing in specific domains, we provide **Chinese DKPLM (Decomposable Knowledge-enhanced Pre-trained Language Model)** for the financial domain named **pai-dkplm-financial-base-zh**, from our AAAI 2021 paper named **DKPLM: Decomposable Knowledge-enhanced Pre-trained Language Model for Natural Language Understanding**.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-strong-filter-.description: This repository contains the **Deep Ignorance** model suite, introduced in the paper: [**Deep Ignorance: Filtering Pretraining Data Builds Tamper-Resistant Safeguards into Open-Weight LLMs**](https://huggingface.co/papers/2508.06601).

dovcharenko/veda-1b-uk16k-pretrain.description: **Veda** (Веда — знання, священне знання) is a ~1.10B parameter decoder-only Transformer trained as a **base pretraining checkpoint** (not instruction-tuned yet). Repo: `dovcharenko/veda-1b-uk16k-pretrain`

AbdulRahmanIqbal/babylm-baseline-10ep.description: Winning configuration from a systematic 15-way ablation of common training optimizations (mixed precision, Flash Attention, curriculum learning, dynamic batching, post-training INT8 quantization) on the BabyLM Strict-Small track. The plain FP32 baseline — no optimizations — won outright at a 10-epoch budget, statistically tied with FP16+Flash Attention.

It is the baseline for later versions.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-e2e-strong-fil.description: This model is presented in the paper [Deep Ignorance: Filtering Pretraining Data Builds Tamper-Resistant Safeguards into Open-Weight LLMs](https://huggingface.co/papers/2508.06601).

We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

KuanP/brain-uce-pilot-mix-v3.description: A pilot **Universal Cell Embedding (UCE)-style** model for brain single-cell RNA-seq, trained from scratch on "data mix v3": a **designed mixture** over the `v2026-09` corpus (26 caches, 147,675,214 cells, 13 species) that re-weights sampling toward brain tissue (68 % of training samples) and under-represented species (human 60 %, mouse 23 %, the eight smallest species 3-20x their uniform share). It maps a cell's raw counts to a 512-d, L2-normalised embedding through a chromosome-ordered "cell sentence" of frozen ESM2 gene tokens. Its sibling `KuanP/brain-uce-pilot-mix-v2` was trained on the same corpus with uniform sampling and the same number of training samples.

mvbalaji/1111AI-Tamil1B-Instruct.description: A **1.24B-parameter Tamil-first language model trained from scratch** — not a multilingual model adapted to Tamil, and not an English model with Tamil tokens bolted on. Tokenizer, corpus and weights are all Tamil-native from the start.

Opflare1144/groundnote-239m.description: A 239M-parameter Llama-style decoder that turns a doctor–patient conversation into a sectioned clinical note: Chief Complaint, HPI, Past Medical History, Allergies, Physical Exam, Assessment, Plan.

matt-hans93/ups-tools-qwen2.5-7b.description: UPS Tool-Use Qwen2.5 7B is a QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct for generating structured Hermes function-calling payloads for a UPS MCP server. It maps natural-language shipping and logistics requests to 18 UPS MCP tools covering tracking, rating, shipment creation, pickup workflows, address validation, paperless documents, landed cost, and location lookup.

tunib/electra-ko-en-small.description: We release several new versions of the [ELECTRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.10555) model, which we name TUNiB-Electra. There are two motivations. First, all the existing pre-trained Korean encoder models are monolingual, that is, they have knowledge about Korean only. Our bilingual models are based on the balanced corpora of Korean and English. Second, we want new off-the-shelf models trained on much more texts. To this end, we collected a large amount of Korean text from various sources such as blog posts, comments, news, web novels, etc., which sum up to 100 GB in total.

It is derived from Jamba model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using **100kb** DNA sequences from the hg38 human genome assembly. stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-600000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

facebook/wav2vec2-conformer-rope-large.description: Wav2Vec2 Conformer with rotary position embeddings, pretrained on 960 hours of Librispeech on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

AnReu/math_pretrained_bert.description: This repository contains our pre-trained BERT-based model. It was initialised from BERT-base-cased and further pre-trained on Math StackExchange in three different stages. We also added more LaTeX tokens to the tokenizer to enable a better tokenization of mathematical formulas. This model is not yet fine-tuned on a specific task.

Gaolaboratory/iona-base-200m.description: Iona is a transformer encoder foundation model for tandem mass spectra (MS/MS). It treats each centroided peak as a token and learns how peaks relate to each other through a per-head attention bias over the signed m/z difference (Δm/z) between every pair of peaks.

Gaolaboratory/iona-contrastive-50m.description: iona-contrastive-50m embeds tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) so that spectra of the same peptide and charge state lie close together. It is the Iona 50m encoder fine-tuned with a supervised contrastive objective, and is suited to spectrum-to-spectrum search and clustering.

ucrelnlp/PyMUSAS-Neural-Multilingual-Bas.description: A fine tuned 307 Million (307M) parameter Multilingual ModernBERT architecture semantic tagger. The tagger outputs semantic tags at the token level from the [USAS tagset](https://ucrel.lancs.ac.uk/usas/usas_guide.pdf).

orzattyholdings/Sylor-S2-Pro.description: **Sylor S2 Pro** es un modelo de lenguaje masivo Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) desarrollado por **Orzatty** (Puerto Ordaz, Venezuela). Está optimizado para la resolución autónoma de problemas de ingeniería de software, automatización de entornos de terminal y orquestación de herramientas mediante el protocolo **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-plasmi.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-138M-plasmid Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA text model with 17.31M parameters x 8 experts = 138.5M parameters. It is derived from Mistral-7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 82367 plasmid genomes > 10kb.

RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-DNA-v1-37M-Atha.description: The ModernBERT-DNA-v1-37M-Athaliana Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 37M parameters. It is derived from ModernBERT model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10kb DNA sequences from 7 A. thaliana genome assemblies (from https://1001genomes.org/data/MPIPZ/MPIPZJiao2020/releases/current/full_set/).

ATH-MaaS/Marco-LLM-SEA.description: Marco-LLM-SEA is a series of enhanced language models specifically fine-tuned for Southeast Asian languages, including Indonesian, Malaysian, Thai, Vietnamese, and other regional languages. This repository contains the 7B Marco-LLM-SEA base language model.

nahid-hub/BnLM-C-66m.description: **BnLM-C** is a 66M-parameter Bangla-specific pretrained language model, one of three models in the **BnLM** suite (**B**e**n**gali **L**anguage **M**odel) introduced alongside the **BLUGE** benchmark and **B-CORE** pretraining corpus. BnLM-F is among the smallest Bangla language models available, while ranking among the most accurate and computationally efficient — delivering state-of-the-art results at a fraction of the size and compute of multilingual alternatives. BnLM models are pretrained from scratch on Bangla text using the Masked Language Modeling (MLM) objective, and are designed for efficient, low-resource NLP without relying on large multilingual models. BnLM-C is the most compact variant in the suite, built for deployment under tighter compute and latency constraints.

Squeal-Studio/squeal_ai_8m-base.description: squeal_ai_8m-base is a compact ~8M parameter language model pretrained from scratch on Russian-language text. It belongs to the squeal_ai_ model family by Squeal Studio.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-strong-filter-.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

Gaolaboratory/iona-base-50m.description: Iona is a transformer encoder foundation model for tandem mass spectra (MS/MS). RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-DNA-v1-117M-Ath.description: The ModernBERT-DNA-v1-117M-Athaliana Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 117M parameters. It is derived from ModernBERT model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10kb DNA sequences from 7 A. thaliana genome assemblies (from https://1001genomes.org/data/MPIPZ/MPIPZJiao2020/releases/current/full_set/).

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8-Q4_0.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. daslab-testing/CloverLM.description: CloverLM is a **4-billion-parameter** dense decoder-only language model pretrained entirely in **native NVFP4** precision using the [Quartet II](https://github.com/IST-DASLab/Quartet-II) algorithm. Trained on the [ClimbMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.13161) data mixture for approximately **310 billion tokens** on 8 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in roughly 8 days, CloverLM reaches zero-shot accuracy competitive with OPT-175B on a standard evaluation suite — at a fraction of the cost.

cmpatino/nanowhale-100m-base.description: A small ~110M parameter language model implementing the **DeepSeek-V4 architecture** from scratch. This is the pretrained base model — see [cmpatino/nanowhale-100m](https://huggingface.co/cmpatino/nanowhale-100m) for the SFT/chat version.

Lernex/Metis-1.5-base.description: **Metis-1.5-base** is an **898M-parameter (≈340M active/token) single-latent Mixture-of-Experts** language model, **pretrained from scratch on 50B tokens** of curated, decontaminated English text. It was trained end to end in **pure JAX on a single TPU v6e-8** with a fully custom training stack — no PyTorch, no Megatron, no Hugging Face Trainer.

razor5050/SmolGuru-80M-512.description: This public repo is being prepared for an ~80M parameter LLaMA-style chatbot trained from scratch with the `HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct` tokenizer.

glassbox/gpt-alpha-bg-91m.description: A 91.26M-parameter decoder-only GPT trained from scratch on Bulgarian text, with no pretrained initialization, in a nanoGPT-style codebase. Its measured strength is judging Bulgarian fluency by perplexity: on error/correction pairs it is statistically on par with Gemini, offline, on a CPU.

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p1-moe-4e-top1.description: Decoder-only transformer trained from scratch for Vietnamese/Japanese -> English translation on `belumind/en-vi-ja-curated-500k-triplets` (4 epochs, 139.3M input tokens).

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p1-moe-4e-top2.description: Decoder-only transformer trained from scratch for Vietnamese/Japanese -> English translation on `belumind/en-vi-ja-curated-500k-triplets` (4 epochs, 139.3M input tokens).

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p1-moe-1shared-3routed.description: Decoder-only transformer trained from scratch for Vietnamese/Japanese -> English translation on `belumind/en-vi-ja-curated-500k-triplets` (4 epochs, 139.3M input tokens).

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p2-mars.description: The Part 1 dense configuration (6 layers, d_model 512, MLP 2048, 35.3M parameters, context 512) pretrained from scratch for exactly one epoch (36.96M tokens) on `browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus` with a from-scratch implementation of **MARS**, at the best peak learning rate of a sweep.

sraivante/sans-llm-10m-pilot.description: > **Status: pilot / proof-of-concept. Not a final model.** > This is the first end-to-end run of a tiny Sanskrit language model built from scratch on a laptop CPU. > It exists to validate the pipeline (scrape → clean → tokenize → train → sample), not to be useful yet. > Expect grammatical-looking but meaningless Sanskrit, repetition loops, and stray artefacts. See *Known issues*.

Undi95/Mistral-11B-Airoboros-RP-v1.description: Mistral-7B and airoboros-mistral2.2-7b glued together and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

lucyknada/Mistral-7B-v0.1-exl2-2bpw.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

OpenLLM-France/Claire-7B-EN-0.1.description: **Claire-7B-EN-0.1 is a 7B parameter causal decoder-only model built by [LINAGORA](https://labs.linagora.com/) with the support of [OpenLLM-France](https://github.com/OpenLLM-France)** **adapted from [Falcon-7b](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/falcon-7b) on English conversational data.**

ATH-MaaS/Marco-LLM-AR-V4.description: Marco-LLM-AR is a series of enhanced language models specifically fine-tuned for common languages used in the Arab world, including Modern Standard Arabic and several dialects. This repository contains the 7B Marco-LLM-AR base language model.

onnx-community/Qwen1.5-0.5B-ONNX.description: This is an ONNX version of [Qwen/Qwen1.5-0.5B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen1.5-0.5B). It was automatically converted and uploaded using [this Hugging Face Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/onnx-community/convert-to-onnx).

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8-Q4_K.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8) for more details on the model.

pvlabs/Chytrej1-90M-Base.description: The first model in the Chytrej series. A fully custom pretrained language model built from scratch on the LLaMA architecture.

Hippocrene/MiniLLM-0.1B.description: A small (~109M parameters) causal language model pretrained from scratch on [OpenWebText](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Skylion007/openwebtext).

sabari2005/cyberslm-33m-base.description: A **33.5M-parameter cybersecurity-focused small language model**, pretrained **from scratch** on a ~745 MB curated corpus (cybersecurity, computer fundamentals, programming, general English) with a custom 32k SentencePiece BPE tokenizer. Trained on a single NVIDIA L40S.

ashrafs1/nanogpt-3000.description: A 124M-parameter GPT-2-class causal language model built from scratch in PyTorch and trained on FineWeb-10B.

VertexResearch/Vertex-0.6-100M-1024-ctx-.description: Base (text-completion) model of the Vertex 0.6 family by Vertex Research, pretrained from scratch on **10.01B tokens** at **1024 context**. This is the raw pretrain checkpoint: no instruction tuning, no chat alignment. Instruct and reasoning variants (with extended context) are released separately.

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_mae_rone_L4.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_mae_r12cm_L2.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

facebook/wav2vec2-large-it-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) large model pretrained on the it unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

mrm8488/biomedtra-small-es.description: **BIOMEDtra** (small) is an Electra like model (discriminator in this case) trained on [Spanish Biomedical Crawled Corpus](https://zenodo.org/record/5510033#.Yhdk1ZHMLJx).

zanelim/singbert-large-sg.description: SingBert Large - Bert for Singlish (SG) and Manglish (MY).

LeBenchmark/wav2vec-FR-1K-Female-base.description: LeBenchmark provides an ensemble of pretrained wav2vec2 models on different French datasets containing spontaneous, read, and broadcasted speech.

LeBenchmark/wav2vec-FR-1K-Male-large.description: LeBenchmark provides an ensemble of pretrained wav2vec2 models on different French datasets containing spontaneous, read, and broadcasted speech.

Siddharth63/pubmedul2-mini-nl8.description: **PubMedUL2** and **MedUL2** are a family of **domain-specific UL2/T5-style encoder–decoder language models** pretrained on large-scale biomedical and medical corpora using the **UL2 (Mixture-of-Denoisers)** objective.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-xlarge-fi-150k.description: The x-large model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

nazdef/1gpu-llm-small-en-it-base.description: This repository is the current **ready-to-use base release** for the `1gpu-llm` small EN/IT family.

aspect-ratio-scaling/mhc-lr2e-3-llama-20.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 3800. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-500.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 9500. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

radlab/polish-gpt2-medium-v2.description: This is the polish gpt2 model in medium architecture.

Dl26/Veyra-Embed-125M.description: `Veyra-Embed-125M` is a from-scratch sentence embedding model developed by **Dl26**. It maps text into normalized dense vectors for sentence similarity, semantic search, clustering, and retrieval-style experiments.

cjnielson44/grizzly-mini-transformer.description: Grizzly Mini Transformer v2 is a second iteration of my locally trained GPT-style language model, rebuilt from scratch using Apple MLX for native Metal GPU training on Apple Silicon. Named after my dog, Grizzly.

Saliltrehan7/slm-125m-base.description: A 125M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch on a curated legal and financial corpus. Built on the LLaMA architecture with a custom 16K byte-level BPE tokenizer.

SmallScale/Simple-Stories-Hindi-10M.description: A **11.45M parameter** decoder-only Transformer language model trained **from scratch** on **2.11 million Hindi simple stories**. The model generates coherent, creative, and grammatically sound Hindi stories given a short text prompt.

richarddzh/tiny-qwen3-30m-zh.description: Tiny Qwen3 30M Chinese is a 29.57M-parameter Chinese causal language model trained from scratch on the [Chinese Small LM Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/richarddzh/chinese-small-lm-corpus). It is a compact educational model for experimenting with tokenizer training, language-model pretraining, checkpointing, and Chinese text generation in the Hugging Face ecosystem.

geodesic-research/control-pretraining-30.description: The treatment arm's base model: the same architecture, curriculum, schedule and token budget as the baseline, trained on the same corpora with AI-scheming literature removed: every document carrying a canary string or scored >= 2 by the gpt-5-mini cost gate, as annotated in sudoers/control-pretraining-filter-annotated at revision eab743dd. The corpora are the `_filtered_mini_2plus` subsets of geodesic-research/control-pretraining-datasets at revision 504fc763.

Crocolil/Chiikamini.description: Petit modele de langage **decoder-only** (3.94 M parametres) ecrit from scratch en PyTorch, pour tester des applications locales sans charger un vrai LLM en RAM. **Ce n'est pas un modele destine a un usage reel** : il complete du code de facon plausible mais ne raisonne pas.

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p1-dense.description: Decoder-only transformer trained from scratch for Vietnamese/Japanese -> English translation on `belumind/en-vi-ja-curated-500k-triplets` (4 epochs, 139.3M input tokens).

yennik16/text-to-stl-part-classifier.description: Stage 1 of a text-to-STL pipeline. It reads a plain-English description of a simple mechanical part and decides which of five part families it is: **pipe_gasket, washer, bracket, rect_container, cyl_container**. The predicted type then selects the schema the [parameter extractor](https://huggingface.co/yennik16/text-to-stl-parameter-extractor) fills in.

navthings/airgpt-night.description: a 40M param model trained from scratch in eight hours on a macbook air (m5, 16gb, no fan) with [airgpt](https://github.com/navthings/airgpt). the air didn't throttle once the whole night.

VishwamAI/vishwamai-base-v0.description: Mixture-of-experts decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** (no distillation, no pre-trained weights) with JAX / Flax / Optax and a SentencePiece tokenizer (English, Hindi, Telugu).

mach-kernel/ecu-pilot-q4km.description: Quantized GGUF of [ecu-pilot-fp16](https://huggingface.co/mach-kernel/ecu-pilot-fp16) — a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B for structured tool calling against project metadata via MCP.

lschaffer/qwen2.5-3b-weathersensorsmcp-o.description: > ⚠️ **This model is trained for the weathersensorsmcp MCP server.** > It is optimised for structured MCP tool-call generation and is not intended > to be a general-purpose assistant.

beatsprom/qwen-stateless-mcp-agent-2026.description: This model repository contains the official LoRA adapter and Ollama Modelfile fine-tuned on the **Enterprise Stateless MCP & Agent Evaluation Suite (2026)**. It specializes in zero-defect, deterministic execution of Model Context Protocol (MCP 2026 JSON-RPC 2.0) tool calls across 25 production infrastructure domains.

tbilisi-ai-lab/kona2-12B-Base.description: **Kona2-12B-Base** is a 12-billion parameter base language model optimized for Georgian language understanding and generation. It is built by continue-pretraining [Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407) on approximately **30 billion tokens** of Georgian/English data with expanded Georgian vocabulary.

marin-community/delphi-3e18-358Mparams-1.description: A 358M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 1.6B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

This release is the **base** checkpoint at the end of pretraining — instruction-tuned variants will follow under separate model names.

abhishekai/slm-125m-legal-base.description: A 125M-parameter Llama-architecture base model pretrained from scratch on a legal- and finance-heavy corpus (US case law, SEC filings, and a slice of FineWeb-Edu).

SereneC/AHA-WAM-Pretrained.description: This repository releases RoboCOIN-pretrained checkpoints for **AHA-WAM** and **Fast-WAM**. These checkpoints are intended as initialization weights for real-robot fine-tuning and deployment experiments with the public AHA-WAM codebase.

Ericu950/Stoicheia-doc_clean.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

0arch-io/kisoku-1.6b.description: Kisoku 1.6B is a base (not chat) language model pretrained from random initialization by one person, Joseph Rodriguez at 0ARCH, on a TPU v4-32 from Google's TPU Research Cloud. It has 1,600,749,056 parameters, saw about 0.5 trillion tokens of pretraining text (524.4B including the long-context phases), and was extended to 64K tokens of context. All numbers below come from the technical report draft (draft 4, 2026-10-07) and were measured by me on my own hardware.

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_jepa_rone_L16.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking_jepa_r6cm_L33.description: Pretrained EEG encoder from the paper *What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?* ([arXiv:2609.33487](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487) · [website](https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking) · [code](https://github.com/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking) · [all 58 models](https://huggingface.co/collections/PierreGtch/eeg-fm-masking-6ab912b6a03bba1348fc7366)).

dccuchile/albert-large-spanish.description: This is an [ALBERT](https://github.com/google-research/albert) model trained on a [big spanish corpora](https://github.com/josecannete/spanish-corpora). The model was trained on a single TPU v3-8 with the following hyperparameters and steps/time: - LR: 0.000625 - Batch Size: 512 - Warmup ratio: 0.003125 - Warmup steps: 12500 - Goal steps: 4000000 - Total steps: 1450000 - Total training time (aprox): 42 days.

jcblaise/electra-tagalog-base-uncased-di.description: **Deprecation Notice** This model is deprecated. New Filipino Transformer models trained with a much larger corpora are available. Use [`jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-base`](https://huggingface.co/jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-base) or [`jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-large`](https://huggingface.co/jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-large) instead for better performance.

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-0-cased-d.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

claudios/cubert-20210711-Python-512.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_512](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_512). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 512 token context window on the Python BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

AILabTUL/mELECTRA.description: mELECTRA is an [Electra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.10555)-based model pretrained on a diverse multilingual corpus. It supports multiple languages, including **Swedish (SE), Slovenian (SL), Slovak (SK), Portuguese (PT), Polish (PL), Norwegian (NO), Italian (IT), Croatian (HR), French (FR), English (EN), Danish (DK), German (DE), and Czech (CZ)**. The model can be fine-tuned for various NLP tasks such as text classification, named entity recognition, and masked token prediction.

dstilesr/glotlid-pretrained-roberta.description: This model was pretrained using Masked Language Modeling (MLM) objective on multilingual text data.

damjanzimbakov/qwen3-1.7b-macedonian-pre.description: This model is a continued-pretraining checkpoint of Qwen3-1.7B on Macedonian text.

Gaolaboratory/iona-base-100m.description: Iona is a transformer encoder foundation model for tandem mass spectra (MS/MS). It treats each centroided peak as a token and learns how peaks relate to each other through a per-head attention bias over the signed m/z difference (Δm/z) between every pair of peaks.

dolphinteam/OpenWhistle-BioClust.description: `dolphinteam/OpenWhistle-BioClust` provides a Wav2Vec2 audio backbone pretrained from scratch on bottlenose dolphin whistle recordings using native Fairseq on three NVIDIA L40S GPUs at Bioclust.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V5.7-Mini.description: SykoLLM-V5.7-Mini, sıfırdan (from scratch) eğitilmiş, Türkçe ve İngilizce destekli, kod anlama kapasitesine sahip küçük ölçekli bir dil modelidir. Phi-3 mimarisi temel alınarak özel BPE tokenizer ile geliştirilmiştir.

Ethangou/attention-residuals-100M-baseli.description: This is the 100M baseline checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a standard Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with standard residual connections, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

tako080614/evex-4.description: ある Discord サーバーのログだけから**ゼロから**学習した日本語の会話モデル。 既存の重みからの派生ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部このサーバーのために作ってある。

ajaxdavis/alpha-er.description: **alpha-er** (二, *èr* — "two") is a 100M-parameter language model trained end to end on a **from-scratch GPU stack**: our own ioctl driver, memory manager, command channels, sm_86 SASS assembler and kernel IR. **No CUDA, no cuBLAS, no vendor runtime** was involved in training — every matrix multiply ran on hand-written machine code.

OpceanAI/PASITA.description: A **decoder-only language model trained 100% from scratch** (no base model), specialized in a single task: converting **plain text into valid Markdown while preserving information**.

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p2-lion.description: The Part 1 dense configuration (6 layers, d_model 512, MLP 2048, 35.3M parameters, context 512) pretrained from scratch for exactly one epoch (36.96M tokens) on `browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus` with a from-scratch implementation of **Lion**, at the best peak learning rate of a sweep.

marin-community/delphi-3e18-273Mparams-2.description: A 273M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 2.2B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-1.9Bparams-7.description: A 1.9B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 7.4B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

PommesPeter/prism-qwen25-extra-siglip-22.description: This model is trained on the Llava-1.5-Instruct dataset. The official [MiniVLA](https://github.com/Stanford-ILIAD/openvla-mini) model uses a **single vision encoder (Siglip)**, which is the key difference.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_without_metadata_3b_st.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

RameshRathod/ego-153m-modern.description: Ego-153M-Modern is a **153M-parameter decoder-only Transformer** trained **from scratch** as a hands-on exploration of modern LLM architecture, optimization, and deployment workflows.

Sakatepon/Brujula-15M.description: The **tiny champion** of the Brújula family — a **15.5M-parameter** decoder-only language model, trained *entirely on a single consumer GPU* (one Intel Arc B580, ~5h16m) from scratch on [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu). *Brújula* ("compass" in Spanish) is a minimal DeepSeek-style architecture: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) + RoPE + SquaredReLU FFN, tied embeddings, hybrid **Muon + AdamW** optimizer.

Jvachier/punctuation-casing-en-7m.description: A small transformer that **restores punctuation and casing** in lowercase, unpunctuated English text such as voice-note or speech-to-text output:

ajesujoba/AfriHuBERT-xlarge.description: This is a 1B parameter multilingual self-supervised speech encoder based on the English HuBERT-XL model, facebook/hubert-xlarge-ll60k. We performed continued pretraining through multilingual adaptive finetuning (MAFT) on over 10,000 hours of African language data aggregated from various sources.

OpenLLM-France/Claire-7B-Apache-0.1.description: **Claire-7B-Apache-0.1 is a 7B parameter causal decoder-only model built by [LINAGORA](https://labs.linagora.com/) and [OpenLLM-France](https://github.com/OpenLLM-France)** **adapted from [Falcon-7b](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/falcon-7b) on French conversational open data.**

timpal0l/Llama-3-8B-flashback-v1.description: Llama-3-8B-flashback-v1 is a continuation of the pretraining process for the base meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B model, utilizing 2 251 233 forum threads from the Swedish website https://www.flashback.org/. Which is rougly 40GB of text. It is a full finetune for three epochs.

EZPK/Claire-Mistral-7B-0.1-Q4_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`OpenLLM-France/Claire-Mistral-7B-0.1`](https://huggingface.co/OpenLLM-France/Claire-Mistral-7B-0.1) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/OpenLLM-France/Claire-Mistral-7B-0.1) for more details on the model.

jacobcarajo/CodeQwen1.5-7B-Q5_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`Qwen/CodeQwen1.5-7B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/CodeQwen1.5-7B) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/CodeQwen1.5-7B) for more details on the model.

Ffftdtd5dtft/Qwen2-0.5B-IQ1_S-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B) for more details on the model.

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8-Q8_0.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-FP8) for more details on the model.

SandLogicTechnologies/gemma-2-9b-GGUF.description: Gemma-2-9B is a pretrained large language model developed by Google as part of the second generation of the Gemma model family. It is designed as a general-purpose foundation model capable of strong language understanding, reasoning, and text generation across a wide range of tasks.
