y-somnolence123/Qwen2-0.5B.description: Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters, including a Mixture-of-Experts model. This repo contains the 0.5B Qwen2 base language model.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-1.4Bparams-3.description: A 1.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 35.2B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-669Mparams-7.description: A 669M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 77.9B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

BiliSakura/RSBuilding-Swin-T.description: HuggingFace Transformers version of RSBuilding Swin-Tiny model, converted from MMDetection/MMSegmentation format.

pafos-ai/biotitan.description: **First application of the TITANS architecture to single-cell genomics, enabling test-time adaptive gene embeddings.**

helmo/tabum-v1.1.description: A small tabular in-context-learning foundation model: **14.31M parameters**, zero-shot classification and regression on any table, native missing-value handling, up to **100 classes** and **2,000 features**. MIT licensed, built clean-room (no third-party model code).

FishCaduceus/FishCaduceus-28L-1024.description: `FishCaduceus-28L-1024` is a fish-specific DNA language model in the **FishCaduceus** family. It was pretrained on fish genomic sequences using a masked language modeling objective and is intended for nucleotide-level representation learning, transfer learning, and sequence-based analyses in fish genomics.

CorteriIntelligence/TimeTron-v2-33M.description: A **33.5M-parameter** time-series foundation model, distilled from **Chronos-2** by **latent-space knowledge distillation** — the student matches the teacher's internal representations rather than its forecasts.

DCU-NLP/electra-base-irish-cased-discrim.description: [gaELECTRA](https://aclanthology.org/2022.lrec-1.511/) is an ELECTRA model trained on 7.9M Irish sentences. For more details, including the hyperparameters and pretraining corpora used please refer to our paper. For fine-tuning this model on a token classification task, e.g. Named Entity Recognition, use the discriminator model.

ViktorAlm/electra-base-norwegian-uncased.description: Trained on Oscar + wikipedia + opensubtitles + some other data I had with the awesome power of TPUs(V3-8)

jcblaise/electra-tagalog-small-uncased-d.description: **Deprecation Notice** This model is deprecated. New Filipino Transformer models trained with a much larger corpora are available. Use [`jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-base`](https://huggingface.co/jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-base) or [`jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-large`](https://huggingface.co/jcblaise/roberta-tagalog-large) instead for better performance.

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-1000000-c.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

Xenova/unispeech-sat-base.description: https://huggingface.co/microsoft/unispeech-sat-base with ONNX weights to be compatible with Transformers.js.

facebook/hiera-base-224-mae-hf.description: **Hiera** is a _hierarchical_ vision transformer that is fast, powerful, and, above all, _simple_. It was introduced in the paper [Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without the Bells-and-Whistles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00989/) and outperforms the state-of-the-art across a wide array of image and video tasks _while being much faster_.

CleverShovel/rubert-tiny2-tnved-v5.description: <!-- Provide a quick summary of what the model is/does. -->

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_country_with_.description: This repo contains the url country 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_with_metadata.description: This repo contains the url 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_country_with_meta.description: This repo contains the country 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

laion/open-sci-ref-1.7b-nemotron-hq-mv_r.description: Base model. Blend is **42.06% MV reasoning+instruct / 57.94% Nemotron-CC**, matching MixtureVitae's own measured reasoning share (175.15B reasoning of 416.45B full MV, both in GPT-NeoX). At 100B that is 0.24 epochs over the reasoning subset — no data repetition.

Asilarkness/cascade-1b-bpe-logic.description: Public experimental causal language model with approximately 1.04B parameters. It uses the open 32k Mistral tokenizer, byte-derived initialization from Cascade-1B-Logic, four local token layers, entropy-guided token patches, and one active eight-layer core path out of three per batch.

0ldev/Lara-350M.description: A 350M parameter LLaMA-style language model pretrained from scratch on a custom corpus. This is the **base pretrained checkpoint** — it has not yet been instruction-tuned or fine-tuned with any persona.

aspect-ratio-scaling/mhc-lr2e-3-llama-20.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 3800. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

Efe-Tatar/base-100m-fineweb-edu.description: A 100M-parameter decoder-only language model whose architecture, tokenizer, data pipeline and training loop were written from scratch in PyTorch, then exported to the standard `LlamaForCausalLM` format. Code, tests and training logs: https://github.com/efe-tatar/transformer-pytorch

jasonacox/nanochat-560M-rl.description: Final model with reinforcement learning (GRPO). Improved performance on math problems and reduced hallucinations.

sathishphdai/cybersecurity-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Cybersecurity domain data. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

rockerritesh/smollm2-135m-fineweb-edu-20.description: A **135M** parameter language model trained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu.

helloadhavan/llara1.0-100M-base.description: Llara is a 91.4M parameter autoregressive language model trained from scratch on English web text. It follows the GPT-2 Small architecture and is trained entirely from random initialisation — no pretrained weights, no distillation, no fine-tuning of an existing model. but it does use GPT's tokenizer

TobiasLogic/TextModel-v1.description: A 122.7M parameter language model trained from scratch. TextModel-v1 is a Llama-style decoder-only transformer, built to be a strong, honestly-evaluated entry on small language model benchmarks, in particular GCI-Bench.

richarddzh/tiny-qwen3-30m.description: Tiny Qwen3 30M is a 29.57M-parameter English causal language model trained from scratch on the [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) dataset. It is intended as a compact educational model for studying tokenizer training, pretraining, checkpointing, and text generation with the Hugging Face ecosystem.

TightX/code-llm-435m-sft.description: The instruction-tuned version of the 435M from-scratch code model whose pretrained weights are in [`TightX/code-llm-435m-base`](https://huggingface.co/TightX/code-llm-435m-base). Same architecture, same 32,000-token byte-level BPE vocabulary, same 1,024-token context — only the weights differ. It reads a plain-English request (*"write a function that checks whether a number is prime"*) or continues a bare `def` signature, and writes Python.

kinglacto/anlp-a2-p2-adamw.description: The Part 1 dense configuration (6 layers, d_model 512, MLP 2048, 35.3M parameters, context 512) pretrained from scratch for exactly one epoch (36.96M tokens) on `browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus` with a from-scratch implementation of **AdamW**, at the best peak learning rate of a sweep.

zeroae/calliope-snac-4b-base-4k.description: Stage-1 **multilingual SNAC prior** for the Calliope text-to-speech project — a continued-pretrain of [`nvidia/Nemotron-H-4B-Base-8K`](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-H-4B-Base-8K) with the vocabulary augmented by 12,288 SNAC codec tokens and a slot router that enforces the codec's `C·M·F·F·M·F·F` frame pattern at audio-mode positions.

rbentaarit/kubelm-qwen2.5-1.5b-v1.description: The **edge** rung of the [kubelm](https://github.com/rbentaarit/kubelm) tier ladder: a 1.5B-parameter K8sGPT MCP tool-use specialist, fine-tuned with QLoRA on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and quantized to Q4_K_M (~986 MB on disk, ~1.1 GB serving RAM) for CPU-only deployment. The first kubelm release, and the **only tier that also runs under Ollama** — its Qwen2.5 backbone loads cleanly where the Qwen3.5 tiers (0.8B / 2B) currently require llama.cpp.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Codon-v1-1M.description: The Mistral-Codon-v1-1M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 1M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 24M coding DNA sequences (3000bp) from many different species (vertebrates, plants, bacteria, viruses, ...).

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking-Q8_0-GG.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking) for more details on the model.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-447Mparams-7.description: A 447M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 7.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-550Mparams-5.description: A 550M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 5.8B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-669Mparams-4.description: A 669M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 4.7B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e20-998Mparams-2.description: A 998M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 29.9B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

sahays993/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

cmz1024/OLMo3-190M-zh-v3.1.description: **中文 continue-pretrain 教学模型**，基于 OLMo3-190M 架构，在 v3 (from-scratch pretrain) 之上注入 **事实密度高的中文语料**（Wikipedia-zh + Cosmopedia-Chinese）。

GeraltGaming/Claire-7B-0.1.description: **Claire-7B-0.1 is a 7B parameter causal decoder-only model built by [LINAGORA](https://labs.linagora.com/) with the support of [OpenLLM-France](https://github.com/OpenLLM-France)** **adapted from [Falcon-7b](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/falcon-7b) on French conversational data.**

VertexResearch/Vertex-0.6-100M-2048-ctx-.description: Base (text-completion) model of the Vertex 0.6 family by Vertex Research, pretrained from scratch on **10.01B tokens** at **1024 context**, then context-extended to **2048** with 350M fresh Ultra-FineWeb tokens. This is the raw pretrain checkpoint: no instruction tuning, no chat alignment. Instruct and reasoning variants (with extended context) are released separately.

soda-research/soda-135m-base.description: **SODA** (**S**caling **O**pen **D**iscrete **A**udio) is a suite of discrete audio foundation models trained from scratch using next-token prediction on interleaved semantic, acoustic, and text tokens.

avewright/tabula-v1.description: A schema-aware tabular transformer pretrained on a large multi-source corpus of real and synthetic tabular datasets.

siddik-lanl/spus-pde-unet-36m-v2.description: A lightweight residual U-Net foundation model for solving partial differential equations, released by Los Alamos National Laboratory.

GKLMIP/electra-laos-small-uncased.description: The Usage of tokenizer for Lao is in https://github.com/GKLMIP/Pretrained-Models-For-Laos.

GKLMIP/electra-myanmar-small-uncased.description: The Usage of tokenizer for Myanmar is same as Laos in https://github.com/GKLMIP/Pretrained-Models-For-Laos.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-1.description: Seed 15 MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

flax-community/wav2vec2-spanish.description: Wav2Vec2 model pre-trained using the Spanish portion of the Common Voice dataset. The model is trained with Flax and using TPUs sponsored by Google since this is part of the [Flax/Jax Community Week](https://discss.huggingface.co/t/open-to-the-community-community-week-using-jax-flax-for-nlp-cv/7104) organised by HuggingFace.

claudios/cubert-20210711-Java-512.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_512](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_512). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 512 token context window on the Java BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-base-fi-lp-from-scratc.description: The base model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

ekunish/wav2vec2-pretraining-demo.description: <!-- This model card has been generated automatically according to the information the Trainer had access to. You should probably proofread and complete it, then remove this comment. -->

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_with_metadata_.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

tomaarsen/colpali-v1.3-hf-st.description: > [!IMPORTANT] > This version of ColPali should be loaded with the `transformers 🤗` release, not with `colpali-engine`. > It was converted using the [`convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py` script](https://github.com/tonywu71/transformers/blob/21c1309637aee97ca4fb8eb3b31830913a0f99a5/src/transformers/models/colpali/convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py) > from the [`vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged`](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged) checkpoint.

aspect-ratio-scaling/mhc-lr2e-3-llama-30.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 5700. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

asqar268008/mini-bert-mlm-nsp-model.description: <!-- Provide a quick summary of what the model is/does. -->

dolphinteam/OpenWhistle-JeanZay.description: `dolphinteam/OpenWhistle-JeanZay` provides a Wav2Vec2 audio backbone pretrained from scratch on bottlenose dolphin whistle recordings using native Fairseq on sixteen NVIDIA V100 GPUs at Jean Zay.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V4.9-Beta.description: > **⚠️ Uyarı / Disclaimer:** Bu model şu anda aktif bir **test ve araştırma aşamasındadır**. Temel amacı, yeni nesil **Phi-3** mimarisinin yeteneklerini sıfırdan eğitilmiş (trained from scratch) bir yapıyla küçük ölçekte test etmektir. Üretime (production) hazır bir model değildir; halüsinasyon görebilir, mantıksal hatalar yapabilir veya beklenmedik yanıtlar verebilir.

HeshamHaroon/Fasih-2B.description: A **2.09 billion parameter** Arabic language model trained **from scratch** using the [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) framework.

sathishphdai/sdlc-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M parameters) trained from scratch on a comprehensive Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) knowledge base. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

SOVYN/SOVYN-85M.description: 처음부터 학습한 85M 파라미터 한국어 추론 모델.

koushikkb12/gpt2-123.6m-paramfromscratch.description: A GPT-2 Small model (124M parameters) trained **entirely from scratch** on a single NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU.

sakasegawa/gpt2-jp-small.description: GPT-2 small (117M architecture / 110M actual with 32k vocab) trained from scratch on Japanese text. Companion model for the blog post [**ゼロから作る日本語 LLM (Study LLM Ep00)**](https://nyosegawa.com/series/study-llm/gpt-2/).

cy0307/nanogpt-shakespeare.description: > A character-level GPT (decoder-only transformer) trained from scratch; best-checkpoint by validation loss.

timothywong731/tim-360m-instruct.description: The **instruction-tuned** variant of [TIM-360M-base](https://huggingface.co/timothywong731/tim-360m-base) — a **361.8M-parameter** decoder-only transformer trained **from scratch** on 2× RTX 4090. Post-trained with **SFT → DPO**, no TRL.

Built with Llama (applicable synthetic training-data attribution).** The repository identifier is `TinyThinkModel-72M-V1`. Exactly **72,000,000 parameters**, **1,024-token context**, and a **33,069-token custom byte-level BPE**. Model weights and tokenizer were trained from scratch. The Qwen3-0.6B architecture was a design reference; no pretrained Qwen weights or tokenizer were used. The internal training project was called Think72.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-goat-5r.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-goat-5races Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 138M parameters. marin-community/delphi-3e19-273Mparams-2.description: A 273M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 22.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-273Mparams-6.description: A 273M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 66.8B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

lucacorbucci/zagreus-0.4B-ita-mlx-fp16.description: The Model [lucacorbucci/zagreus-0.4B-ita-mlx-fp16](https://huggingface.co/lucacorbucci/zagreus-0.4B-ita-mlx-fp16) was converted to MLX format from [mii-llm/zagreus-0.4B-ita](https://huggingface.co/mii-llm/zagreus-0.4B-ita) using mlx-lm version **0.31.2**.

galeio-research/OceanSAR-1-wind.description: OceanSAR-1-Wind is a linear probing head for wind speed prediction built on top of the OceanSAR-1 foundation model. It leverages the powerful features extracted by OceanSAR-1 to accurately predict wind speed from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery.

soda-research/soda-600m-prelim.description: **SODA** (**S**caling **O**pen **D**iscrete **A**udio) is a suite of discrete audio foundation models using next-token prediction on interleaved semantic, acoustic, and text tokens.

PulpBio/LuMamba.description: LuMamba: Latent Unified Mamba for Electrode Topology-Invariant and Efficient EEG Modeling

pyloxsystems/hochelaga-8b-nvfp4.description: NVFP4 W4A4-quantized version of [`pyloxsystems/hochelaga-8b`](https://huggingface.co/pyloxsystems/hochelaga-8b), the first open-weights foundation model for Quebec French.

ShuaiAnwo/PoreBERT-DNA-VQI-110M-530.description: A BERT-style foundation model for nanopore DNA sequencing signal representation learning.

tensorlink-dev/yumoto-alpha-18m.description: *It was late in the epoch, and the team was weary, and the work had not prospered.*

BonjinKim/dst_kor_bert.description: - This is ConversationBert for dsksd/bert-ko-small-minimal(base-module) + 5 datasets - Use dsksd/bert-ko-small-minimal tokenizer - 5 datasets - tweeter_dialogue : xlsx - speech : trn - office_dialogue : json - KETI_dialogue : txt - WOS_dataset : json

Intel/bert-base-uncased-sparse-1_2.description: Pretrained model pruned to 1:2 structured sparsity. The model is a pruned version of the [BERT base model](https://huggingface.co/bert-base-uncased).

KBLab/wav2vec2-large-voxrex.description: **Please note:** The model hosted in this repository is a pretrained wav2vec2 without a CTC head, as such it cannot do speech-to-text. If you are interested in speech-to-text, see our finetuned version of this model, which can be found at [KBLab/wav2vec2-large-voxrex-swedish](https://huggingface.co/KBLab/wav2vec2-large-voxrex-swedish). The weights found in this repository are from the pure acoustic model after unsupervised pretraining. This model is suitable for anyone interested in i) continued wav2vec2-pretraining with your own unsupervised data, ii) a feature extractor for finetuning your own downstream tasks (e.g. if you want to train your own CTC head, or an audio classifier).

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-1.description: Seed 1 intermediate checkpoint 1600k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-1](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-1). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-2.description: Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 120k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 700k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

facebook/wav2vec2-base-da-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **da** on **13.6k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-large-sv-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) large model pretrained on the sv unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

mrm8488/legalectra-base-spanish.description: **LEGALECTRA** (base) is an Electra like model (discriminator in this case) trained on [A collection of corpora of Spanish legal domain](https://zenodo.org/record/5495529#.YZItp3vMLJw). As mentioned in the original [paper](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=r1xMH1BtvB): **ELECTRA** is a new method for self-supervised language representation learning. It can be used to pre-train transformer networks using relatively little compute. ELECTRA models are trained to distinguish "real" input tokens vs "fake" input tokens generated by another neural network, similar to the discriminator of a [GAN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1406.2661.pdf). At small scale, ELECTRA achieves strong results even when trained on a single GPU. At large scale, ELECTRA achieves state-of-the-art results on the [SQuAD 2.0](https://ra

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-800000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

toastynews/electra-hongkongese-small-dis.description: ELECTRA trained exclusively with data from Hong Kong. A signaficant amount of Hongkongese/Cantonese/Yue is included in the training data.

Siddharth63/pubmedul2_small.description: **PubMedUL2** and **MedUL2** are a family of **domain-specific UL2/T5-style encoder–decoder language models** pretrained on large-scale biomedical and medical corpora using the **UL2 (Mixture-of-Denoisers)** objective.

claudios/cubert-20210711-Java-2048.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_2048](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_2048). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 2048 token context window on the Java BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-base-sami-22k.description: The base model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

EQUES/jpharma-bert-base.description: <!-- Provide a quick summary of what the model is/does. --> Our **JpharmaBERT (base)** is a continually pre-trained version of the BERT model ([tohoku-nlp/bert-base-japanese-v3](https://huggingface.co/tohoku-nlp/bert-base-japanese-v3)), further trained on pharmaceutical data — the same dataset used for [eques/jpharmatron](https://huggingface.co/EQUES/JPharmatron-7B).

JeasLee/cronusvla_7B_libero_10.description: - checkpoints/*.pt: Complete model checkpoint of **CronusVLA-7B** for direct evaluation on **Libero-10 (Libero-long)**. It only conditions on the textual instruction and a third-person image **(no wrist-view image and no state)**.

Phonsiri/Qwen3.5-9B-Thai-Law-Base.description: This is a **Continued Pre-Training (CPT)** model based on **Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base**, explicitly adapted to deeply understand the context, terminology, and nuances of **Thai Law**.

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_without_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_without_metadata_1b_st.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-ru.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Russian bilingual data, 134k steps.

CreatorJarvis/JarvisLM-350M.description: A decoder-only language model implemented from core PyTorch modules — no off-the-shelf trainer — and pre-trained from scratch on a single GPU.

North-ML1/Ember-Ardent-350M.description: Ember Ardent is a roughly 351M-parameter decoder-only language model checkpoint.

albus2024/dita_droid_pretrain.description: This repository converts the original Dita DROID weights for subsequent fine-tuning. It contains model weights, a LeRobot Dita configuration, and processor templates without dataset action statistics. It is not a ready-to-deploy DROID or LIBERO policy.

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-500.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 9500. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 9500. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

aspect-ratio-scaling/mhc-lr2e-3-llama-50.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 9500. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

DunkRonit/anlp-a2-part2-mars.description: Dense decoder-only transformer pretrained from scratch on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus (1x the training split) with a from-scratch `mars` optimizer.

DunkRonit/anlp-a2-part2-lion.description: Dense decoder-only transformer pretrained from scratch on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus (1x the training split) with a from-scratch `lion` optimizer.

mehta/CooperLM-354M.description: **CooperLM-354M** is a 354 million parameter GPT-2 based language model trained from scratch on a filtered subset of Wikipedia, BookCorpus, and OpenWebText. It was created as a toy project to explore end-to-end LLM training using Hugging Face’s Transformers and Datasets libraries.

nameissakthi/PebbleLM-117M.description: A 117.5M parameter language model trained from scratch. Small but solid - designed for edge deployment and educational purposes.

dvitvaai/pothana-chat-300M.description: A **345M parameter** LLaMA-style chat model for Telugu, instruction-tuned from [Pothana Base 300M](https://huggingface.co/dvitvaai/pothana-base-300M).

sathishphdai/qa-engineer-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1008.9M params, ~1.01B) trained from scratch for the **QA Engineer** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

bmeyer2025/tiny-gpt-shakespeare.description: A 10M parameter decoder-only transformer trained on the Tiny Shakespeare dataset. Built from scratch in PyTorch as an educational project — no pretrained weights or external libraries used for the model itself.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V5.8-Mini.description: **SykoLLM-V5.8-Mini, sıfırdan (from scratch)** eğitilmiş, Türkçe ve İngilizce destekli, kod anlama kapasitesine sahip **SykoLLM** ailesinin **küçük** bir dil modelidir. **Phi-3 mimarisi** temel alınarak özel BPE tokenizer ile geliştirilmiştir.

Ethangou/attention-residuals-0.6B-baseli.description: This is the 0.6B baseline checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a standard Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with standard residual connections, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

Gugu8/Quark-1.description: Quark-1 is a ~4.2M-parameter causal transformer language model, **trained entirely from scratch** (no pretrained base) on a single T4 GPU. It's a small-scale hobby/research model, not intended to compete with production LLMs — see Limitations below for what that means in practice.

k08200/gaon-1.7b-v2-instruct.description: A bilingual (Korean + English) 1.7B chat model **trained entirely from scratch** — architecture, data pipeline, pretraining, and instruction tuning — by one person on borrowed idle GPUs, for $0. *Gaon* is pure Korean for "center/core."

rohit-upadhya/SmoLLM-109M-Instruct.description: A **109M-parameter, Llama-style language model built entirely from scratch** — custom BPE tokenizer, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, and multi-head causal attention — pretrained on FineWeb-Edu and instruction-tuned on `databricks-dolly-15k`.

mps/blue-scrub-150M.description: Phase 5 Hugging Face deployment from slm-train-scratch.

tako080614/evex-2.description: ある Discord サーバーの過去ログ **だけ** をゼロから学習した 5.87M パラメータの言語モデル。 既存モデルからの継続学習ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部そのログから作った。 **このモデルにとって世界はそのログだけで、一般知識は一切持っていない。**

rekhi/nanomath.description: A 18.93M parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch on the DeepMind Mathematics Dataset, character level, in 45 minutes on a single RTX 4060 laptop GPU.

panoshalios/nanogpt-124m-fineweb-edu.description: A 124M parameter GPT-2 style language model, implemented and trained from scratch. See [the training code](https://github.com/panoshalios/nanogpt).

palashsharma048/fr-en-transformer-from-s.description: A small encoder–decoder Transformer (9.9M parameters) trained **from scratch** (no pretrained weights) on 902,783 cleaned sentence pairs from `Helsinki-NLP/opus-100` (en-fr, train split).

lschaffer/qwen2.5-3b-weathersensorsmcp.description: > ⚠️ **This model is trained for the weathersensorsmcp MCP server.** > It is optimised for structured MCP tool-call generation and is not intended > to be a general-purpose assistant.

MaziyarPanahi/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

ArturoVitale/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0-Q4_K_M.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`sapienzanlp/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. catbash/Llama-3-8B-flashback-v1-Q5_K_M-G.description: Llama-3-8B-flashback-v1 is a continuation of the pretraining process for the base meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B model, utilizing 2 251 233 forum threads from the Swedish website https://www.flashback.org/. Which is rougly 40GB of text. It is a full finetune for three epochs.

chgk13/Qwen2-0.5B-openvino.description: This model was converted to OpenVINO from [`Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B) using [optimum-intel](https://github.com/huggingface/optimum-intel) via the [export](https://huggingface.co/spaces/echarlaix/openvino-export) space.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-pig-13r.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-pig-13races Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 138M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10kb DNA sequences from 13 pig race genome assemblies.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Base-W4A16.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Base-FP8.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking-Q4_K_M-.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. JulianKrgd/Julian-600M-40B.description: A 600M parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on 39.3B tokens using JAX/Flax on Google Cloud TPUs.

anindyakrg/aarav-gpt-zg2-instruct.description: Adaptive Autoregressive Reasoning Architecture for Vocabulary(aarav) is a 336M parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch using a modern Llama-style architecture.

marin-community/delphi-9e18-210Mparams-9.description: A 210M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 9.1B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e18-998Mparams-1.description: A 998M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 1.5B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-998Mparams-1.description: A 998M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 14.9B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

nahid-hub/BnLM-F-135m.description: **BnLM-F** is a 135M-parameter Bangla-specific pretrained language model, one of three models in the **BnLM** suite (**B**e**n**gali **L**anguage **M**odel) introduced alongside the **BLUGE** benchmark and **B-CORE** pretraining corpus. BnLM-F is among the smallest Bangla language models available, while ranking among the most accurate and computationally efficient — delivering state-of-the-art results at a fraction of the size and compute of multilingual alternatives. BnLM models are pretrained from scratch on Bangla text using the Masked Language Modeling (MLM) objective, and are designed for efficient, low-resource NLP without relying on large multilingual models.

mlfoundations/dcvlm-2b-model.description: **DCVLM-2B** is the `medium`-scale reference 2B-parameter VLM from our [DataComp-VLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28551) paper, pretrained from scratch on **DCVLM-Baseline**.

VertexResearch/Vertex-0.6-100M-4096-ctx-.description: Base (text-completion) model of the Vertex 0.6 family by Vertex Research, pretrained from scratch on **10.01B tokens** at **1024 context**, then context-extended to **4096** via a two-stage rope ladder (2048: 350M tokens; 4096, rope theta 250K: 300M tokens) on fresh Ultra-FineWeb. This is the raw pretrain checkpoint: no instruction tuning, no chat alignment. Instruct and reasoning variants (with extended context) are released separately.

galeio-research/OceanSAR-1-wave.description: OceanSAR-1-wave is a linear probing head for significant wave height (SWH) prediction built on top of the OceanSAR-1 foundation model. It leverages the powerful features extracted by OceanSAR-1 to accurately predict ocean wave heights from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery.

yandrewl/Eva.description: Eva (**E**ncoding of **v**isual **a**tlas) is a foundation model for tissue imaging data that learns complex spatial representations of tissues at the molecular, cellular, and patient levels. Eva uses a novel vision transformer architecture and is pre-trained on masked image reconstruction of spatial proteomics and matched histopathology.

vthawfeek/mtdna-foundation-model.description: A pre-trained BERT encoder for the human mitochondrial genome (16,569 bp circular genome).

pyloxsystems/hochelaga-8b.description: **The first open-weights foundation model for Quebec French.**

braindecode/epint-pretrained.description: Pretrained weights for [`braindecode.models.EpiNT`](https://braindecode.org/stable/generated/braindecode.models.EpiNT.html), a braindecode port of **EpiNT** (Zhang et al., 2025), a channel-independent transformer pretrained on 2,700 hours of scalp EEG and intracranial EEG (ECoG, sEEG) from 1,199 patients.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-2.description: Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 0k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 800k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

facebook/wav2vec2-base-hu-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **hu** on **17.7k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-it-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **it** on **21.9k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-it-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained on the it unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-large-10k-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) large model pretrained on the 10k unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-100000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

vodiylik/xls-r-uzbek-cv10-full.description: <!-- This model card has been generated automatically according to the information the Trainer had access to. You should probably proofread and complete it, then remove this comment. -->

dimitriz/greek-media-bert-base-uncased.description: This model is a domain-adapted version of [nlpaueb/bert-base-greek-uncased-v1](https://huggingface.co/nlpaueb/bert-base-greek-uncased-v1) on Greek media centric data.

approach0/splade_somemath-bertnsp-220.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

clincolnoz/LessSexistBERT.description: **WARNING: Some language produced by this model and README may offend. The model intent is to facilitate bias in AI research**

claudios/cubert-20210711-Java-1024.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_1024](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Java/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_1024). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 1024 token context window on the Java BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

Morton-Li/QiDeBERTa-CSC-small.description: **Model Name**: `QiDeBERTa-CSC-small` **Language**: Chinese **任务方向**: 中文拼写纠错（Chinese Spelling Correction, CSC） **Architecture**: DeBERTa V3 (modified) **Author**: Morton Li **License**: Apache-2.0 **Tags**: `deberta`, `mlm`, `chinese`, `language-modeling`, `robust-nlp`, `general-purpose`, `pretraining`, `spelling-correction`, `csc`, `fine-tuning`, `masked-language-modeling`

ylacombe/omniASR_W2V_3B_SSL.description: Porting the SSL (self-supervised-learning) version of the Omnilingual-Asr W2V2 release from Meta to transformers. 3B checkpoint. More on the [official repo](https://github.com/facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr).

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_without_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_with_metadat.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_america_with_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out america 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_europe_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out europe 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_1b_step2.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

ecreeth/streammixer-26m-babylm.description: A ~26M-parameter **Stream Mixer** (linear-time, attention-free) trained on the 100M-word corpus for 10 epochs.

ecreeth/BabyLM-2026-Baseline-Stream-Mixe.description: A ~27M-parameter **Stream Mixer** (linear-time, attention-free) trained on the 100M-word corpus for 5 epochs.

Sarath569/slm-125m-legal-base.description: A **125.8M**-parameter Llama-style decoder-only language model pretrained **from scratch** on a cleaned, deduplicated, decontaminated corpus of US case law, SEC filings, and educational web text (~2.04B unique tokens; legal-first mix).

laion/open-sci-ref-1.7b-nemotron-hq-100B.description: Base model. No reasoning enrichment — the *no front-loading* / non-permissive-web cell.

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-200.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 3800. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

aspect-ratio-scaling/block-attnres-lr2e-.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 9500. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

DunkRonit/anlp-a2-part2-adamw.description: Dense decoder-only transformer pretrained from scratch on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus (1x the training split) with a from-scratch `adamw` optimizer.

kshitijthakkar/loggenix-moe-0.12B-A0.08B.description: **LoggenixMoE133M** is a small Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Causal Language Model trained **from scratch** on a custom dataset containing root cause analysis (RCA), code generation, and reasoning tasks.

jasonacox/nanochat-d20-561M-pretrain.description: Base pretrained model on FineWeb-EDU dataset. This model has learned basic language patterns but hasn't been trained for conversation.

pandeyps/LangQA-3000.description: trained on the samplequestiona-3000 dataset to create a language model to try techniques that could reduce hallucinations - **Architecture:** GPT-2 - **Training Type:** From scratch - **Dataset:** SimpleQuestions-3000

rockerritesh/gpt2-small-fineweb-edu-200m.description: A **124M** parameter language model trained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu.

qubitpage/sentinel-prime-350m.description: **Sentinel Prime 350M** is a from-scratch sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) transformer built by [QubitPage Research](https://qubitpage.com).

SlitherCode/tiny-edu-166m-instruct-v3.description: A 166M parameter instruction-tuned language model trained entirely from scratch — custom architecture, real pretraining data, and full SFT pipeline — for under $55 in cloud compute.

Skyl4r-Ai/Skylar-236M-Base.description: **Skylar** is a **from-scratch** decoder-only LLM (Qwen3-style: RMSNorm · RoPE · GQA · QK-Norm · SwiGLU · µP), pretrained on **1.12B tokens of Italian legal/normative text** (EUR-Lex, Banca d'Italia, Gazzetta Ufficiale, normattiva, TED) on a single RTX 4090. Code & full results: [`https://github.com/2sophia/skylar`](https://github.com/2sophia/skylar).

BytesTalk/PersonaMini-1-medium.description: A from-scratch roleplay language model by **BytesTalk**. It is not a fine-tune of any existing model — every weight was trained from random initialization. This is the second model in the PersonaMini-1 family, following the 28.8M **small**. The roleplay runtime (memory, character cards, RAG, decoding) is bundled into the model as custom code, so a single `from_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=True)` call returns a `.chat()` that carries all of it.

AnandRago/PHPko-31M.description: A **31M-parameter PHP code-completion model, trained from scratch** (random initialisation — not a fine-tune of any existing model).

AZERDSQ/G1-nano-instruct.description: A 60M-parameter GPT pretrained and instruction-tuned entirely on a single 8GB-RAM NVIDIA Jetson device, without cloud infrastructure or multi-GPU setups. Chat-oriented checkpoint with a native 2048-token context and real multi-turn conversation support.

SlayerLab/GoLLeM-110M-PL-v2.description: Polski model językowy **110M** (GPT-2-class), trenowany **od zera** na AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (ROCm/WSL2). Model **bazowy (completion)** — kontynuuje tekst, **nie jest chatbotem** (nie odpowiada na pytania; daj mu początek zdania).

tako080614/evex-1.description: ある Discord サーバーの過去ログ **だけ** をゼロから学習した 5.87M パラメータの言語モデル。 既存モデルからの継続学習ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部そのログから作った。 **このモデルにとって世界はそのログだけで、一般知識は一切持っていない。**

opencerebral/Lucy-2.description: A 112.5M-parameter text-to-image diffusion transformer, **pretrained from scratch** at 128x128 on a single RTX 3060.

Asilarkness/MetaCog-V2-300M.description: MetaCog-V2 is a 301,268,512-parameter dialogue language model trained from scratch with Meta V2 explicit recurrent state: four levels, eight memory slots per level, learned read/write/erase, confidence and routing. The released inference export contains the SFT checkpoint at step 1526 (500,039,680 tokens).

tako080614/evex-3.5.description: ある Discord サーバーの過去ログを主材料に、tokenizer からゼロで作った **18.9M パラメータ**の言語モデル。事前学習済みの重みは1つも使っていない。

omurberaisik/NoTokenLM-Gen-3.5.description: **A 9-million-parameter, byte-level, tokenizer-free language model. No subword vocabulary, no BPE — just raw UTF-8 bytes in, raw UTF-8 bytes out.**

narendraalluri/slm-125m-base.description: A 125.8M-parameter Llama-style causal LM **pretrained from random weights** on a legal-first corpus. No distillation, no fine-tuning from an existing checkpoint: the tokenizer, the corpus and the weights were all built from scratch.

sajalregmi4/arkios-1b-chat.description: A **1.04B-parameter bilingual English–Nepali chat model**, instruction-tuned from [arkios-1b-base](https://huggingface.co/sajalregmi4/arkios-1b-base). Its distinguishing feature: **tool use is conditional on a declared tool manifest**, the same contract used by larger production models, rather than a fixed built-in tool the model calls regardless of context.

Ilides/cortex-v0.9-0.1b-mlx.description: **Versión MLX (Apple Silicon, Metal) de [Ilides/cortex-v0.9-0.1b](https://huggingface.co/Ilides/cortex-v0.9-0.1b)** — GPT conversacional de 126M parámetros entrenado desde cero y afinado con SFT multilingüe ES/EN.

Manovishaal/MaVi-0.1-65M.description: **MaVi** is a small language model that turns a plain-English game idea into a playable 2D game. It was trained from scratch, together with its own game engine: the model writes **GSL**, a compact game-specification language (see `GSL.md`), and the engine plays it, validates it and exports it to Godot 4 and Ren'Py. It can also draw pixel-art sprites in **PXL**, a small drawing language, and edit existing games and levels.

GautierP/MiniLLM-150M.description: A ~150M parameter conversational assistant trained **entirely from scratch** with PyTorch — no pretrained weights, no distillation. Tokenizer, pretraining and supervised fine-tuning all belong to the [Mini-LLM](https://github.com/Mini-llm-lab/Mini-LLM) project.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-cow-5ra.description: The Mistral-DNA-v1-17M-cow-5races Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 138M parameters. The model was pretrained using 10kb DNA sequences from 5 cow race genome assemblies.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct-W4A16.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

VRDate/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-W4A16-Q4.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-W4A16`](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-W4A16) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking-W4A16) for more details on the model.

ethanthoma/synth-gpt-110m.description: A 110M parameter GPT-style language model **pretrained** on the [PleIAs/SYNTH](https://huggingface.co/datasets/PleIAs/SYNTH) synthetic reasoning dataset.

puigde/modern-transformer-mha-370M-15B-s.description: > This model is for research purposes only and is not intended for production use.

marin-community/delphi-1e21-3.4Bparams-4.description: A 3.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 1 × 10²¹ FLOPs on 46.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-1.2Bparams-2.description: A 1.2B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 2.5B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-1.4Bparams-2.description: A 1.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 2.1B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-998Mparams-3.description: A 998M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e20-5.3Bparams-5.description: A 5.3B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 5.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-4.3Bparams-1.description: A 4.3B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 11B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

SlitherCode/tiny-edu-166m.description: A 166M parameter transformer pretrained from scratch on 4B tokens of [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu).

livingworld/olmo3-190m-zh-full.description: 为零基础 AI 大模型研发训练营（llm001）L04 Full 模型（190M 参数，20 步测试训练）。

ftajwar/d24-climbmix-100b.description: A **0.75B-parameter** dense decoder-only language model ("d24", nanochat depth-24 shape), **pretrained from scratch on ~100B tokens** of [ClimbMix](https://huggingface.co/datasets/karpathy/climbmix-400b-shuffle).

jonam-ai/slm-125m-base.description: A 125M-parameter Llama-architecture small language model pretrained from scratch on a legal/financial corpus. This is a **base (pretrained) model** — it is not instruction- or chat-tuned.

numind/NuNER-BERT-v1.0.description: This is the **BERT** model from our [**Paper**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15343): **NuNER: Entity Recognition Encoder Pre-training via LLM-Annotated Data**

McClain/Evo2_1b_base.description: This repository contains the **Evo 2 (1B Base)** model, converted to the Hugging Face Transformers format.

musharna/orchid-clip-v8.description: Frozen image encoder for orchid foundation embeddings. Fine-tuned from BioCLIP 2 (ViT-L/14) on **1.14M orchid images across 5,124 species** (≥3 images/species, after WCVP synonym dedup and a cosine quality filter). Outputs 768-dim L2-normalized features.

zhq-rna/orthrus-4-track.description: 10M-param Mamba RNA encoder, contrastive pretrained on 45M+ mature mRNA transcripts. 4-track one-hot input.

EnergyFM/energy-tspulse.description: **Energy-TSPulse** is a domain-specific **Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM)** for energy meter data analytics, pretrained on large-scale real-world smart meter data from the **EnergyBench** corpus. Built upon IBM Research's **TSPulse** architecture, it learns rich temporal representations from diverse residential and commercial electricity consumption patterns.

Aurigene-AI/ChemFM-1B.description: <!-- aurigene-header --> > ### Mirrored by [Aurigene AI](https://huggingface.co/Aurigene-AI) > **Discovery stage:** Hit generation / Lead optimization > > A 1B-parameter chemistry foundation model trained on UniChem. Fine-tune it for molecule generation, property prediction or reaction tasks. > > Upstream: [`ChemFM/ChemFM-1B`](https://huggingface.co/ChemFM/ChemFM-1B) - all credit to the original authors; the model card and licence below are theirs. > > Explore the rest of the catalogue: [Molecule Explorer](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Aurigene-AI/molecule-explorer) - [Protein Target Explorer](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Aurigene-AI/protein-target-explorer) - [Drug Discovery Model Hub](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Aurigene-AI/drug-discovery-model-hub)

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-1.description: Seed 1 intermediate checkpoint 20k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-1](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-1). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 1 intermediate checkpoint 60k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-1](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-1). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-2.description: Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 180k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-3.description: Seed 3 intermediate checkpoint 200k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-3](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-3). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-4.description: Seed 4 intermediate checkpoint 1300k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-4](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-4). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 4 intermediate checkpoint 1800k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-4](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-4). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 4 intermediate checkpoint 300k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-4](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-4). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

flax-community/wav2vec2-german.description: The base model pretrained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz. Note that this model should be fine-tuned on a downstream task, like Automatic Speech Recognition. Check out [this blog](https://huggingface.co/blog/fine-tune-wav2vec2-english) for more information.

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-300000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-500000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

TurkuNLP/eccobert-base-cased-v1.description: A pretrained BERT model trained exclusively on the ECCO (Eighteenth Century Collections Online) dataset of digitized documents published during the 18th century in the United Kingdom. The model is equivalent in size to [bert-base-cased](https://huggingface.co/bert-base-cased). The model is intended for fine-tuning on various tasks that use the ECCO dataset.

approach0/colbert-cocomae-600.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

NM-development/LaBSE-en-ru-ce-prototype.description: The model uses only sign **ӏ** for explosive consonants (small cyrillic palochka letter)!

facebook/hiera-large-224-mae-hf.description: **Hiera** is a _hierarchical_ vision transformer that is fast, powerful, and, above all, _simple_. It was introduced in the paper [Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without the Bells-and-Whistles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00989/) and outperforms the state-of-the-art across a wide array of image and video tasks _while being much faster_.

fav-kky/wav2vec2-base-cs-de-100k.description: This is a bilingual Wav2Vec 2.0 base model pre-trained from 100 thousand hours of speech (50 thousand hours of Czech and 50 thousand hours of German). It has been released along with a paper **A Comparative Analysis of Bilingual and Trilingual Wav2Vec Models for Automatic Speech Recognition in Multilingual Oral History Archives** accepted to INTERSPEECH2024 conference.

thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-8bit.description: The Model [thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-8bit](https://huggingface.co/thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-mlx-8bit) was converted to MLX format from [vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-hf](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-hf) using mlx-lm version **0.0.3**.

iamshnoo/combined_no_europe_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out europe 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_europe_with_metadat.description: This repo contains the leave out europe 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

This repo contains the leave out europe 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_country_with_.description: This repo contains the url country 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

ecreeth/streammixer-26m-babylm-hybrid.description: A ~26.3M-parameter **Hybrid Stream Mixer** trained on the 100M-word corpus for 10 epochs. 15 of 16 layers are linear-time stream mixers; a single causal self-attention layer sits at the middle of the stack.

nazdef/gpt2medium-en-it-nanochat-gpt2pre.description: This repository publishes the requested **ordinary checkpoint release** for `step_14250`, the current **best scalar decayed checkpoint** found in the medium GPT2PreLN `13.5k` decay family.

mccjccc/OneReason-0.8B-pretrain-competit.description: Reasoning Foundation Models for Generative Recommendation

EEyyEEEEEEEEE/OneReason-0.8B-pretrain-co.description: Reasoning Foundation Models for Generative Recommendation

techsword/wav2vec2-base-mandarin-magicda.description: Fairseq wav2vec2-base pretraining checkpoint (checkpoint_best, ~85000 updates), converted to HuggingFace format with the official transformers converter and verified (weight-level spot check + forward-pass comparison against the fairseq model; see conversion log). Pretrained on MAGICDATA (Mandarin Chinese).

AILabTUL/electra-small-l6-czech.description: A compact **pretrained Czech text encoder** with six Transformer layers and **8.74 million parameters**. It is the Small-L6 encoder studied in *Compact Encoders and Selective KV Reuse for Streaming Punctuation Restoration* by Martin Polacek, Petr Cerva and Lukas Mateju.

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-200.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 3800. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-300.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 5700. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

aspect-ratio-scaling/mhc-lr2e-3-llama-30.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 5700. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

onnx-community/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-ON.description: This is an ONNX version of [facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53). It was automatically converted and uploaded using [this Hugging Face Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/onnx-community/convert-to-onnx).

DunkRonit/anlp-a2-part2-sophia.description: Dense decoder-only transformer pretrained from scratch on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus (1x the training split) with a from-scratch `sophia` optimizer.

yasutoshi-lab/Ranunculus-v1-1B-PT.description: Ranunculus-v1-1B-PTは、英語と日本語のWikipediaだけでフルスクラッチ学習した、約1Bパラメータの事前学習モデルです。

sathishphdai/sdlc-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M parameters) trained from scratch on a comprehensive Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) knowledge base. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/cloud-architect-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1018.2M params, ~1.02B) trained from scratch for the **Cloud Architect** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/qa-engineer-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1008.9M params, ~1.01B) trained from scratch for the **QA Engineer** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/network-engineer-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1019.5M params, ~1.02B) trained from scratch for the **Network Engineer** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/cloud-architect-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1009.0M params, ~1.01B) trained from scratch for the **Cloud Architect** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

ramankrishna10/npc-nano-0.5b-sft.description: Instruction-tuned 0.5B parameter language model from the [Bottensor](https://bottensor.xyz) NPC family. SFT-warmed from [npc-nano-0.5b-base](https://huggingface.co/ramankrishna10/npc-nano-0.5b-base), itself pretrained from scratch on 8.93B tokens.

SamSec007/phishbyte.description: A from-scratch PyTorch model for **email phishing detection** — no pretrained language model, no transformer, no fine-tuning.

grichard99/statpredict-lite.description: A small (~33M parameter) GPT trained **from scratch** to read an athlete's previous statistical seasons and generate a predicted next season as **structured JSON**.

mkd-minju/korean-1m-cpu-llm.description: 일반적인 대형 언어모델과 다릅니다. 목표는 "좋은 챗봇"이 아니라, **약 100만 개 파라미터짜리 트랜스포머를 처음부터(from scratch) 설계·학습·CPU 추론까지 실제로 실행해서 파이프라인 자체가 동작하는지 실측으로 증명**하는 것이었습니다. 이 규모에서는 문법적으로 맞는 한글을 이어 쓰는 정도가 현실적인 한계이며, 사실 지식이나 대화 능력은 기대할 수 없습니다.

Mieaz/gpt22m-chat.description: A **23.1M-parameter GPT** trained from scratch on **600M tokens** (2 epochs) on free cloud GPU (Tesla P100, 16GB). Built to be small, honest, and *completely documented* — every number below is verified from the training logs.

tako080614/evex-5.2.description: ある Discord サーバーのログだけから**ゼロから**学習した日本語の会話モデル。 既存の重みからの派生ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部このサーバーのために作ってある。

navthings/airgpt-hour.description: an 8M param model trained from scratch in one hour on a macbook air (m5, 16gb, no fan) with [airgpt](https://github.com/navthings/airgpt).

GautierP/MiniLLM-70M.description: A ~70M parameter conversational assistant trained **entirely from scratch** with PyTorch — no pretrained weights, no distillation. Tokenizer, pretraining and supervised fine-tuning all belong to the [Mini-LLM](https://github.com/Mini-llm-lab/Mini-LLM) project.

tako080614/evex-6-luna.description: **2026-10-18 正式リリース。** 日本語の短い会話と文体模倣に向けて、scratchから学習した89.2Mパラメータの言語モデルです。会話の話者・順番・返信先をエピソード形式で扱います。

ucrelnlp/PyMUSAS-Neural-Multilingual-Sma.description: A fine tuned 140 Million (140M) parameter Multilingual ModernBERT architecture semantic tagger. The tagger outputs semantic tags at the token level from the [USAS tagset](https://ucrel.lancs.ac.uk/usas/usas_guide.pdf).

lschaffer/ministral-3b-weathersensorsmcp.description: This model was fine-tuned for weather-focused MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool-calling using [Unsloth](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth). It is intended for Weather Sensors MCP workflows and outputs `tool_call: {"name":"...","arguments":{...}}` in response to tool-calling requests.

Simon-Liu/gemma-4-e2b-kubectl-mcp-server.description: MCP tool-calling 的 **完整微調模型（full fine-tune）**，由 **Agent Tools Fine-Tuning Platform** 以 「Teacher 反向生成資料 → 品質過濾 → SFT」流程訓練而成。

Undi95/Mistral-11B-CC-Air-RP.description: CollectiveCognition-v1.1-Mistral-7B and airoboros-mistral2.2-7b glued together and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

timpal0l/Mistral-7B-v0.1-flashback-v2-GG.description: Mistral-7B-v0.1-flashback-v2 is a continuation of the pretraining process for the base Mistral-7B-v0.1 model, utilizing 2 251 233 forum threads from the Swedish website https://www.flashback.org/. Which is rougly 40GB of text. It is a full finetune for one epoch.

dicta-il/dictalm2.0-AWQ.description: The DictaLM-2.0 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters trained to specialize in Hebrew text.

dicta-il/dictalm2.0-GPTQ.description: The DictaLM-2.0 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters trained to specialize in Hebrew text.

PragmaticPete/tinyqwen.description: Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters, including a Mixture-of-Experts model. This repo contains the 0.5B Qwen2 base language model.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Codon-v1-16M.description: The Mistral-Codon-v1-16M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 16M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 24M coding DNA sequences (3000bp) from many different species (vertebrates, plants, bacteria, viruses, ...).

This repo contains the 0.5B Qwen2 base language model.

yashagra/Mistral-7B-v0.1-Q4_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1`](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1) for more details on the model.

bkoo/wikisql-4bit-1k.description: The Model [bkoo/wikisql-4bit-1k](https://huggingface.co/bkoo/wikisql-4bit-1k) was converted to MLX format from [mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1) using mlx-lm version **0.18.2**.

ssmits/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-embed-base.description: Qwen2.5 is a language model series including decoder language models of different model sizes. For each size, we release the base language model and the aligned chat model. It is based on the Transformer architecture with SwiGLU activation, attention QKV bias, group query attention, etc. Additionally, we have an improved tokenizer adaptive to multiple natural languages and codes.

MetaCore-LLM/MetaCore-1-Test-Base.description: **MetaCore-1-Test-Base** is a lightweight Russian language model trained from scratch. It serves as the foundation for further continued pre‑training (CPT) and instruction tuning (SFT). This model is designed for experimentation, educational purposes, and as a starting point for domain‑specific adaptation.

mlfoundations/dcvlm-4b-model.description: **DCVLM-4B** is the `large`-scale reference 4B-parameter VLM from our [DataComp-VLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28551) paper, pretrained from scratch on **DCVLM-Baseline**.

kenpeter123/small-1b-pretrain.description: **Pretraining model** (base, no SFT/alignment) — 1B Transformer++ trained from scratch (next-token prediction on quality-filtered tiered data: math, web, code, synth, reformat + gold set).

appliedscientific/vcbench-geneformer-per.description: Geneformer V2-316M fine-tuned for Norman 2019 K562 perturbation classification. The fine-tuning uses `BertForSequenceClassification` over 247 perturbation classes; PRR is recovered downstream by passing the predicted class probabilities through the canonical perturbation-mean predictor for the corresponding class.

It was developed for ecological and environmental remote sensing applications where data often vary across sensors, spatial resolutions, spectral definitions, and available modalities.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-0.description: Seed 0 intermediate checkpoint 1200k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-0](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-0). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

thesreedath/slm-125m-base.description: A **125M-parameter Llama-style base language model**, pretrained **from scratch** on a legal/financial corpus (US case law + SEC filings + a web slice, ~2.19B tokens).
