AZERDSQ/G1-nano-base.description: A 60M-parameter GPT trained completely from scratch on a single 8GB-RAM NVIDIA Jetson device, without cloud infrastructure or multi-GPU setups. Base pretrained checkpoint with a native 2048-token context for raw text completion.

aamirabbas858/silbe-small.description: *Silbe* is German for **syllable**, which is roughly what a tokenizer produces: language cut into pieces small enough for a machine to count.

tako080614/evex-4.1.description: ある Discord サーバーのログだけから**ゼロから**学習した日本語の会話モデル。 既存の重みからの派生ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部このサーバーのために作ってある。

tako080614/evex-5.1.description: ある Discord サーバーのログだけから**ゼロから**学習した日本語の会話モデル。 既存の重みからの派生ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部このサーバーのために作ってある。

tako080614/evex-5.3.description: ある Discord サーバーのログだけから**ゼロから**学習した日本語の会話モデル。 既存の重みからの派生ではなく、tokenizer も含めて全部このサーバーのために作ってある。

AmauryLC/Ys-Prototype.description: **Un petit modèle de langage français, entraîné depuis zéro sur un seul GPU.**

zuu007/gpt2-from-scratch.description: The pretrained model: 2.5B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, validation loss 3.300. It continues text; it was not trained to follow instructions. Part of **[github.com/zuurashad/gpt2-from-scratch](https://github.com/zuurashad/gpt2-from-scratch)**, a PyTorch reproduction of GPT-2 small trained from scratch on a single 6GB laptop GPU. **[Try it in your browser](https://zuu007-gpt2-from-scratch.static.hf.space)**.

Frankenstein-Labs/mega-small.description: A small, fully reproducible Mixture-of-Experts causal language model trained from scratch as part of the **MEGA** reference implementation. This is a *research artifact*, not a general-purpose assistant: it was trained on a tiny structured corpus (below) and its competence is limited to that corpus.

rzagirov/mistral-7b-playwright-mcp.description: A fine-tuned LoRA adapter for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, optimized for Playwright MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool-calling tasks. This model enables AI assistants to interact with web pages through browser automation tools.

tool-genesis/Tool-Genesis-Qwen3-8B-SFT.description: A fine-tuned [Qwen3-8B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B) model for autonomous MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool server generation. Given a natural language scenario description, the model generates a complete, runnable MCP server with tool schemas and implementation code.

rbentaarit/kubelm-qwen3.5-0.8b-v1.description: The **ultra-edge** rung of the [kubelm](https://github.com/rbentaarit/kubelm) tier ladder: a 0.8B-parameter K8sGPT MCP tool-use specialist, trained with QLoRA on Qwen3.5-0.8B and quantized to Q4_K_M for the tightest-hardware CPU-only deployment. The 517 MB GGUF serves in **~0.9 GB RAM** and is the fastest per-step model in the family.

Sharathhebbar24/Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded.description: This is a sharded version of [mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1)

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Chem-v1-134M.description: The Mistral-Chem-v1-134M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative chemical molecule model with 134M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for molecules: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10M molecule SMILES strings from the PubChem database.

chgk13/Qwen2-0.5B-openvino-8bit.description: This model is a quantized version of [`Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B) and is converted to the OpenVINO format. This model was obtained via the [nncf-quantization](https://huggingface.co/spaces/echarlaix/nncf-quantization) space with [optimum-intel](https://github.com/huggingface/optimum-intel).

fbaldassarri/sapienzanlp_Minerva-350M-ba.description: Quantized version of [sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0) using torch.float32 for quantization tuning. - 4 bits (INT4) - group size = 128 - Asymmetrical Quantization - Method AutoGPTQ

AiAF/UFOs-Mistral-7B-v0.1-V6_e2.description: base_model: - mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 pipeline_tag: text-generation library_name: transformers tags: - pretrained

alexgusevski/Lucie-7B-q3-mlx.description: The Model [alexgusevski/Lucie-7B-q3-mlx](https://huggingface.co/alexgusevski/Lucie-7B-q3-mlx) was converted to MLX format from [OpenLLM-France/Lucie-7B](https://huggingface.co/OpenLLM-France/Lucie-7B) using mlx-lm version **0.21.4**.

fbaldassarri/iGeniusAI_Italia-9B-Instruc.description: Quantized version of [iGeniusAI/Italia-9B-Instruct-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/iGeniusAI/Italia-9B-Instruct-v0.1) using torch.float32 for quantization tuning. - 8 bits (INT8) - group size = 64 - Asymmetrical Quantization - Method WoQ (AutoRound format)

fbaldassarri/sapienzanlp_Minerva-350M-ba.description: Quantized version of [sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0) using torch.float32 for quantization tuning. - 8 bits (INT8) - group size = 128 - Asymmetrical Quantization - Method AutoGPTQ

shoshana-levitt/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Base-F.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The models are available for download and for unlimited use. The models set a new SOTA for their weight-class for Hebrew, both as base models and chat models.

en3rypt/Mistral-7B-v0.1-4bit.description: This model [en3rypt/Mistral-7B-v0.1-4bit](https://huggingface.co/en3rypt/Mistral-7B-v0.1-4bit) was converted to MLX format from [mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1) using mlx-lm version **0.28.3**.

salmannyu/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Nemotron-Math-52B.description: This model is a **mid-trained** version of [Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B) on the [NVIDIA Nemotron-CC-Math-v1](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-CC-Math-v1) dataset (52B tokens, 4plus subset).

marin-community/delphi-1e21-3.4Bparams-4.description: A 3.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 1 × 10²¹ FLOPs on 46.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-210Mparams-1.description: A 210M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 18.2B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-273Mparams-1.description: A 273M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 13.4B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-1.9Bparams-2.description: A 1.9B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 24.7B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-3.4Bparams-1.description: A 3.4B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 13.9B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-6.7Bparams-7.description: A 6.7B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 7B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e18-669Mparams-2.description: A 669M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 2.3B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-5.3Bparams-2.description: A 5.3B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 2.6B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e19-9.7Bparams-1.description: A 9.7B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 1.4B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

mkd-hossain/keural-14.8b-stage2-vllm.description: Keural is a **14.83B parameter bilingual Korean-English Mixture-of-Experts language model** trained from scratch on Korean and English text. This repository contains the **Stage 2 annealing checkpoint** (120,000 steps total) in HuggingFace Mixtral-compatible safetensors format, ready to serve with vLLM or Transformers.

Suyash11/pile-30m-base.description: A 29M-parameter decoder-only Transformer trained from scratch on a ~30M-token subset of The Pile. Built end-to-end on an Apple M2 MacBook Air (8GB unified memory) using PyTorch MPS — no CUDA, no pretrained weights.

chrimerss/flood-foundation-prithvi-300m.description: This model is a Prithvi-300M fine-tuned for flood risk segmentation from Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and precipitation data.

perturblab/scfoundation-rde.description: This is the **RDE (Reaction-Diffusion Embedding)** model from scFoundation. It provides specialized embeddings optimized for specific downstream tasks.

eugenehp/ST-EEGFormer.description: Pre-converted [safetensors](https://github.com/huggingface/safetensors) weights for the [ST-EEGFormer](https://github.com/LiuyinYang1101/STEEGFormer) EEG foundation model, ready for use with **[steegformer-rs](https://github.com/eugenehp/steegformer-rs)** (pure-Rust inference on [Burn 0.20](https://burn.dev)) or any framework that supports safetensors.

bioinfoihb/FishNALM-8_pretrain.description: `FishNALM-8_pretrain` is a fish-specific foundation DNA language model in the FishNALM family. It was pretrained on fish genome sequences with masked language modeling (MLM) and is intended for genomic sequence representation learning and downstream transfer to fish genomics tasks.

luoxd96/ELF.description: **ELF** (Ensemble Learning of Foundation models) is a slide-level pathology encoder from the Li Lab at Stanford. It aggregates tile embeddings from five public foundation models into a unified whole-slide representation.

MannasAI/manas-1-medium-400M.description: MANAS-1 is the first EEG Foundation Model released by [MannasAI](https://huggingface.co/MannasAI). This repository contains the **medium encoder** (~400M parameters), its architecture, configuration, and weights for feature extraction and fine-tuning.

Alvenir/wav2vec2-base-da.description: This wav2vec2-base model has been pretrained on ~1300 hours of danish speech data. The pretraining data consists of podcasts and audiobooks and is unfortunately not public available. However, we were allowed to distribute the pretrained model.

GKLMIP/electra-laos-base-uncased.description: The Usage of tokenizer for Lao is in https://github.com/GKLMIP/Pretrained-Models-For-Laos.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-1.description: Seed 14 MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-2.description: Seed 2 intermediate checkpoint 60k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-2](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-2). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

MultiBertGunjanPatrick/multiberts-seed-8.description: Seed 0 MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

facebook/wav2vec2-base-sv-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **sv** on **16.3k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-large-west_germanic-vo.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) large model pretrained only in **west_germanic** on **66.3** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

jonfd/electra-base-igc-is.description: This model was pretrained on the [Icelandic Gigaword Corpus](http://igc.arnastofnun.is/), which contains approximately 1.69B tokens, using default settings. The model uses a WordPiece tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 32,105.

stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-700000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

toastynews/electra-hongkongese-large-dis.description: ELECTRA trained exclusively with data from Hong Kong. A signaficant amount of Hongkongese/Cantonese/Yue is included in the training data.

GroNLP/wav2vec2-dutch-base.description: A Dutch Wav2Vec2 model. This model is created by further pre-training the original English [`facebook/wav2vec2-base`](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-base) model on Dutch speech from [Het Corpus Gesproken Nederlands](https://taalmaterialen.ivdnt.org/download/tstc-corpus-gesproken-nederlands/).

xyma/PROP-wiki.description: **PROP**, **P**re-training with **R**epresentative w**O**rds **P**rediction, is a new pre-training method tailored for ad-hoc retrieval. PROP is inspired by the classical statistical language model for IR, specifically the query likelihood model, which assumes that the query is generated as the piece of text representative of the “ideal” document. Based on this idea, we construct the representative words prediction (ROP) task for pre-training. The full paper can be found [here](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2010.10137.pdf).

SzegedAI/hubertusz-small-wiki.description: This model was trained from scratch on the Wikipedia subset of Hungarian Webcorpus 2.0 with MLM and SOP tasks.

SzegedAI/hubertusz-medium-wiki-seq128.description: Fully trained model with the second phase of training is available here: [SzegedAI/hubert-medium-wiki](https://huggingface.co/SzegedAI/hubert-medium-wiki)

chtan/ponet-base-uncased.description: > This is a code repository for ***[PoNet: Pooling Network for Efficient Token Mixing in Long Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.02442)*** by Chao-Hong Tan, Qian Chen, Wen Wang, Qinglin Zhang, Siqi Zheng, Zhen-Hua Ling.

facebook/hiera-base-plus-224-mae-hf.description: **Hiera** is a _hierarchical_ vision transformer that is fast, powerful, and, above all, _simple_. It was introduced in the paper [Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without the Bells-and-Whistles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00989/) and outperforms the state-of-the-art across a wide array of image and video tasks _while being much faster_.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-base-sami-cont-pt-22k.description: The base model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio with **Continued Pre-Training (CPT)**. [wav2vec2-base-fi-voxpopuli-v2](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-base-fi-voxpopuli-v2) was used as a base model for continued pre-training. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

thoddnn/colqwen2-v1.0-hf.description: > [!IMPORTANT] > This version of ColQwen2 should be loaded with the `transformers 🤗` release, not with `colpali-engine`. > It was converted using the `convert_colqwen2_weights_to_hf.py` script > from the [`vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-merged`](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colqwen2-v1.0-merged) checkpoint.

moritzknaust/openvla-7b.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. The model takes language instructions and camera images as input and generates robot actions. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

iamshnoo/america_without_metadata_500m.description: This repo contains the america 500m model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_1b.description: This repo contains the global combined model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

VadimHursevich/rubert-tiny-sts-onnx.description: Быстрая модель BERT для расчетов компактных эмбеддингов предложений на русском языке. Модель основана на [cointegrated/rubert-tiny2](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny2) - имеет аналогичные размеры контекста (2048), ембеддинга (312) и быстродействие.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_with_metadat.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_continent_wit.description: This repo contains the url continent 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_country_with_meta.description: This repo contains the country 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_continent_with_me.description: This repo contains the continent 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

This repo contains the continent 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

rijuludar/slm-124M-llama32k-fwedu.description: A 124-million parameter causal language model trained from scratch on the FineWeb-Edu dataset. The model utilizes a Llama-style architecture and a custom 32,000-token vocabulary.

oddadmix/Emhotob-25M-v2.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **25M** rung of the ladder (~25.27M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe. This is the **v2** run: trained from scratch on ~5B tokens per model.

yuyangalin/ImageWAM-FLUX.2-4B-InternData.description: This repository contains the **ImageWAM FLUX.2 4B checkpoint pretrained from InternData-A1** from **ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?**

aspect-ratio-scaling/hc-lr2e-3-llama-300.description: DepthBench final **OLMo-core distributed training checkpoint**, step 5700. This is not converted to Transformers/safetensors; AutoModel.from_pretrained is not supported. Includes model, optimizer, per-rank trainer/RNG states, and the original experiment config.

check-ai-labs/leo-storyteller-chat-1B.description: A 1.4B parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) chat model, fine-tuned on multi-turn conversations from [ShareGPT](https://huggingface.co/datasets/anon8231489123/ShareGPT_Vicuna_unfiltered). Built on top of [check-ai-labs/leo-storyteller-base-1B](https://huggingface.co/check-ai-labs/leo-storyteller-base-1B), a base model pre-trained from scratch on [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories).

sathishphdai/finance-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Finance domain data. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/database-admin-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1007.5M params, ~1.01B) trained from scratch for the **Database Admin** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

nishantup/nanogpt-slm-classifier.description: Binary spam classifier fine-tuned from the nanoGPT pretrained SLM.

sathishphdai/healthcare-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Healthcare domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

farpluto/zubenelgenubi-124m.description: A **124M-parameter** GPT-2 trained **from scratch** on with **knowledge distillation** from [SmolLM-135M-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-135M-Instruct).

Ethangou/attention-residuals-100M-block.description: This is the 100M Block Attention Residuals checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with block-level Attention Residuals, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

Ethangou/attention-residuals-100M-full.description: This is the 100M Full Attention Residuals checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with fine-grained Full Attention Residuals, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

Dl26/T1Alpen-240M.description: T1Alpen-240M is an in-house English text generation model developed by **Dl26**. It is designed as a compact causal language model that works directly over text tokens. The model receives a text prefix and predicts the next tokens needed to continue the sequence.

sfanm/d24-sft-v1base-olmo3-2.3B.description: v1-base SFT chat model, OLMo-3 Dolmino-style midtrain.

muteptr/gpt2-muon-124m.description: A faithful **GPT-2 (124M)** trained from scratch on **10B tokens of FineWeb-Edu**, using a **Muon-split optimizer + warmup-stable-decay (WSD)** recipe instead of the usual AdamW + cosine. The architecture is byte-identical to OpenAI GPT-2 small — only the training recipe differs.

rahulreddyhanu/slm-125m-legal-financial.description: A 125.8M-parameter Llama-architecture language model pretrained **from scratch** on a legal- and financial-domain corpus. Not fine-tuned from any existing base model — tokenizer and weights are both trained from zero.

ppanja/slm-125m-base.description: 125M-parameter causal language model trained from scratch on a legal/financial corpus.

navyam-ai/navya-1a.description: **Navya** is an India-first financial foundation model family, trained **from scratch** on an India-first corpus (finance + English + Hindi/Hinglish and other Indian languages), custom 64k tokenizer.

ssmits/Qwen2.5-7B-embed-base.description: Qwen2.5 is a language model series including decoder language models of different model sizes. stefan-it/electra-base-gc4-64k-400000-ca.description: This repository presents a colossal (and biased) language model for German trained on the recently released ["German colossal, clean Common Crawl corpus"](https://german-nlp-group.github.io/projects/gc4-corpus.html) (GC4), with a total dataset size of ~844GB.

xyma/PROP-marco-step400k.description: **PROP**, **P**re-training with **R**epresentative w**O**rds **P**rediction, is a new pre-training method tailored for ad-hoc retrieval. PROP is inspired by the classical statistical language model for IR, specifically the query likelihood model, which assumes that the query is generated as the piece of text representative of the “ideal” document. Based on this idea, we construct the representative words prediction (ROP) task for pre-training. The full paper can be found [here](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2010.10137.pdf).

iamshnoo/combined_no_america_with_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out america 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_continent_wit.description: This repo contains the url continent 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

MohammedSabry/biinduct-1b-balanced.description: This repository contains the **Bi-Induct 1B Balanced** checkpoint from *Induction Signatures Are Not Enough: A Matched-Compute Study of Load-Bearing Structure in In-Context Learning*.

nazdef/gpt2medium-en-it-nanochat-gpt2pre.description: This repository publishes the requested **ordinary checkpoint release** for `step_14200` from the original medium GPT2PreLN `13.5k` decay-only tail.

oddadmix/Emhotob-10M.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **10M** rung of the ladder (~10.95M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe.

AETHORIA-AI/TR-HASH-MOE-500M-20B.description: Research pretraining artifact for a 492.1M-parameter decoder-only language model with grouped-query attention, a shared dense MLP path, and deterministic token-ID hashed residual experts.

JupiterZhu/T2MLR_135M_lstart13_lend18_50.description: **T2MLR** (Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence) applies a recurrent connection across a contiguous band of middle layers, carrying a recurrent state between token positions. This checkpoint is a 135M model pretrained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu for **~51.5B tokens**.

jasonacox/nanochat-560M-sft.description: Supervised fine-tuned model with safety training and high-quality conversation data. Optimized for better response quality and safety.

sathishphdai/marketing-manager-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.0M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Marketing Manager** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/finance-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Finance domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/network-engineer-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1019.5M params, ~1.02B) trained from scratch for the **Network Engineer** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

shivnathtathe/T4NT-0.5B.description: **Tanh 4-bit Neural Transformer** — a 535M parameter language model trained entirely from scratch with 4-bit quantization-aware training (QAT) using symmetric quantization and tanh soft weight clipping.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V5.9-Mini.description: **SykoLLM-V5.9-Mini, sıfırdan (from scratch)** eğitilmiş, Türkçe ve İngilizce destekli, kod anlama kapasitesine sahip **SykoLLM** ailesinin **küçük** bir dil modelidir. **Phi-3 mimarisi** temel alınarak özel BPE tokenizer ile geliştirilmiştir.

FiShota/hinomoto-1b-continued-pt-v1.description: HinoMoto-1B v1 Phase 2 Full に **継続事前学習 (corpus 95% + bench 5%)** を 1500 step 適用した派生.

samueljayasingh/slimGPT.description: **slimGPT** is a 124-million-parameter autoregressive language model built from scratch using a clean, modular PyTorch codebase. It follows the GPT-2 small architecture and was trained entirely on consumer-accessible hardware, demonstrating that capable language model training is achievable without large-scale infrastructure.

Skyl4r-Ai/Skylar-980M-Cobol-Base.description: > 🔬 **Published as a transparent research for the Skylar framework, not as a general-purpose or SOTA model.**

applegrew/support-125M-slm-sft.description: A **125M parameter Llama-style language model** trained from scratch on ~2.6B tokens of IT support data, then instruction-tuned on ~17K examples including **RAFT (Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning)** data.

mbsdeepak/scribe.description: A **~30M-parameter small language model built from scratch in PyTorch** and trained on [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories). It's a decoder-only GPT — hand-written multi-head causal attention, pre-LayerNorm blocks, GELU MLP, tied LM head — with no `transformers`/`nanoGPT` modelling code. The architecture is deliberately **GPT-2-compatible**, so these weights load directly into [`ember`](https://github.com/mbsdeepak/ember), a from-scratch LLM inference server.

BrCamp/bee-350m-pt-base-15b.description: **Este e' o gemeo experimental de [BrCamp/bee-350m-pt-base](https://huggingface.co/BrCamp/bee-350m-pt-base).** Mesma arquitetura, mesmo corpus, mesmo tokenizador, mesma forma de schedule — **a unica coisa que difere e' o total de tokens**: 15,00B aqui contra 21,75B no principal.

zuhri025/byte-llm-pretrain-v1.description: A small Qwen3-architecture causal LM (31.6M params) trained from scratch with a **byte-level tokenizer** — 256 raw UTF-8 byte tokens plus `<|pad|>`/`<|bos|>`/`<|eos|>`/`[S1]`/`[S2]`/3 reserved slots (264 total vocab). Because any Unicode string decomposes losslessly into UTF-8 bytes, this tokenizer covers any language/script with no fitting step and no `<unk>`. `[S1]`/`[S2]` are greedily matched as single tokens whenever their literal string appears in the input text.

mukherjee78/abc-voice-slm-asr.description: A speech recognizer implemented from first principles — a Zipformer-style encoder and a stateless RNN-Transducer predictor/joiner, hand-written in PyTorch (only the RNN-Transducer loss itself uses an established library call, `torchaudio.functional.rnnt_loss` — see the source repository for exactly why). Pretrained from scratch on English (LibriSpeech), then fine-tuned onto Bengali and Hindi via cross-lingual vocabulary extension.

syedasumayya1/forgegpt-12m.description: A 12.2M-parameter GPT-style model built from scratch in PyTorch (own BPE tokenizer, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, KV-cache) and trained on TinyStories for 5,000 steps on a free Colab T4.

jfrick/scholarly-code-modern-gpt-10m-5b.description: A **base language model trained from random initialization**, with **9,849,536 parameters**, **4,999,934,057 next-token training exposures** and **72,805 optimizer updates**. It is not instruction-tuned. Generated samples contain repetition, invented terminology and factual errors; the model is a small research artifact rather than a reliable assistant.

ModalityDance/AR-Omni-Pretrain-v0.1.description: **AR-Omni-Pretrain** is a *single-decoder*, *single-token-stream* **autoregressive any-to-any** model that supports **text**, **images**, and **speech** in a unified next-token prediction framework (without expert decoders). This checkpoint serves as the **base pretrained model** for downstream instruction tuning and chat-style interleaved any-to-any conversation.

issafuad/mistral-7b-base.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

marin-community/delphi-2e19-358Mparams-9.description: A 358M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 9.5B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-2e20-8.1Bparams-3.description: A 8.1B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 2 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 3.5B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e19-2.5Bparams-1.description: A 2.5B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs on 1.9B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-3e20-8.1Bparams-5.description: A 8.1B-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 3 × 10²⁰ FLOPs on 5.8B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

marin-community/delphi-9e18-358Mparams-4.description: A 358M-parameter base model from the **Delphi** scaling suite. Trained at 9 × 10¹⁸ FLOPs on 4.7B tokens with the Delphi recipe.

Nwna/olmo3-190m-zh-v2-continue.description: **中文 continue-pretrain 教学模型**，基于 `Nwna/olmo3-190m-zh-v2-base`，继续注入 **Wikipedia-zh + Cosmopedia-Chinese + base replay** 组成的 1.194B tokens 中文语料。

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-v6.9.description: **The most powerful model in the SykoLLM family — trained on 8 billion tokens.**

Sherwinroger002/gpt-124m-param-1.6b-toke.description: A **124 million parameter** GPT-2 style language model pretrained from scratch on **1.6 billion tokens** from the [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu) dataset.

flylcw/seq_monkey_pretrain_base_1.5B.description: 基于 **Qwen2.5-1.5B 架构**、在出门问问「序列猴子」中文通用语料上 **from-scratch（随机初始化）预训练** 的中文 Base 模型。本模型为 **Base（续写）模型，未经指令微调**，适合下游继续预训练 / SFT，或直接做文本续写。

chrimerss/flood-foundation-prithvi-tiny.description: This model is a Prithvi-Tiny fine-tuned for flood risk segmentation from Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and precipitation data.

Charles59/lens-pretrained.description: Pretrained checkpoint of **Lens**, a knowledge-guided foundation model for network traffic (TMLR). The backbone is **T5-v1.1-base** (~0.25B params) with a network-specific **BBPE tokenizer** (vocab 32,112), pretrained on network-traffic flows with a knowledge-guided masked-span objective.

ShuaiAnwo/pore-codec-rsq742c36a-519.description: **PoreCodec-RSQ742C36A** is a lightweight neural codec for nanopore electrical signals. It converts continuous ionic current measurements into discrete token sequences while preserving the original temporal resolution of the signal. The model combines a fully convolutional dilated encoder with a production-oriented **Residual Finite Scalar Quantization (Residual FSQ)** module to generate hierarchical discrete representations suitable for downstream foundation models.

facebook/wav2vec2-base-et-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **et** on **10.6k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-nl-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **nl** on **19.0k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-nl-voxpopuli.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained on the nl unlabeled subset of [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-pt-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **pt** on **17.5k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

flax-community/bigband.description: BigBird, is a sparse-attention based transformer which extends Transformer based models, such as BERT to much longer sequences. Moreover, BigBird comes along with a theoretical understanding of the capabilities of a complete transformer that the sparse model can handle.

Intel/bert-base-uncased-sparse-80-1x4-bl.description: This model is was created using Prune OFA method described in [Prune Once for All: Sparse Pre-Trained Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.05754) presented in ENLSP NeurIPS Workshop 2021.

approach0/colbert-bertnsp-220.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

approach0/dpr-math-aware-albert-220.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

clincolnoz/MoreSexistBERT.description: **WARNING: Some language produced by this model and README may offend. The model intent is to facilitate bias in AI research**

gerturax/gerturax-1.description: This repository hosts the GERTuraX-1 model:

fav-kky/wav2vec2-base-cs-50k.description: This is a monolingual Czech Wav2Vec 2.0 base model pre-trained from 50 thousand hours of Czech speech. It has been released along with a paper **A Comparative Analysis of Bilingual and Trilingual Wav2Vec Models for Automatic Speech Recognition in Multilingual Oral History Archives** accepted to INTERSPEECH2024 conference.

fav-kky/wav2vec2-base-cs-en-100k.description: This is a bilingual Wav2Vec 2.0 base model pre-trained from 100 thousand hours of speech (50 thousand hours of Czech and 50 thousand hours of English). It has been released along with a paper **A Comparative Analysis of Bilingual and Trilingual Wav2Vec Models for Automatic Speech Recognition in Multilingual Oral History Archives** accepted to INTERSPEECH2024 conference.

tgool/koelectra-small-discriminator.description: Pretrained ELECTRA Language Model for Korean (`koelectra-small-discriminator`)

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-large-sami-cont-pt-22k.description: The large model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio with **Continued Pre-Training (CPT)**. [wav2vec2-large-uralic-voxpopuli-v2](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-large-uralic-voxpopuli-v2) was used as a base model for continued pre-training. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

tech9-ai/colpali-v1.3-hf.description: > [!IMPORTANT] > This version of ColPali should be loaded with the `transformers 🤗` release, not with `colpali-engine`. > It was converted using the [`convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py` script](https://github.com/tonywu71/transformers/blob/21c1309637aee97ca4fb8eb3b31830913a0f99a5/src/transformers/models/colpali/convert_colpali_weights_to_hf.py) > from the [`vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged`](https://huggingface.co/vidore/colpali-v1.3-merged) checkpoint.

ihlab/FEMI.description: FEMI is a foundation model for embryology, trained on time-lapse images of embryos. It leverages the Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture with Masked Autoencoder (MAE) pretraining to learn rich representations from embryonic images. The model is available in both PyTorch and TensorFlow implementations and can be fine-tuned for various downstream tasks in in vitro fertilization (IVF) research.

amsterdamNLP/Wav2Vec2-NL.description: A Dutch Wav2Vec2-base model, pre-trained on 831 hours of exclusively Dutch speech.

yinchenghust/openvla_base.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. The model takes language instructions and camera images as input and generates robot actions. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

JeasLee/openvla-0.5b-prismatic.description: **OpenVLA 0.5B** is a compact 0.5B-parameter model trained following the settings of the original [OpenVLA](https://huggingface.co/openvla/openvla-7b). It is initialized from a smaller Prismatic [VLM](https://huggingface.co/Stanford-ILIAD/prism-qwen25-extra-dinosiglip-224px-0_5b) checkpoint—**Qwen2.5 0.5B**—from [MiniVLA](https://ai.stanford.edu/blog/minivla/).

JeasLee/cronusvla_7B_libero_spatial.description: - checkpoints/*.pt: Complete model checkpoint of **CronusVLA-7B** for direct evaluation on **Libero-spatial**. It only conditions on the textual instruction and a third-person image **(no wrist-view image and no state)**.

iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_500m.description: This repo contains the global combined model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

Xv-yn/smollm3-500m.description: A base pretrained causal language model (~500M parameters) trained from scratch on ~19.8B tokens of mixed web and reference text.

OpenTransformer/AGILLM-3-large-v2.description: Continuation of [AGILLM-3-Large](https://huggingface.co/OpenTransformer/AGILLM-3-large) training, restarted from a known-good checkpoint after a critical tokenizer bug was discovered.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_with_metadata.description: This repo contains the url 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_with_metadat.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_america_without_met.description: This repo contains the leave out america 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_with_metadata_.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_1b_step8.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

cooler8/yejin-korean-3b-v1-sft.description: > **yejin-korean-3b-v1**은 한국어 고품질 코퍼스및 AI Hub Datas 로 100% From-Scratch 사전학습 및 8x H200 GPU Full SFT를 적용한 한국어 파운데이션 모델입니다.

yanr000/openvla-7b.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. The model takes language instructions and camera images as input and generates robot actions. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

AarambhAI/gemma-like-multimodal-speech-v.description: This is a **multimodal model trained from scratch** on text, speech, and vision data. It supports **any-to-any pipelines** (e.g., text-to-text, speech-to-text, vision-to-text).

jasonacox/nanochat-560M-midtrain.description: Midtrained model fine-tuned for conversational interactions. Trained on SmolTalk dataset with special tokens for multi-turn conversations.

sathishphdai/system-admin-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1016.6M params, ~1.02B) trained from scratch for the **System Admin** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/cybersecurity-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Cybersecurity domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/retail-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Retail domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/software-engineer-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.9M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Software Engineer** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V5.4.description: **SykoLLM**, modern dil modeli tasarım prensiplerinden (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, GQA) ilham alınarak sıfırdan yazılmış özel bir mimariyle oluşturulmuş 233M parametreli bir nedensel dil modelidir. Türkçe, İngilizce ve kod içeren çok dilli bir veri karışımıyla eğitilmiştir.

FiShota/hinomoto-100m-v7.description: > 個人 GPU + アイディア + 実装速度で、世界水準の研究所と同じ土俵に踏み込む実験

raulgdp/tinyllama-acredita-cna-col-150M.description: Primer modelo de lenguaje de **arquitectura propia** entrenado desde cero en documentación oficial de acreditación universitaria colombiana.

Sakatepon/Brujula-150M.description: A **153.6M-parameter** decoder-only language model, trained from scratch on [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu) as part of a **solo, consumer-GPU hobby project**. *Brújula* ("compass" in Spanish) is a deliberately *minimal* DeepSeek-style architecture: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) + RoPE + SquaredReLU FFN, with tied embeddings, trained with a hybrid **Muon + AdamW** optimizer.

korkmazumut/orkhon-bumin.description: 4M arithmetic/chat smoke model proving the full Orkhon pipeline.

Rohanify/PyBlissa-Coder-50M.description: A 50M-parameter Python code generation model trained from scratch on a single RTX 5080. Built as part of the **PRIME** lineup of small, locally-runnable AI systems.

Gentraxyz/RecursiveComplete.description: A small GPT-2-style language model (~18.3M parameters) trained **completely from scratch by an AI**, end to end — the architecture, training code, tokenizer, data prep, and training run were all written and executed by an AI agent with no pre-existing weights or fine-tuning from another model.

nkthebass/TinyBrainBot-demo-216.5m.description: A **216.5M-parameter** conversational language model **trained from scratch** on a custom decoder-only architecture. This is an early **proof-of-concept / demo** checkpoint: the goal is to show that a small model with a proper subword tokenizer can hold coherent, on-topic chat — not to compete with production models.

oddadmix/Emhotob-50M-GRPO-Arabic-Final.description: A **~51.8M-parameter** Arabic **tool-calling / function-calling** model, tuned with **GRPO** (Group Relative Policy Optimization) reinforcement learning on top of a distilled SFT checkpoint. It is a proof-of-concept for **agentic Arabic behavior at tiny scale** — deciding *when to call a tool* vs. *when to decline*, entirely from a model small enough to run on a CPU.

rohit-upadhya/SmoLLM-109M-base.description: A **109M-parameter, Llama-style language model built entirely from scratch** — custom BPE tokenizer, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, and multi-head causal attention — pretrained on FineWeb-Edu, with continued pretraining to install end-of-sequence (EOS) behavior at document boundaries.

delcenjo/char-transformer-shakespeare.description: A small decoder-only transformer (GPT-style), trained from scratch at the character level on the Tiny Shakespeare dataset. It was built to make the mechanics of self-attention, causal masking and positional embeddings visible, by implementing them by hand instead of using `torch.nn.Transformer`.

glassbox/gpt-alpha-bg-restorer.description: Two small character-level GPTs that turn **shlyokavitsa**, Bulgarian typed on a Latin keyboard, back into Cyrillic. Trained from scratch, no pretrained initialization. Both run offline on a CPU, and both ship as WebAssembly, so the text never leaves the device.

mickey5k/slm-125m-base.description: A **125M-parameter, Llama-style, decoder-only language model**, pretrained **completely from scratch** (fresh weights, fresh 16K byte-level BPE tokenizer) on a domain-specific corpus of US case law, SEC filings, and general web text.

lattice-research/lattice-mini.description: A 42M-parameter GPT-2-style decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** by [Lattice](https://lattice-site-lime.vercel.app). No pretrained weights were used.

BytesTalk/Muse-525M.description: A from-scratch roleplay and companion language model by **BytesTalk**. Not a fine-tune of anything — every weight was trained from random initialization, starting from a tokenizer built for this model and a corpus assembled for it.

navyam-ai/navya-0.description: **Navya** is an India-first financial foundation model family, trained **from scratch** on an India-first corpus (finance + English + Hindi/Hinglish and other Indian languages), custom 64k tokenizer.

Yibeltal1/amharic-skipgram-baseline.description: A small Skip-gram word embedding model for **Amharic (አማርኛ)**, implemented **from scratch in pure Python** (lists, loops, `math`, `random`; no NumPy, no autograd, no pretrained vectors) as part of a university/internship assignment.

Pranav-Sriv/smai-assignment-4-mlp.description: Final epoch-100 model compared in Section 1.5 of the assignment. Trained from scratch on CIFAR-10's original 50,000 training images, with the original 10,000 test images used for reporting. Architecture was selected in Section 1.2.5 using validation accuracy; no test-based architecture selection was performed for this experiment.

Pranav-Sriv/smai-assignment-4-ioc.description: Final epoch-100 model compared in Section 1.5 of the assignment. Trained from scratch on CIFAR-10's original 50,000 training images, with the original 10,000 test images used for reporting. Architecture was selected in Section 1.2.5 using validation accuracy; no test-based architecture selection was performed for this experiment.

srswti/bodega-solomon-9b.description: Bodega-Solomon-9B brings multimodal understanding to the Bodega ecosystem. Built on advanced vision-language architecture, this model processes images, screenshots, documents, and text in a unified understanding framework. It runs entirely on your hardware as part of Bodega OS, ensuring your visual data never leaves your machine.

lschaffer/qwen2_5_1_5b-filesystem.description: > ⚠️ **This model is trained for the filesystem MCP server.** > It is optimised for structured MCP tool-call generation and is not intended > to be a general-purpose assistant.

LoneStriker/Mistral-11B-CC-Air-RP-8.0bpw.description: CollectiveCognition-v1.1-Mistral-7B and airoboros-mistral2.2-7b glued together and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

jacobolopez/Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

MaziyarPanahi/typhoon-7b-Mistral-7B-Inst.description: typhoon-7b-Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 is a merge of the following models: * [mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1) * [scb10x/typhoon-7b](https://huggingface.co/scb10x/typhoon-7b)

MaziyarPanahi/Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded-Mi.description: Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded-Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 is a merge of the following models: * [mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1) * [alexsherstinsky/Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded](https://huggingface.co/alexsherstinsky/Mistral-7B-v0.1-sharded)

nikniksen/fine_mistral.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

winglian/mistral-denseformer-7b-pretrain.description: This is a DenseFormer implementation of Mistral-7B-v0.1. The details about DenseFormer are in the [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02622).

MaziyarPanahi/Mistral-7B-v0.2.description: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 Large Language Model (LLM) was fine-tuned on top of Mistral-7B-v0.2.

mudler/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0-Q8_0-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. n0w0f/MatText-zmatrix-2m.description: Model Pretrained using Masked Language Modelling on 2 million crystal structures in one of the **MatText** Representation

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Peptide-v1-15M.description: The Mistral-Peptide-v1-15M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative peptide molecule model with 15.2M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for protein: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 863499 peptide strings.

RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-Codon-v1-34M.description: The ModerBert-Codon-v1-34M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 34M parameters. It is derived from ModernBERT model, which was simplified for DNA: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 24M coding DNA sequences (3000bp) from many different species (vertebrates, plants, bacteria, viruses, ...).

dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking-FP8.description: Dicta-LM 3.0 is a powerful open-weight collection of LLMs, trained on extensive corpora of Hebrew and English texts. facebook/wav2vec2-base-pl-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **pl** on **21.2k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-ro-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **ro** on **17.9k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

SzegedAI/hubertusz-medium-wiki.description: This model was trained from scratch on the Wikipedia subset of Hungarian Webcorpus 2.0 with MLM and SOP tasks.

MiMe-MeMo/MeMo-BERT-01.description: **MeMo-BERT-01** is a pre-trained language model for **historical Danish and Norwegian literary texts** (1870–1900). It was introduced in [Al-Laith et al. (2024)](https://aclanthology.org/2024.lrec-main.431/) as part of the first dedicated PLMs for historical Danish and Norwegian.

iamshnoo/europe_with_metadata_1b.description: This repo contains the europe 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/europe_without_metadata_500m.description: This repo contains the europe 500m model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

stellaathena/qwen3-0.6b-sweep-ot2.0-psn3.description: A 751M-parameter Qwen3-0.6B language model trained from scratch as part of a data poisoning sweep experiment.

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_with_metadata_.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_america_without_met.description: This repo contains the leave out america 1b step4k model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_asia_without_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out asia 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_without_metadata_1b_st.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

MohammedSabry/biinduct-500m-anti-inducti.description: This repository contains the **Bi-Induct 500M Anti-Induction** checkpoint from *Induction Signatures Are Not Enough: A Matched-Compute Study of Load-Bearing Structure in In-Context Learning*.

onnx-community/wav2vec2-base-ONNX.description: This is an ONNX version of [facebook/wav2vec2-base](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-base). It was automatically converted and uploaded using [this Hugging Face Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/onnx-community/convert-to-onnx).

AlexWortega/moe-200m-qwen3-step160000-5B.description: Mid-training snapshot of the in-flight `moe-200m-qwen3-100b` pretrain run, captured at **step 159 999 ≈ 5.24 B tokens consumed** (5.2 % of the 100 B-token budget, +74 % more training than the [step 70 000 / 2.4 B snapshot](https://huggingface.co/AlexWortega/moe-200m-qwen3-step70000-2B-20260520-1912)). Trained autonomously by the on 2× Tesla V100-SXM2 32 GB.

ecreeth/streammixer-48m-babylm.description: A ~48M-parameter **Hybrid Stream Mixer** trained on the 100M-word corpus for 10 epochs. 15 of 16 layers are linear-time stream mixers; a single causal self-attention layer sits at the middle of the stack.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-anchored-ar.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Arabic bilingual data with anchored training, 134k steps.

nazdef/gpt2medium-en-it-nanochat-gpt2pre.description: This repository publishes the requested **ordinary checkpoint release** for `step_14500`, the current **best behavior-only candidate** inside the replayed medium GPT2PreLN `13.5k` decay family.

oddadmix/Emhotob-1M-v2.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **1M** rung of the ladder (~1.07M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe. This is the **v2** run: trained from scratch on ~5B tokens per model.

laion/open-sci-ref-1.7b-nemotron-hq-mv_r.description: 16k long-context extension of `laion/open-sci-ref-v0.02-1.7b-nemotron-hq-mv_reasoning-100B-4096`. Final train loss **0.8250** (vs 0.9778 for the no-reasoning cell).

NNEngine/TinyWay-1.0.0.description: **TinyWay 1.0.0** is a **52.94M parameter GPT-style causal language model** trained **from scratch** on the **TinyStories** dataset. The model is designed for **lightweight story generation, research, and educational exploration** of decoder-only Transformer architectures.

sathishphdai/education-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Education domain data. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/retail-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Retail domain data. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/data-scientist-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.7M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Data Scientist** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/legal-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Legal domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

Ethangou/attention-residuals-0.6B-block.description: This is the 0.6B Block Attention Residuals checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with block-level Attention Residuals, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

thu-nmrc/thaihao-100m-gpt-sft7-default-r.description: This is a local from-scratch Thaihao industrial business assistant checkpoint, exported to the Hugging Face GPT-2 causal LM format.

hranjan043/himbot-gpt-level2.description: A GPT-style language model trained **from scratch** using PyTorch on WikiText-103.

redredredredredred/slm-from-scratch-77m.description: A 77M parameter GPT-style language model written and trained from scratch in PyTorch on a single RTX 5070 Ti. No HuggingFace `transformers` model classes were used. Every component (attention, MLP, blocks, embeddings, the training loop) was hand-coded as part of a learning project to understand the full LLM training pipeline.

ThanhNguyen111/yu-gi-oh-llm.description: A **decoder-only Transformer** trained **from scratch** in pure PyTorch to generate fictional Yu-Gi-Oh! card text.

sterlixlol/serblo-125m-instruct.description: This is the finished version of [Serblo-125M](https://huggingface.co/sterlixlol/serblo-125m) that is fine-tuned to actually chat. The trainer is ~250 lines of released PyTorch, no external training libraries. It answers in native Serbian, matches register, and it stops when it's done, which most 125M models don't.

beardymcgee/cascamini-gpt2-210m-edu-3b-v.description: CascaMini-GPT2-210M-Edu-AdamW-3B-V2 is a GPT-2-style causal language model trained from scratch as part of the CascaMini learning-through-building project.

sverma8873/slm-125m-base.description: A 125.8M-parameter LLaMA-architecture decoder-only language model **pretrained from scratch** on a legal/financial-heavy corpus (~2.0B tokens: ~40% US case-law, ~40% SEC filings, ~20% educational web text).

zyoralabs/AQ-academic-ai.description: **AQ (Academic Quotient) — India's Concept-First Academic AI. v1 now live.** *Raising the Academic Quotient of every student.*

applegrew/support-125M-slm-base.description: A **125M parameter Llama-style language model** trained from scratch on ~2.6B tokens of curated IT support and technical data. This is the **base (pretrained)** model — it completes text but does not follow instructions.

sarathi-balakrishnan/tiny-sql-gpt.description: > **The goal:** build a language model from scratch, end to end, small enough to understand every > part of it, and in doing so understand how the large ones actually work.

alpharomercoma/slm-pipeline-151m.description: A 151M-parameter language model trained **from scratch** through every stage of the modern pipeline — pre-training → mid-training → SFT → DPO → RLVR/GRPO — on **one H100 in 20 hours 20 minutes**. Every stage is plain PyTorch: no TRL, no `Trainer`, every loss written out.

SMLBuilder/cobol-jeeves-sml.description: > ⚠️ **PROTOTYPE / research artifact — read the Honesty section before citing any > number.** This is a *method demonstration*, not a working COBOL author and not a > generalization result. It was adversarially reviewed (Claude, Codex, GLM) and the > framing below is the corrected, honest version after that review.

navyam-ai/navya-1b.description: **Navya** is an India-first financial foundation model family, trained **from scratch** on an India-first corpus (finance + English + Hindi/Hinglish and other Indian languages), custom 64k tokenizer.

navyam-ai/navya-1b-sft-v9.description: **Navya** is an India-first financial foundation model family, trained **from scratch** on an India-first corpus (finance + English + Hindi/Hinglish and other Indian languages), custom 64k tokenizer.

riccorl/Minerva-3B-base-v1.0-Q4_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`sapienzanlp/Minerva-3B-base-v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-3B-base-v1.0) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. VaiTon/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0-Q8_0-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`sapienzanlp/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-1B-base-v1.0) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Chem-v1-15M.description: The Mistral-Chem-v1-15M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative chemical molecule model with 1.9M parameters x 8 experts = 15.2M parameters. It is derived from Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 model, which was simplified for molecules: the number of layers and the hidden size were reduced. The model was pretrained using 10M molecule SMILES strings from the PubChem database.

tradebetter/Qwen2-0.5B.description: Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters, including a Mixture-of-Experts model. This repo contains the 0.5B Qwen2 base language model.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-0.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

galeio-research/OceanSAR-1-tengeop.description: OceanSAR-1-TenGeoP is a linear probing head for classifying ocean geophysical phenomena, built on top of the OceanSAR-1 foundation model. It leverages the powerful features extracted by OceanSAR-1 to accurately identify 10 different geophysical phenomena in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery.

soda-research/discrete-audio-isoflop-1.8.description: A suite of discrete audio models trained for our IsoFLOP study as part of **SODA**, which is a unified next-token prediction on interleaved semantic, acoustic, and text tokens.

IQuestLab/IQuest-UBio-MolFM-V1.description: UBio-MolFM is a foundation model suite for molecular modeling, specifically designed for bio-systems. Refer to the technique report for more details: **UBio-MolFM** ([arXiv:2602.17709](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17709)).

Siddharth63/medul2-base.description: **PubMedUL2** and **MedUL2** are a family of **domain-specific UL2/T5-style encoder–decoder language models** pretrained on large-scale biomedical and medical corpora using the **UL2 (Mixture-of-Denoisers)** objective.

claudios/cubert-20210711-Python-1024.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_1024](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_1024). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 1024 token context window on the Python BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

facebook/hiera-small-224-mae-hf.description: **Hiera** is a _hierarchical_ vision transformer that is fast, powerful, and, above all, _simple_. It was introduced in the paper [Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without the Bells-and-Whistles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00989/) and outperforms the state-of-the-art across a wide array of image and video tasks _while being much faster_.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-large-fi-lp-cont-pt.description: The large model pre-trained on 16kHz sampled speech audio with [facebook/wav2vec2-large-uralic-voxpopuli-v2](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-large-uralic-voxpopuli-v2) used as a foundation model for continued pre-training. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.

GetmanY1/wav2vec2-base-FS.description: <!-- Provide a quick summary of what the model is/does. -->

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-e2e-extra-weak.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

EleutherAI/deep-ignorance-pretraining-st.description: We explore an intuitive yet understudied question: Can we prevent LLMs from learning unsafe technical capabilities (such as CBRN) by filtering out enough of the relevant pretraining data before we begin training a model? Research into this question resulted in the **Deep Ignorance Suite**. In our experimental setup, we find that filtering pretraining data prevents undesirable knowledge, doesn't sacrifice general performance, and results in models that are resistant to tampering.

JeasLee/cronusvla_7B_libero_object.description: - checkpoints/*.pt: Complete model checkpoint of **CronusVLA-7B** for direct evaluation on **Libero-object**. It only conditions on the textual instruction and a third-person image **(no wrist-view image and no state)**.

iamshnoo/combined_without_metadata_1b.description: This repo contains the global combined model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

kavinrajkrupsurge/minivla-vq-bridge-pris.description: This checkpoint is in a format that is compatible with the training script from the original [Prismatic VLMs project codebase](https://github.com/TRI-ML/prismatic-vlms), which the OpenVLA team built on top of to develop the OpenVLA model.

stellaathena/qwen3-0.6b-sweep-ot0.25-psn.description: A 751M-parameter Qwen3-0.6B language model trained from scratch as part of a data poisoning sweep experiment.

stellaathena/qwen3-0.6b-sweep-ot4.0-psn1.description: A 751M-parameter Qwen3-0.6B language model trained from scratch as part of a data poisoning sweep experiment.

iamshnoo/combined_without_metadata_3b_st.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

onnx-community/mms-300m-ONNX.description: This is an ONNX version of [facebook/mms-300m](https://huggingface.co/facebook/mms-300m). It was automatically converted and uploaded using [this Hugging Face Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/onnx-community/convert-to-onnx).

oddadmix/Emhotob-25M.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **25M** rung of the ladder (~25.27M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe.

laion/open-sci-ref-1.7b-nemotron-hq-100B.description: 16k long-context extension of `laion/open-sci-ref-v0.02-1.7b-nemotron-hq-100B-4096`. Final train loss **0.9778**.

JupiterZhu/T2MLR_135M_lstart13_lend18_10.description: **T2MLR** (Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence) applies a recurrent connection across a contiguous band of middle layers, carrying a recurrent state between token positions. This checkpoint is a 135M model pretrained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu for **~10B tokens**.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-ru-v4.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Russian bilingual data, 133,600 total steps (v4 run). Uses a shared 65k English-Russian tokenizer (`65k_en1.0_ru1.0`).

itarutomy/llm_workshop_hands_on_gpt-mode.description: 本モデルはチュートリアル「[Let's develop LLMs from scratch](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1g-KjfRWoR4OehKr8FY5MSuFO2etCUf1L)」から学習した小型GPTモデルです。

jasonacox/nanochat-560M-pretrain.description: Base pretrained model on FineWeb-EDU dataset. This model has learned basic language patterns but hasn't been trained for conversation.

yashshinde0080/zeronet-1-28M.description: A **28 million parameter** decoder-only causal Transformer language model **built entirely from scratch** — no pretrained weights, no fine-tuned checkpoints, no API wrappers.

sathishphdai/legal-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Legal domain data. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE.

SykoSLM/SykoLLM-V4.8-Beta.description: > **⚠️ Uyarı / Disclaimer:** Bu model şu anda aktif bir **test ve araştırma aşamasındadır**. Temel amacı, yeni nesil **Phi-3** mimarisinin yeteneklerini sıfırdan eğitilmiş (trained from scratch) bir yapıyla küçük ölçekte test etmektir. Üretime (production) hazır bir model değildir; halüsinasyon görebilir, mantıksal hatalar yapabilir veya beklenmedik yanıtlar verebilir.

sathishphdai/hr-manager-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.3M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **HR Manager** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/database-admin-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1007.5M params, ~1.01B) trained from scratch for the **Database Admin** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/education-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~33.9M params) trained from scratch on Education domain data. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE.

sathishphdai/hr-manager-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.3M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **HR Manager** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

jasonacox/jason-d24-880M-chat.description: A character model trained to mimic **Jason A. Cox**. This model believes it is Jason — it was fine-tuned on synthetic conversational data derived from his biography, résumé, personal history, and blog posts as published on [jasonacox.com](https://jasonacox.com). Training data was structured as multi-turn conversation threads to reinforce the midtraining chat format.

Ethangou/attention-residuals-0.6B-full.description: This is the 0.6B Full Attention Residuals checkpoint for the attention-residuals-reproduction project. It uses a Qwen3-style decoder-only Transformer with full Attention Residuals, trained from scratch on Chinese data.

vukrosic/nano-g2p.description: Spells out how a word is pronounced — `though` → `DH OW`, `tough` → `T AH F`, `through` → `TH R UW`, `cough` → `K AA F`. English spelling is famously **not phonetic** (`though`/`tough`/`through`/`cough`/`rough`/`bough` — six different sounds from `-ough`), so no rule does this; pronunciation lives only in a learned lexicon. A **~1M-parameter (1,016,960) byte-level transformer** that learns grapheme→phoneme patterns and generalises to words it never saw.

emrevrg/Norovox-Alpha.description: Norovox Alpha, random-init ile eğitilmiş özgün `NorovoxAlphaCore` mimarisine ve kendi 32k BPE tokenizer'ına sahip deneysel bir Türkçe yapay zekâ çekirdeğidir. Qwen/Llama sınıfı veya başka bir modelin ağırlık kopyası değildir. Güncel kanonik SFT checkpoint'i **151.641.856 parametre** ve **step 67.740** düzeyindedir.

sahuabinash/slm-125m-base.description: A 125.8M-parameter LLaMA-architecture causal language model, pretrained from scratch on a legal/financial/general-web corpus.

weights-and-wires/audio8-tts-from-scratc.description: A **DualAR text-to-speech language model trained from scratch** on 440 clips (72.6 minutes) of LibriSpeech `clean/train.100`, 4 speaker(s).

christianrss/chris-gpt-2-124m-GGUF.description: GGUF export of **Chris-GPT-2 124M**, a GPT-2-style causal language model trained from scratch on approximately **10 billion tokens from FineWeb-Edu**.

Magurofg/pocket-lm-269m-executor.description: Pré-treino **do zero** (286M efetivos, 12h de H100, 7,0 bi de tokens) com a fase de decay dominada por **ações de celular** (intenção + campos estruturados). Nome interno `full-executor-v1`.

MenteEAI/mentee-embed-v3.description: **A 41M-parameter trilingual text embedding model trained entirely from scratch — no pretrained backbone, no BERT, no RoBERTa. Random initialization only.**

ryze-ai/flash-archer-150M-2.0.description: A clean, decoder-only transformer language model trained **from scratch** on **FineWeb-Edu** — 150M parameters, ~2.1B tokens, on a single Tesla T4 in ~7 hours. Built as a self-contained, reproducible pretraining project: custom byte-level BPE tokenizer, streaming data pipeline, cosine LR schedule with warmup, and a hand-written PyTorch training loop.

navyam-ai/navya-1c.description: **Navya** is an India-first financial foundation model family, trained **from scratch** on an India-first corpus (finance + English + Hindi/Hinglish and other Indian languages), custom 64k tokenizer.

ApyHTML19/Cgi_Model_9M.description: Modèle transformer entraîné from scratch sur le Code Général des Impôts (CGI) 2026 français. Architecture custom (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, attention causale) — voir `config.json` pour les hyperparamètres et le dépôt source pour le code du modèle (`CGITransformer`).

hiianish/mini-gpt2_decoder.description: A small GPT-style decoder-only transformer, trained from scratch.

bugrayildirim/story-to-music-analyzer.description: `google/mt5-small`'un Türkçe metinleri **Suno** ve **Udio** için müzik parametrelerine çeviren fine-tuned versiyonu. [Story-to-Music MCP](https://github.com/sbugrayy/story-to-music) projesinin "Analyzer" bileşeni.

ajesujoba/AfriHuBERT-large.description: This is a 300M+ parameter multilingual self-supervised speech encoder based on the English HuBERT-L model, facebook/hubert-large-ll60k. Undi95/Mistral-11B-RP-v1.description: This is Mistral, but in 11B, and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

LoneStriker/Mistral-11B-CC-Air-RP-4.0bpw.description: CollectiveCognition-v1.1-Mistral-7B and airoboros-mistral2.2-7b glued together and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

LoneStriker/Mistral-11B-CC-Air-RP-5.0bpw.description: CollectiveCognition-v1.1-Mistral-7B and airoboros-mistral2.2-7b glued together and finetuned with qlora of Pippa and LimaRPv3 dataset.

RiversHaveWings/Mistral-7B-v0.1-safetens.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

joaovitor2763/mistral-sdr-model.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

pblair-basis/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: **NOTE**: This is a fork of [Mistral-7B-v0.1](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1) intended to have a non-null pad token. anonymneurips2027/PIT-4B-FT-201712.description: Point-In-Time (PIT) is a family of GPT-style language models trained on chronologically-ordered monthly snapshots of FineWeb. Each checkpoint captures the state of knowledge available up to a specific month, making them suitable for temporal reasoning and point-in-time analysis tasks.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-doc_clean.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.
