This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-4](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-4). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

Seed 4 intermediate checkpoint 80k MultiBERTs (pretrained BERT) model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.16163.pdf) and first released in [this repository](https://github.com/google-research/language/tree/master/language/multiberts). This is an intermediate checkpoint. The final checkpoint can be found at [multiberts-seed-4](https://hf.co/multberts-seed-4). This model is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

castorini/azbert-base.description: Here we share a pretrained BERT model that is aware of math tokens. The math tokens are treated specially and tokenized using [pya0](https://github.com/approach0/pya0), which adds very limited new tokens for latex markup (total vocabulary is just 31,061).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-hr-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **hr** on **8.1k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

facebook/wav2vec2-base-sk-voxpopuli-v2.description: [Facebook's Wav2Vec2](https://ai.facebook.com/blog/wav2vec-20-learning-the-structure-of-speech-from-raw-audio/) base model pretrained only in **sk** on **12.1k** unlabeled datat of the [VoxPopuli corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00390).

loodos/electra-small-turkish-uncased-dis.description: As R&D Team at Loodos, we release cased and uncased versions of most recent language models for Turkish. More details about pretrained models and evaluations on downstream tasks can be found [here (our repo)](https://github.com/Loodos/turkish-language-models).

toastynews/electra-hongkongese-base-disc.description: ELECTRA trained exclusively with data from Hong Kong. A signaficant amount of Hongkongese/Cantonese/Yue is included in the training data.

approach0/backbone-bertnsp-600.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

approach0/dpr-bertnsp-520.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

approach0/dpr-cotbert-120.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

approach0/splade_somemath-cocomae-220.description: This [repository](https://github.com/approach0/azbert) is a boilerplate to push a mask-filling model to the HuggingFace Model Hub.

kul-speech-lab/wav2vec2-xls-r-1b-lay10.description: This repository contains the [wav2vec2 XLS-R 1B](https://huggingface.co/facebook/wav2vec2-xls-r-1b) model truncated to 10 layers.

claudios/cubert-20210711-Python-2048.description: This model is the unofficial HuggingFace version of "[CuBERT](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/cubert)". In particular, this version comes from [gs://cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_2048](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/cubert/20210711_Python/pre_trained_model_epochs_2__length_2048). It was trained 2021-07-11 for 2 epochs with a 2048 token context window on the Python BigQuery dataset. I manually converted the Tensorflow checkpoint to PyTorch and have uploaded it here. The [tokenizer](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/cubert/python_tokenizer.py) has not been converted yet. All credit goes to Aditya Kanade, Petros Maniatis, Gogul Balakrishnan, and Kensen Shi.

JeasLee/cronusvla_7B_libero_goal.description: - checkpoints/*.pt: Complete model checkpoint of **CronusVLA-7B** for direct evaluation on **Libero-goal**. It only conditions on the textual instruction and a third-person image **(no wrist-view image and no state)**.

iamshnoo/africa_with_metadata_1b.description: This repo contains the africa 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

Wenxuan123/capvector.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. The model takes language instructions and camera images as input and generates robot actions. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

iamshnoo/combined_only_country_with_meta.description: This repo contains the country 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_america_with_metada.description: This repo contains the leave out america 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_europe_with_metadat.description: This repo contains the leave out europe 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_africa_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out africa 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_continent_wit.description: This repo contains the url continent 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_url_country_with_.description: This repo contains the url country 1b step2k model exported from the 2k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_1b_step4.description: This repo contains the global combined model exported from the 4k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-ar.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Arabic bilingual data, ~42k steps.

nazdef/gpt2medium-en-it-nanochat-gpt2pre.description: This repository publishes the **best scalar checkpoint** from the medium GPT2PreLN anchor20k run evaluated in the full repo-native sweep currently recorded in this workspace.

nazdef/gpt2small-en-it-nanochat-gpt2prel.description: This repository packages the current **best continual-pretraining checkpoint before any decay-only extraction** in the small GPT2PreLN EN/IT line.

JupiterZhu/T2MLR_362M_lstart9_lend24_50B.description: **T2MLR** (Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence) applies a recurrent connection across a contiguous band of middle layers, carrying a recurrent state between token positions. This checkpoint is a 362M model pretrained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu for **~51.5B tokens**.

JupiterZhu/T2MLR_982M_lstart9_lend24_50B.description: **T2MLR** (Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence) applies a recurrent connection across a contiguous band of middle layers, carrying a recurrent state between token positions. This checkpoint is a 982M model pretrained **from scratch** on FineWeb-Edu for **~51.5B tokens**.

jasonacox/jason-nanochat-560M-midtrain.description: Midtrained model fine-tuned for conversational interactions. Trained on SmolTalk dataset with special tokens for multi-turn conversations. Added identity conditioning with persona data from jasonacox.com blog posts.

hranjan043/simbot-gpt-level1.description: SimBot GPT is a **from-scratch GPT-style language model** implemented in **PyTorch**. This project is focused on **learning LLM internals**, not on instruction tuning or production use.

sathishphdai/uiux-designer-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.3M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **UI/UX Designer** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/customer-support-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.0M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Customer Support** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

AbstractPhil/geolip-vit-base-x3.description: This wasn't meant to be seen by others, but it's too damn messy so there you go. I can't keep rewriting the same explanations over and over to justify the empirical data here.

shreyask/fineweb-gpt-scratch.description: A GPT-style language model trained completely from scratch as a learning exercise. Every component was written from scratch: BPE tokenizer, transformer architecture, and training loop.

way2hemanthkumar/indian-slm-hindi-30m.description: A LLaMA-style decoder-only language model trained from scratch on Hindi text.

saiteja718/gpt-2.description: A GPT-2–style causal language model built and trained **entirely from scratch** in PyTorch — no pre-trained weights, no HuggingFace Trainer. Every component (multi-head attention with KV-cache, transformer blocks, weight-tying) was implemented by hand.

Sqersters/vuaf-1-femto.description: > ⚠️ **Experimental research checkpoint — under active development.** > This model is a small from-scratch architecture exploration. Outputs > may be incoherent, biased, or wrong. Do **not** use it for anything > serious. Treat every release as a snapshot of work in progress.

jokernifty/Krix1-0.2b.description: A ~122M-parameter (≈0.2B) **Llama-style decoder, pretrained from scratch** on Hindi text. Every weight was trained from random initialization — this is not a fine-tune of an existing model.

danelcsb/localagent-tiny-30m-byte.description: A **28M-parameter, pretrained-from-scratch, byte-level** agent for tool dispatch. Selection is **generable** (no fixed-N classifier): a 5-way **route head** gates modality, a **dense two-tower selector** scores *any* tool by its description embedding, and a **pointer head** copies argument values from the prompt. 50-tool surface. Trained on a corrected, paraphrase-rich + referent- conditioned dataset ([danelcsb/localagent-dispatch-data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/danelcsb/localagent-dispatch-data)).

Rohanify/PyBlissa-Coder-40M-GGUF.description: PyBlissa-Coder-40M is the second model from the PyBlissa-Coder family that mainly supports python coding. Despite its small footprint, 40M parameters, trained on 272M tokens, PyBlissa has achieved an amazing score of 14.6% on the HumanEval dataset; and 4.4% on MBPP dataset (both being benchmark datasets). While scoring such a good number, it's imperfections are also something to be aware of. This model can sometimes generate wrong, inefficient, or broken codes. Though its mostly temperature-dependent.

tonibirat/neBrahma-base-58m.description: A 58M-parameter Nepali decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** on 1.16B tokens of Nepali text. This is the P3 base model for the neBrahma FYP project - a unified Nepali text+audio system targeting ASR and TTS.

helloadhavan/llara2-100M-base.description: license: apache-2.0 datasets: - wikimedia/structured-wikipedia - helloadhavan/github_issues - helloadhavan/python-docstrings language: - en tags: - from-scratch - gpt2

Batman55072/NanoChat-28M-V1.description: A ~27.8M parameter GPT-style decoder-only transformer, trained fully from scratch, that generates simulated live-stream chat comments -- both regular fast-paced "hype chat" and rarer, longer "superchat"-style paid messages/questions. Built to run fast on CPU, as a lightweight audience-simulation layer for AI VTuber / livestream projects.

shreyash-pandey-katni/phoenix-350m-base.description: A **350M-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch** on **~10B tokens** of [FineWeb-Edu](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu), on a single consumer GPU (RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GB). Released as a **base model** (no instruction tuning).

pranay-aggarwal/mcq-scratch-lstm-transfo.description: A custom multiple-choice QA model built from scratch (no pretrained backbone) for the Smart MCQ Solver Challenge on Kaggle.

pngwn/memcap-m-near-capacity.description: Part of a tiny-scale reproduction of **[How much do language models memorize?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24832)** (Morris et al., ICML 2026 honorable mention): GPT-style models trained from scratch on uniformly random token sequences, where generalization is impossible and every bit of loss reduction is memorization.

Atharva1232/Qwen3-0.6B-GRPO-GSM8K.description: A Qwen3-0.6B base model that learned to solve grade-school math word problems — **without ever being shown a single worked solution.** Trained with GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) written from scratch in ~150 lines of plain PyTorch, no TRL, on one free Kaggle T4 in 3.2 hours.

RaphaelMourad/Mistral-Codon-v1-117M.description: The Mistral-Codon-v1-117M Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative DNA sequence model with 117M parameters. Ericu950/Stoicheia-fold-2.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

RISS01/openvla-7b-serbot.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. iamshnoo/combined_with_metadata_3b.description: This repo contains the global combined model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_only_continent_with_me.description: This repo contains the continent 1b model at the final 10k-step checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

iamshnoo/combined_no_europe_without_meta.description: This repo contains the leave out europe 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

atrost/climbmix-matformer-353m-1p2b-h100.description: MatFormer-style nested Llama pretrained from scratch on `nvidia/Nemotron-ClimbMix`.

AlexWortega/ml-intern-moe100m-ufweb-en-s.description: This is the **final ckpt** from a 100B-token continuation pretrain of the model, **stopped gracefully at step 131778** (≈ 21.59 B tokens consumed total counting the 1B and 10B warm-start phases). The originally- planned 100B target was abandoned because the held-out eval loss had flatlined at **2.91** for the last ~3.3B of training tokens — the model became data-limited on the Ultra-FineWeb-en slice well before the planned end of the run.

yusufizzetmurat/finbert-fed-adjacent.description: Artefact for the [fed-pulse](https://github.com/yusufizzetmurat/fed-pulse) FOMC text analytics project.

nazdef/gpt2medium-en-it-nanochat-gpt2pre.description: This repository publishes the requested **ordinary checkpoint release** for `step_14700`, the current **best practical / release-style candidate** inside the replayed medium GPT2PreLN `13.5k` decay family.

whilework/rubert-tiny2.description: This is an updated version of [cointegrated/rubert-tiny](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny): a small Russian BERT-based encoder with high-quality sentence embeddings. This [post in Russian](https://habr.com/ru/post/669674/) gives more details.

oddadmix/Emhotob-1M.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **1M** rung of the ladder (~1.07M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe.

oddadmix/Emhotob-500K-v2.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **500K** rung of the ladder (~518K parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe. This is the **v2** run: trained from scratch on ~5B tokens per model.

oddadmix/Emhotob-10M-v2.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **10M** rung of the ladder (~10.95M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe. This is the **v2** run: trained from scratch on ~5B tokens per model.

joey00072/ohara-moe-base-d12.description: The **pretrained mixture-of-experts base model** from a nanochat-style run with [ohara](https://github.com/joey00072/ohara). 332M total parameters, 85M active per token, trained from scratch on 1.48B tokens of ClimbMix on 2xA100-80GB in 2.35 hours.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-ru-v3.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Russian bilingual data, 133,600 total steps (v3 run). Uses a shared 65k English-Russian tokenizer (`65k_en1.0_ru1.0`).

11-47/Mini.Deep.Thinker.11m.description: A small decoder-only causal language model trained from scratch with deep chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities.

sathishphdai/project-manager-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.0M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Project Manager** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sebastianbachmaier/Model5.description: Model5 is a **~529M parameter Llama-style decoder-only transformer**, implemented and trained from scratch (no `AutoModel` base — architecture, pretraining loop, and SFT loop are all custom code), then converted to a standard HuggingFace `LlamaForCausalLM` checkpoint for distribution. Broikos/bslm-72m-v1.description: A small language model built **entirely from scratch**: no pretrained weights, no Hugging Face base model, no distillation. Every parameter starts from random init and is trained on a corpus the project generates itself. It is a bilingual (English and Greek) everyday assistant that understands a fixed task list and then performs the tasks by calling tools, rather than trying to memorise facts.

faiz4320/cifar10-resnet50-scratch.description: A ten-class image classifier using a custom CIFAR-style ResNet50-v1 architecture with 3-4-6-3 bottleneck stages, a 3×3 stride-1 stem, no initial max pool, global average pooling and a softmax head. The model is the author's own training and is released under MIT.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-2.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

tt1225/openvla-7b-devel.description: OpenVLA 7B (`openvla-7b`) is an open vision-language-action model trained on 970K robot manipulation episodes from the [Open X-Embodiment](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/) dataset. The model takes language instructions and camera images as input and generates robot actions. It supports controlling multiple robots out-of-the-box, and can be quickly adapted for new robot domains via (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning.

rocky1410/haipai-micro.description: **Haipai-micro** is a "Micro-LLM" designed to test the limits of parameter efficiency. Despite having only **55 Million parameters** (roughly 1/2 the size of GPT-2 Small), it achieves surprising performance on common sense and reasoning benchmarks by utilizing a high-density dataset mix.

atrost/climbmix-baseline-large-353m-1p2b.description: Dense untied Llama baseline trained on 1.2B tokens from nvidia/Nemotron-ClimbMix.

atrost/climbmix-baseline-small-asymmetri.description: Exact-shape asymmetric nested baseline trained on 1.2B tokens from nvidia/Nemotron-ClimbMix.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-translated-ar-134.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English and translated Arabic data, 134k steps.

nazdef/20260703_continual-pretraining-gp.description: This is an **ordinary checkpoint release** from the main medium continual-pretraining run. It is **not a separately launched decay-only branch**. It is published as a reference candidate for the future `1gpu-llm-medium-v2` release; it is not yet that definitive release.

oddadmix/Emhotob-5M.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **5M** rung of the ladder (~5.08M parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-ru-v2.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English-Russian bilingual data, 134k steps (injection fix v2).

11-47/FrontD.11m.description: FrontD.11m is an approximately 11-million-parameter decoder-only language model trained completely from scratch.

cooler8/yejin-korean-3b-v1-base.description: > **yejin-korean-3b-v1**은 8x NVIDIA H200 (1,128GB VRAM) 환경에서 한국어 고품질 코퍼스(172GB+ 및 AI Hub)로 100% From-Scratch 사전학습 및 8x H200 GPU Full SFT를 적용한 한국어 파운데이션 모델입니다.

Finisha-LLM/Limy-basique.description: `Limy-basique` est un modèle de classification de texte conçu pour différencier les questions sur les capitales de celles sur les animaux. Entraîné sur le jeu de données `Clem27sey/Nacid`, ce modèle a été entièrement construit **`from scratch`** par Clemylia. Il est idéal pour les tâches de classification binaire et peut être utilisé en tant que base pour des projets similaires.

likhonsheikh/Sheikh-ABF.description: **Sheikh-ABF** is a state-of-the-art, **decoder-only Transformer language model for Bangla NLP**, developed entirely **from scratch**. This project emphasizes a **Bangla-first approach**, focusing on the unique linguistic and cultural aspects of the Bengali language. The name 'Sheikh' explicitly refers to its origin as a model developed in **Bangladesh**, aiming to provide a foundational LLM for the region.

surazbhandari/miniembed.description: **MiniEmbed** is an ultra-compact text embedding model (Bi-Encoder) built entirely from scratch in PyTorch. No HuggingFace Transformers, no pre-trained weights -- just pure PyTorch.

Entity-27th/opus-1.5-Q4_K_M-GGUF.description: This model was converted to GGUF format from [`opus-research/opus-1.5`](https://huggingface.co/opus-research/opus-1.5) using llama.cpp via the ggml.ai's [GGUF-my-repo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ggml-org/gguf-my-repo) space. Refer to the [original model card](https://huggingface.co/opus-research/opus-1.5) for more details on the model.

nishantup/nanogpt-slm-124m.description: A small language model trained **from scratch** using a custom nanoGPT implementation. Pretrained on 133 classic English fiction novels from Project Gutenberg.

sathishphdai/financial-analyst-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.0M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Financial Analyst** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/system-admin-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~1016.6M params, ~1.02B) trained from scratch for the **System Admin** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

shreyash-pandey-katni/sweta-125m-multili.description: Sweta-125M is a decoder-only multilingual language model trained from scratch.

Ghostgim/GhostLM.description: A small cybersecurity language model trained from scratch. Not a fine-tune of an existing base — every parameter learned on a curated security corpus. Currently shipping the v0.5.0 chat-tuned variant of `ghost-small`.

FiShota/hinomoto-1b-bitnet158-v1.description: HinoMoto-1B v1 Phase 2 Full の **BitNet b1.58 量子化版**. 重みを 三値 (= 1.58 bit/weight) に置換 後、 500 step QAT で 品質回復.

geoppls/rwkv7-147m-early-modern-english.description: A 147M parameter RWKV-7 language model trained **exclusively on Early Modern English text** from the Text Creation Partnership (TCP) corpus: 60,172 documents spanning 1473–1800, including EEBO (Early English Books Online), ECCO, and Evans-TCP.

DuoNeural/native-refusal-25pct-50m.description: Part of the **Native Refusal Geometry** experiment series. DuoNeural 2026-06-07 | Archon, Jesse Caldwell, Aura

sfanm/d24-sft-v3-olmo3-10b-wholedoc.description: v3 SFT chat model — 50B ClimbMix base + 10B whole-doc OLMo-3 midtrain (2x the 5B corpus).

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v1-sft.description: The V1 base model further trained with supervised fine-tuning to follow instructions and respond conversationally.

chetanxpatil/noun-collapse.description: Word embeddings learned with **nothing but a collapse dynamical system** — no MLP, no attention, no output layer, no pretrained embeddings. The entire model is **one 256-d well per word, a start state, and two scalars** (pull strength, readout temperature). ~25.6M numbers total; ~99% of them are the well table.

nocaps/amoresignal-encoder.description: **AmoreSignal reads free-form text — a bio, a chat message, a written reflection — and identifies the psychological and relational patterns present in it.** It doesn't just classify text; it generates a ranked, structured list of what it detects, one signal at a time, each with a strength (how present the trait is) and a confidence score (how sure the model is).

samueljayasingh/rune-0.3b-base.description: A ~351M parameter decoder-only transformer, pretrained from scratch on general web text. This is stage 1 of the Rune-R1 pipeline (**Pretrain → SFT → GRPO**) and serves as the foundation for [Rune-R1-SFT](https://huggingface.co/samueljayasingh/Rune-R1-sft) and [Rune-R1](https://huggingface.co/samueljayasingh/Rune-R1) (the final GRPO reasoning model). On its own, it is a general-purpose next-token predictor with no instruction-following or chat behavior.

quik-models/efficient-monkey-120.description: **AutoResearch-multivision-depth8** is a **77.6M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **multivision**.

quik-models/elated-frost-137.description: **AutoResearch-multivision-depth10** is a **131.0M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **multivision**.

Ericu950/Stoicheia-fold-1.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

On LIBERO-90 it lowers trajectory jerk by **~7–8%** (position jerk 20.28 → 18.82 m/s³; rotation jerk 4.79 → 4.39 rad/s³) while keeping task success within run-to-run noise of the base model — a reproducible, statistically significant smoothness gain across 3 training seeds.

atrost/climbmix-llama-288m-2p8b-h100-sav.description: Small Llama-style causal language model pretrained from scratch on `nvidia/Nemotron-ClimbMix`.

kyLELEng/adaptive-retro-gpt-1b.description: Adaptive-RETRO-GPT-1B is a RETRO-inspired retrieval-pretrained decoder-only language model. AlexWortega/moe-200m-qwen3-step70000-2B-.description: Intermediate checkpoint from the in-flight `moe-200m-qwen3-100b` pretrain run, captured at **step 70 000 ≈ 2.4 B tokens consumed** (2.4 % of the 100B-token budget). nazdef/1gpu-llm-medium-en-it-base-v2.description: Official medium bilingual base model of the `1gpu-llm` family, trained from scratch and continued on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti 16GB.

oddadmix/Emhotob-500K.description: **Emhotob** is a family of small Arabic language models pretrained **from scratch** on Arabic web text. This is the **500K** rung of the ladder (~518K parameters), part of a scaling series ranging from 500K to 25M parameters that all share the same tokenizer, context length, and training recipe.

scottgeng00/qwen3-0.6b-dclm-20b.description: A 0.6B-parameter (595.8M, tied embeddings) model with the Qwen3-0.6B architecture and tokenizer, pretrained from random initialization on ~20.0B tokens of DCLM (the `dclm` source of the OLMo 2 Dolmino mix) with [lingua](https://github.com/facebookresearch/lingua). This is a research baseline, not an instruction-tuned model.

sathishphdai/software-engineer-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.9M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Software Engineer** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/product-manager-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.1M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Product Manager** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

sathishphdai/product-manager-slm-5m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.1M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Product Manager** role. Supports up to **5M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

prskid1000/micro-Omni.description: A from-scratch **multimodal AI** that handles text + images + audio (in and out) on a single GPU. Inspired by Qwen3 Omni's Thinker-Talker architecture.

MonumentalSystems/wire-2m-chinchilla.description: WireNative 2M — Chinchilla-scaled training run, best BPB 1.97

EphAsad/BactoTiny-Seq-86M.description: **A from-scratch BERT-style encoder trained on bacterial 16S rRNA sequences for sequence representation learning and genus-group classification.**

endurasolution/RON-110M.description: A 110M-parameter GPT-style language model trained from scratch on a single RTX 3090. Pretrained on WikiText-103, then fine-tuned on CNN/DailyMail for extractive news summarization.

deepakdsoni/DPMM-0.1B-MoE.description: A 124.5M parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model trained from scratch with production-grade architecture techniques.

sfanm/d24-pretrain-v2-climbmix-13B.description: v2 from-scratch pretrained BASE LM (strong base).

alvarobrito/slm-gigaverbo.description: Modelo de linguagem causal treinado do zero em português brasileiro, parte da série "Criando seu próprio SLM do Zero" por Álvaro Brito.

korkmazumut/orkhon-bumin-mini.description: 4M unified assistant smoke model for EN/TR/Kokturk behavior.

krishang-raju/transformer-scratch-123M-w.description: A decoder-only transformer built entirely from first principles in PyTorch — every component (embeddings, RoPE, multi-head attention, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, output projection) implemented and numerically verified against reference math, then trained to convergence on WikiText-103. Accelerated with a hand-written, hand-derived CUDA attention kernel, verified correct to float32 precision.

ashishk1331/MDLM-TinyShakespeare.description: A **masked diffusion language model (MDLM)** trained from scratch on character-level TinyShakespeare. Unlike an autoregressive model, it generates text by **iterative denoising**: starting from an all-`[MASK]` sequence and refining it over multiple steps until fully unmasked, rather than left-to-right, one token at a time.

DavidCBaines/ebible_m2m-ms8-ie-shareable.description: A multilingual, from scratch encoder decoder transformer that translates verses of the Bible from a fixed Koine Greek source into many languages. It reproduces and extends the closed text translation experiment first carried out by Sami Liedes in 2018, replacing his convolutional sequence to sequence model with a modern transformer and adding quantitative evaluation. This checkpoint comes from the `ms8_ie_shareable` experiment.

quik-models/cosmic-energy-38.description: **AutoResearch-fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle-depth10** is a **122.6M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle**.

quik-models/curious-thunder-77.description: **AutoResearch-tinystories-depth8** is a **285.2M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **TinyStories (karpathy/tinystories-gpt4-clean)**.

quik-models/glad-dew-91.description: **AutoResearch-tinystories-depth8** is a **285.2M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **TinyStories (karpathy/tinystories-gpt4-clean)**.

ARotting/snip-0.09m-distilled.description: SNIP means **Small Neural Intelligence Prototype**. SNIP-0.4M is a deliberately tiny causal transformer designed to make the complete language-model lifecycle inspectable on ordinary hardware.

LGTEAMai/Nano-1.2-Lite-198M.description: A 198M parameter language model trained from scratch using a Decoder-only Transformer architecture (RoPE, GQA, SwiGLU, RMSNorm).

quik-models/distinctive-leaf-115.description: **AutoResearch-multivision-depth8** is a **77.6M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **multivision**.

quik-models/prime-fire-126.description: **AutoResearch-multivision-depth8** is a **77.6M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **multivision**.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-3.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

oooranz/TabWM.description: TabWM (Tabular World Model) is a relational world model introduced in *Relational Learning as World Modeling*. Given a few observed executions from a relational system, it predicts the structured edits that a new action makes to the database, without updating its parameters. The model is pretrained on WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds, and its encoder is initialized from the [RT-PluRel](https://huggingface.co/stanford-star/rt-plurel) Relational Transformer.

happyhappy-jun/gr00t-n1.6-uvd-racer-pt12.description: This is an independently trained **multitask pretraining (PT)** checkpoint based on [NVIDIA GR00T N1.6](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-3B). It is **not** an official NVIDIA release and **not** a target-task fine-tuned checkpoint.

castorini/gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-cli.description: The bidirectional variant of [`castorini/gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-20260924`](https://huggingface.co/castorini/gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-20260924), described in the pre-training section of ([PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.11922)). Our GPU budget did not allow a second pre-training run, so we obtained it by converting the causal model, following LLM2Vec: starting from the causal checkpoint at 245B tokens, we trained it on the remaining 42B tokens of the corpus with bidirectional attention and masked next-token prediction (MNTP). It is a base model; no instruction or embedding tuning has been applied.

vukrosic/nano-spell.description: Corrects a misspelled word to its intended word — `recieve` → `receive`, `teh` → `the`, `freind` → `friend`, `thier` → `their`. Which real word a typo most likely meant lives only in a frequency-weighted lexicon, so the obvious script (nearest dictionary word by edit distance) guesses wrong whenever the typo lands as close to another word. A **~1M-parameter (1,016,960) byte-level transformer**, trained 100% on code-generated data.

vukrosic/nano-proofread.description: Fixes the writing errors a spell-checker can't see — `their going to win` → `they're going to win`, `its raining again` → `it's raining again`, `the the cat sat` → `the cat sat`. The mistakes are **real words** (`their`/`there`/`they're` are all spelled correctly), so a spell-checker stays silent; which one is right depends on the surrounding words. A **~1M-parameter (1,016,960) byte-level transformer** that reads the context and picks.

DavidCBaines/ebible_m2m-ie-big-shareable.description: A multilingual, from scratch encoder decoder transformer that translates verses of the Bible from a fixed Koine Greek source into many languages. It reproduces and extends the closed text translation experiment first carried out by Sami Liedes in 2018, replacing his convolutional sequence to sequence model with a modern transformer and adding quantitative evaluation. This checkpoint comes from the `ie_big_shareable` experiment.

quik-models/lemon-puddle-39.description: **AutoResearch-fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle-depth12** is a **185.6M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle**.

quik-models/faithful-bee-70.description: **AutoResearch-opencaption-finegrained-clone-depth8** is a **98.2M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **opencaption-finegrained-clone**.

BytesTalk/PersonaMini-1-big.description: A from-scratch roleplay language model by **BytesTalk**. Not a fine-tune of anything — every weight was trained from random initialization on a GPU (GeForce RTX 4090, 24 GB). Efficient-Large-Model/Qwen2-OV-SI-72B.description: Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-5.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

Asilarkness/budgie-100m.description: 100M-param ablation checkpoint of budgie-1b (parrot-themed from-scratch reasoning LLM). Base pretrain, 12 layers x 768 d_model, GQA 12Q/3KV, hybrid sliding-window+global attention, QK-norm, value-residual, partial RoPE, tied embeddings. Trained 7629 steps on ~3B tokens (Muon + AdamW, WSD schedule).

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-4.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

Sejibeji/tso-foundation-v17.description: **Time is geometry.** The Time-Series Operator (TSO) is a foundation model that learns the *shape* of dynamical systems instead of token-chunking numbers. Pretraining uses four self-supervised pretexts — reconstruction, Koopman-linear dynamics, scale covariance (a renormalization leg), and the arrow of time — on 40 series across 8 domains (electricity grids, meteorology, ECG, finance, epidemiology, economics, solar physics, chaotic systems). Transfer to a never-seen series is a **closed-form Koopman fit on the frozen latent**: zero gradient steps.

This repo contains the url 1b step8k model exported from the 8k checkpoint for the metadata localization project. It was trained from scratch on the project corpus, using the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and vocabulary.

Saminx22/MedSLM.description: A **381M parameter** transformer language model pre-trained on curated medical text from PubMed abstracts, PMC full-text articles, and clinical guidelines.

MohammedSabry/biinduct-125m-induction.description: This repository contains the **Bi-Induct 125M Induction** checkpoint from *Induction Signatures Are Not Enough: A Matched-Compute Study of Load-Bearing Structure in In-Context Learning*.

Itaking/itakura-300m-pretrain-model.description: OLMo-2 アーキテクチャを ~300M に縮小してランダム初期化から事前学習したモデル。

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en1-en2-codeswitchin.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English bilingual data with code-switching, 34k steps.

procmarco/pina-500m.description: A **536M**-parameter decoder-only language model for **Italian + English + code**, trained from scratch. This is an **early / partial base-model checkpoint** — about **9.19B tokens** (~23% of a planned 40B-token base run) — released for inspection.

Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runA-zh-fir.description: A 1.7B-parameter bilingual (English + Chinese) language model, part of a **controlled language-ordering study**. Three models share the *same* architecture, initialization, total data diet (50B English + 50B Chinese = 100B tokens), and LR schedule; they differ **only** in the order in which the two languages are presented during pretraining. This is the **Chinese-first** run.

Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runD-zh30-e.description: A 1.7B-parameter bilingual (English + Chinese) language model trained with a **purely sequential monolingual curriculum**: all of one language, then all of the other. This is the **Chinese-first sequential (zh30->en70)** run, part of a controlled language-ordering study. Companion blended-curriculum runs (50/50 diet, 3-phase) live at `Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runA-zh-first`, `-runB-en-first`, `-runC-5050`.

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-translated-ru-v2.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English and translated Russian data, 134k steps (injection fix v2).

The-CoLab/llama3-7b-en-translated-ru-v4.description: LLaMA-3 7B pretrained on English + Russian (translated from English) bilingual data, 133,600 total steps (v4 run). Uses a shared 65k English-Russian tokenizer (`65k_en1.0_ru1.0`).

kambale/pearl-23m-translate.description: This is the **Pearl Model (23M-translate-v2)**, a Transformer-based neural machine translation (NMT) model trained from scratch. It is designed to translate text from English to Luganda and contains approximately 23,363,200 parameters. This version features an increased maximum sequence length of 512, deeper encoder/decoder (6 layers each), wider feed-forward networks (PF_DIM 1024), an increased tokenizer vocabulary size (16000), and the Transformer's original learning rate schedule.

sathishphdai/sales-executive-slm-1m.description: A **LLaMA-style transformer** (~989.0M params, ~0.99B) trained from scratch for the **Sales Executive** role. Supports up to **1M token context** via RoPE with gradient checkpointing.

manasred/picochat.description: A 90M parameter GPT trained from scratch in Rust using the [picochat](https://github.com/Nu11ified/picochat) framework.

tanaylab/sns-paper-flashzoi-silicusplusc.description: Borzoi architecture trained from random initialization on the **silicusPlusCGDCreCtcfExonTE** synthetic genome with CUT&Tag H3K27me3 and H3K4me3 targets.

coolermyself/kivest-chat-scratch-v1.description: A custom-built 160,451,328 parameter conversational AI trained entirely from scratch (random weight initialization).

euswbnix/transformer-wmt14-ende-base.description: A **from-scratch PyTorch implementation** of the Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017), trained on **WMT14 English→French** without any pretrained weights. This is the strongest checkpoint from the parent project and the one worth sharing externally.

SOVYN/sovyn-300m-cortex.description: SOVYN-300M-Cortex is a small Korean conversational model trained from scratch. It is not a Transformers-compatible checkpoint yet; it uses the custom PyTorch architecture in `src/sovyn`.

ostah-1010/Marshmello-8M.description: **Marshmello-8M** is a decoder-only GPT language model trained from scratch in [**Marshmello**](https://github.com/mohmmedwee/Marshmello) — a step-by-step project that builds transformers from one weight to GPT pretraining, SFT, and 300M scaling on Apple Silicon.

Asilarknes/FLATest.description: A **308M-parameter** decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** on a single RTX PRO 6000 (Blackwell). It mixes **Gated Linear Attention (GLA)** layers with sparse full-attention layers — a hybrid sequence mixer in the spirit of Jamba / MiniMax — to get **O(N) long-context** behaviour while keeping the **exact associative recall** that pure linear attention loses.

imshadow0/pycraft-1.description: PyCraft-1 is a 55.3M parameter decoder-only transformer trained **entirely from scratch** on Python code using a single NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop GPU (4GB VRAM). It demonstrates that a domain-specific code LLM can be trained without cloud compute, following a quality-first data curriculum inspired by the Phi-1 "Textbooks Are All You Need" approach.

pulipakav-1/dravidian-gpt2-malayalam.description: A GPT-2 base model trained from scratch on Malayalam language data, part of the **Dravidian GPT-2** series covering Dravidian languages (Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, Tamil).

korkmazumut/orkhon-tegin.description: 22M unified assistant tuned from the former Kultegin instruct model.

korkmazumut/orkhon-bunghu.description: 57M unified EN/TR/Kokturk assistant tuned from the bilingual branch.

vukrosic/nano-vowel.description: Restores the vowels to a vowel-less word — `wrld` → `world`, `dsmvwld` → `disemvoweled`, `brd` → `bread`. Vowel placement lives only in a learned lexicon, so a rule-only script has *nothing to compute*; the model recovers the most likely word a consonant skeleton came from. A **~1M-parameter (1,016,960) byte-level transformer**.

QDHShamiro/Kairo.description: From-scratch GPT-style causal LM (8 layers, 512 dim, 8 heads, 32000 BPE vocab), trained as the "brain" behind the Kairo Voice assistant.

quik-models/giddy-flower-36.description: **AutoResearch-fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle-depth6** is a **42.1M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle**.

quik-models/sunny-cloud-66.description: **AutoResearch-tinystories-depth8** is a **285.2M parameter** decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **TinyStories (karpathy/tinystories-gpt4-clean)**.

ARotting/snip-0.4m-reward.description: SNIP means **Small Neural Intelligence Prototype**. SNIP-0.4M is a deliberately tiny causal transformer designed to make the complete language-model lifecycle inspectable on ordinary hardware.

achavan1211/minimind-instruct-135m.description: A ~137.7M-parameter GPT-style decoder transformer **built entirely from scratch** - custom architecture, custom tokenizer, from-scratch pretraining, and instruction fine-tuning. This is the **instruction-tuned** checkpoint: it follows the Alpaca prompt format and responds to instructions.

amDANIEL2024/gptmdogo-bible.description: Custom-architecture GPT trained from scratch on a character-level tokenizer.

sifat-febo/banglish-ontor.description: Your model answers a Banglish message — Bengali typed in Latin letters — without knowing anything about it. ontor is a perception layer: it reads the message first and hands your model what it found. The whole layer is 3.3 MB and it runs on a CPU in milliseconds.

flbjcy/LM-from-scratch.description: A small Transformer language model, implemented entirely from scratch (no `torch.nn` layers beyond `Parameter` and containers) as part of Stanford's CS336 (Language Modeling from Scratch) assignment.

pngwn/memcap-l-above-capacity.description: Part of a tiny-scale reproduction of **[How much do language models memorize?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24832)** (Morris et al., ICML 2026 honorable mention): GPT-style models trained from scratch on uniformly random token sequences, where generalization is impossible and every bit of loss reduction is memorization.

ausjahk/fruit-fresh-rotten-cnn-from-scra.description: Custom CNN trained from random weights on Kaggle fruits fresh/rotten dataset. Classes: ['freshapples', 'freshbanana', 'freshoranges', 'rottenapples', 'rottenbanana', 'rottenoranges'] Test Accuracy: 93.58% Parameters: 4,585,478

faiz4320/cnn-model.description: Classroom prototype. NOT a medical device and NOT a validated pneumonia detector.

Manovishaal/MaVi-0.2-65M.description: **MaVi** is a small language model that turns a plain-English game idea into a playable 2D game. It was trained from scratch, together with its own game engine: the model writes **GSL**, a compact game-specification language (see `GSL.md`), and the engine plays it, validates it and exports it to Godot 4 and Ren'Py. It can also draw pixel-art sprites in **PXL**, a small drawing language, and edit existing games and levels.

opena2a/nanomind-security-classifier.description: A fast, lightweight threat classifier purpose-built for AI agent security scanning. Classifies SKILL.md files, MCP server configurations, SOUL.md governance docs, and agent tool descriptions into 10 security categories in under 1ms.

dalek-ai/baseline-v1-desc-hybrid-next-v1.description: Same hybrid pipeline as [`baseline-v1-desc-hybrid`](https://huggingface.co/dalek-ai/baseline-v1-desc-hybrid), but the encoder has been fine-tuned on **8 386 next-tool prediction triplets** with contrastive (task, gold_description, hard_negative) triples. Hard negatives are sampled from the top-50 retrieval of the **previous** hybrid encoder, so each gradient step pushes the encoder past its own retrieval mistakes.

beatsprom/agentic-tool-use-qwen-7b-lora.description: Fine-tuned adapter using the **Agentic Tool-Use & Function Calling Suite (2026)**.

fbaldassarri/sapienzanlp_Minerva-350M-ba.description: Quantized version of [sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-350M-base-v1.0) using torch.float32 for quantization tuning. - 8 bits (INT8) - group size = 128 - Symmetrical Quantization - Method WoQ (AutoRound format)

fbaldassarri/sapienzanlp_Minerva-7B-inst.description: Quantized version of [sapienzanlp/Minerva-7B-instruct-v1.0](https://huggingface.co/sapienzanlp/Minerva-7B-instruct-v1.0) using torch.float32 for quantization tuning. - 8 bits (INT8) - group size = 128 - Asymmetrical Quantization - Method WoQ (AutoRound format)

rudransh0109/Mistral-7B-v0.1-bnb-4bit.description: This model is a quantized version of the original model [`mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1`](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1).

Zaixi/RNAGenesis.description: RNAGenesis is a generalist RNA foundation model that integrates sequence representation, structural prediction, and de novo functional design within a single generative framework. Trained on diverse clustered non-coding RNAs, RNAGenesis leverages a BERT-style encoder, query-based latent compression, and a diffusion-guided decoder enhanced by inference-time alignment with gradient guidance and beam search strategies.

Enaoudir/base_model.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

kostakoff/Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: The Mistral-7B-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative text model with 7 billion parameters. Mistral-7B-v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks we tested.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-9.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

yang0104/TropicBERT.description: **TropicBERT** is the first genomic foundation model series specifically designed for **tropical fruit crop genome sequences**. We pre-trained BERT models using the **MLM (Masked Language Modeling)** objective on datasets comprising **13 different species combinations**, releasing a total of **13 pre-trained model variants** covering 1, 5, and 10 species.

tjuwk/tabfm-1.0.0-jax.description: TabFM is a zero-shot tabular foundation model from Google Research. It supports classification and regression on structured/tabular data with mixed numerical and categorical columns, requiring no fine-tuning or hyperparameter search - training examples are passed as context and predictions are made in a single forward pass.

Sejibeji/tso-foundation-v11.description: **Time is geometry.** The Time-Series Operator (TSO) is a foundation model that learns the *shape* of dynamical systems instead of token-chunking numbers. Pretraining uses four self-supervised pretexts — reconstruction, Koopman-linear dynamics, scale covariance (a renormalization leg), and the arrow of time — on 40 series across 8 domains (electricity grids, meteorology, ECG, finance, epidemiology, economics, solar physics, chaotic systems). Transfer to a never-seen series is a **closed-form Koopman fit on the frozen latent**: zero gradient steps.

Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runC-5050.description: A 1.7B-parameter bilingual (English + Chinese) language model, part of a **controlled language-ordering study**. This is the **balanced 50/50 control** run.

Companion blended-curriculum runs (50/50 diet, 3-phase) live at `Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runA-zh-first`, `-runB-en-first`, `-runC-5050`.

anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-8.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

Sejibeji/tso-foundation-v13.description: **Time is geometry.** The Time-Series Operator (TSO) is a foundation model that learns the *shape* of dynamical systems instead of token-chunking numbers. Pretraining uses four self-supervised pretexts — reconstruction, Koopman-linear dynamics, scale covariance (a renormalization leg), and the arrow of time — on 40 series across 8 domains (electricity grids, meteorology, ECG, finance, epidemiology, economics, solar physics, chaotic systems). Transfer to a never-seen series is a **closed-form Koopman fit on the frozen latent**: zero gradient steps.

danelcsb/localagent-ultra-tiny-1m.description: A **from-scratch, byte-level** tool-calling agent model from [LocalAgent](https://github.com/sangbumchoi/localagent). anonymous-stoicheia/Stoicheia-fold-1.description: **Stoicheia** is a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek (`d_model` 1024, depth 32, banded attention: three of every four blocks attend within a 256-character window, the fourth globally). Its input is factored into five aligned planes -- letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, punctuation -- each of which can be masked independently to an explicit *unknown* state at inference. That is what lets one model read an edited text, *scriptio continua*, and a lacuna of unknown length without changing anything but its input.

This is the recommended small adapter: the same numbers as the 3B that found the result, on a base whose licence permits commercial use.

mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-qwen25-1.5b.description: Two LoRA adapters, one recipe at two seeds, on **Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (Apache-2.0)**, trained on jam-actions-v1 **1.1.0** (the four-draw corpus of the eleven verified songs). This is the smallest model that learned the acoustic gate comparison from this corpus. It is an option for hardware where 4B is too much; the recommended small path is [mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-qwen3-4b](https://huggingface.co/mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-qwen3-4b), and the 7B is at [mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-qwen25-7b](https://huggingface.co/mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-qwen25-7b).

AffixIO/affixio-ollama.description: Pin + run local Ollama models behind an AffixIO-style verification gate. Proof/verification runs BEFORE the model is called; sensitive actions wait for human approval. Fully offline — no AffixIO key needed (`local_demo`).

AffixIO/affixio-agent-tools.description: Fail-closed local tool layer: identity + permission checks, transaction intent validation, email search/organisation, drafting and sending **with human approval**, webhook/API actions behind allow-lists, and an audit record for every decision. No network, no production keys.

AffixIO/affixio-mcp-gateway.description: Use the AffixIO MCP server (`@affixio/mcp`) as the policy gate in front of every privileged agent tool call — Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client. PII never leaves the host: only SHA-256 arg digests are kept.

AffixIO/affixio-agent-guard-py.description: Python mirror of the npm `affixio-agent-guard` policy: deterministic, fail-closed check of one tool call + local JSON receipt. Zero network, zero keys. Receipts are **local simulations, not cryptographic attestations** — same honest contract as the npm package.

gnr8tr/falco-decision-models.description: The Falco Multi-Query Router is a specialized, fine-tuned sequence classification model exported to ONNX format. It is explicitly designed to act as the weights backend for the Rust-based **Falco Neural Decision Routing Engine**.

yasinyaman/callbus-heads-qwen3-emb-8b.description: Two small learned heads that sit on top of [Qwen3-Embedding-8B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B) sentence embeddings for tool retrieval. The state head reads the request, the action head reads a tool; each computes `x + MLP(x)` (a *skip* head: 4096 → 1536 → 1536 → 4096, GELU, LayerNorm), then L2-normalises, and a tool's score is the cosine of the two. The heads start as the identity, so training only adds a correction on top of the base model.

ayub42/agentic-intent-router.description: A lightweight, zero-shot intent routing layer designed for **Autonomous Agentic RAG Systems**. Built on top of `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`, this model computes cosine similarity between input query embeddings and precomputed domain prototype centroids to determine whether an agent should dispatch calls to external tools via the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** or proceed with standard synthesis.

One forward pass turns a state plus typed questions into calibrated probabilities: P(prompt-injection), P(jailbreak), P(PII-leak), P(tool-risk). English plus Hinglish plus Hindi. Apache-2.0, self-hosted, $0.

openbles/firewall-1.description: An open decision model that works as a prompt injection firewall for AI agents. It reads the text an agent is about to read (a web page, a tool or MCP result, an email, a file) and answers one question: is this text trying to give the agent orders?

danielrosehill/Voice-Note-Intent-Classif.description: > **v0.1.0 (2026-10-15): placeholder release.** A first, deliberately simple model > that works end to end and sets a baseline. It is not tuned, and its accuracy on real > notes is modest (micro F1 0.56). Expect it to be replaced; the > `taxonomy_version` in every prediction lets a router detect that.

Niphroke77/Whisper-v8-32.6B-A6B-Hybrid-U.description: > **Whisper-v8** is a state-of-the-art 32.6B parameter (6.2B active) unfiltered Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model engineered for autonomous agents, system administration, reverse engineering, and complex reasoning without refusal vectors.

Amandeep10/pretrain-where-SatMAE-weights.description: SatMAE (https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08051) is the most cited MAE-based GeoFoundational Model. majiabo/GPFM.description: GPFM is a pathology foundation model based on ViT-L/14 (DINOv2 configuration) for extracting general visual features from histopathology tiles/patches. It supports downstream WSI tasks including MIL classification, prognosis, survival analysis, and ROI tasks. The model architecture corresponds to `vit_large_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m` in `timm`, using DINOv2's key hyperparameters (`img_size=224`, `init_values=1e-5`).

ATLASBIOINFO/PlantDNA-FM.description: **PlantDNA-FM** is a plant DNA foundation model pre-trained on the complete collection of plant genomes from **Ensembl Plants**, with a specific focus on **gene-body regions** — including promoters, exons, introns, and terminators. The model is designed to learn the regulatory grammar and coding/non-coding sequence structure underlying plant gene expression and evolution.

youngzhou12/MerMED.description: MerMED-FM is a self-supervised medical imaging foundation model pretrained across **7 imaging modalities and 12 medical specialties**.

ChangwenXu/CLOUD.description: CLOUD (**C**rystal **L**anguage m**O**del for **U**nified and **D**ifferentiable materials modeling) is a Transformer-based foundation model that learns crystal representations from string encodings of crystal structures. Crystals are serialized with a novel **Symmetry-Consistent Ordered Parameter Encoding (SCOPE)**, a compact, coordinate-free representation that captures space-group symmetry, Wyckoff positions, and composition. The model can be fine-tuned for accurate, generalizable, and scalable property prediction, and can be combined with physics laws (e.g. the Debye model) for thermodynamic-consistent predictions.

stanford-star/rt-v1.description: Checkpoints of [Relational Transformer: Toward Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Relational Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06377) (ICLR 2026): one `.pt` file per (database, task). `pretrain_<db>_<task>.pt` is pretrained with `<db>` held out, `contd-pretrain_*` continues pretraining on `<db>` with the task held out, `finetune-from-*` is fine-tuned on the task. 12 blocks, `d_model` 256, 8 heads, `d_ff` 1024; text embedded with `all-MiniLM-L12-v2`.

navgeet/chess-sft-merged.description: **chess-sft-qwen3-0.6b** is an intermediate research model designed to develop chess move generation with reasoning capabilities. It is built on top of [Qwen3-0.6B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B), and has been fully fine-tuned using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a curated dataset of 776,026 chess move legality examples. This model serves as a foundation for training models that can generate the best moves with chain-of-thought reasoning.

arcinstitute/Stack-Large.description: **Stack** is a large-scale encoder-decoder foundation model for single-cell biology. Jershone/FluidAI-0.7B_Gen1.description: Welcome to **FluidAI-0.7B**, a **700 million parameter multimodal foundation model** built completely from scratch using the **Fluidic Wave Architecture**.

postcn/OrbitFM.description: **OrbitFM** is a satellite orbit prediction model that forecasts future orbital elements — and, through SGP4, future satellite **positions** — directly from a satellite's historical **Two-Line Element (TLE)** time series. It is built by continued pretraining (fine-tuning) of the [Datadog/Toto-2.0-2.5B](https://huggingface.co/Datadog/Toto-2.0-2.5B) time-series foundation model on 20 years (2005–2024) of cleaned, daily-resampled TLE records for low-Earth-orbit (LEO) objects, enriched with physics-derived features and **space-weather** (solar / geomagnetic) driver channels.

FM4NPP/PP_collision.description: Pretrained state space model (Mamba / Mamba2) checkpoints for particle physics, from the paper **[Foundation Models for Particle Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14087)** (accepted to ICLR 2026). Developed at Brookhaven National Laboratory.

RelativeDB/rt-j-int8.description: Int8 quantizations of [stanford-star/rt-j](https://huggingface.co/stanford-star/rt-j), the Relational Transformer foundation model for in-context learning over relational databases. Produced and consumed by the [RelativeDB](https://github.com/RelativeDB) native inference engine (`cpp/rt_quantize --type q8`). Weights stay **quantized-resident** at inference: the engine's CPU (Accelerate / portable SIMD) and Metal/MPS kernels dequantize inside the GEMM, so DRAM weight traffic is the int8 payload.

RelativeDB/rt-j-int4.description: Int4 quantizations of [stanford-star/rt-j](https://huggingface.co/stanford-star/rt-j), the Relational Transformer foundation model for in-context learning over relational databases. Produced and consumed by the [RelativeDB](https://github.com/RelativeDB) native inference engine (`cpp/rt_quantize --type q4`). Weights stay **quantized-resident** at inference: the engine's CPU (Accelerate / portable SIMD) and Metal/MPS kernels dequantize inside the GEMM, so DRAM weight traffic is the int4 payload.

RelativeDB/rt-j-fp16.description: Half-precision conversions of [stanford-star/rt-j](https://huggingface.co/stanford-star/rt-j), the Relational Transformer foundation model for in-context learning over relational databases. Produced and consumed by the [RelativeDB](https://github.com/RelativeDB) native inference engine (`cpp/rt_quantize --type f16`). Weights stay **f16-resident** at inference: the engine's CPU (Accelerate / portable SIMD) and Metal/MPS kernels convert to fp32 inside the GEMM, halving weight memory and DRAM traffic vs. fp32 with **no measurable accuracy loss** (drift vs. the PyTorch reference is identical to the fp32 checkpoint on the golden batch).

loopback-kr/Luna.description: **Luna** is a multimodal, multi-task retinal foundation model for high-resolution color fundus photographs (CFPs). Instead of pixel reconstruction, it is pre-trained by **predicting masked clinical tokens** (disease label, age, sex, eye laterality) from the image, while a **UNETR decoder jointly supervises vessel / optic-disc segmentation**.

geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-N.description: A compact per-pixel encoder for Sentinel-2 + Sentinel-1 satellite time series, **distilled from the [TESSERA v2 2B teacher](https://huggingface.co/geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-Teacher)**. It maps one pixel's annual observation history to a **128-dimensional Matryoshka embedding**: the first K dimensions are independently usable for K ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128}, so you can truncate to 16/32/64 dims with no retraining and no separate checkpoint.

geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-S.description: A compact per-pixel encoder for Sentinel-2 + Sentinel-1 satellite time series, **distilled from the [TESSERA v2 2B teacher](https://huggingface.co/geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-Teacher)**. It maps one pixel's annual observation history to a **128-dimensional Matryoshka embedding**: the first K dimensions are independently usable for K ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128}, so you can truncate to 16/32/64 dims with no retraining and no separate checkpoint.

It maps one pixel's annual observation history to a **128-dimensional Matryoshka embedding**: the first K dimensions are independently usable for K ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128}, so you can truncate to 16/32/64 dims with no retraining and no separate checkpoint.

geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-L.description: A compact per-pixel encoder for Sentinel-2 + Sentinel-1 satellite time series, **distilled from the [TESSERA v2 2B teacher](https://huggingface.co/geotessera/TESSERA-V-2.0-2B-Teacher)**. kevin0311/Medical-SAM3.description: Medical SAM3 is a foundation model for universal prompt-driven medical image segmentation, obtained by fully fine-tuning SAM3 on large-scale, heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets with paired segmentation masks and text prompts.

alexalexak/PanMET.description: PanMET is a genome-aware foundation-model framework for RNA sequencing and DNA methylation. It combines independently pretrained modality towers, leakage-free cross-modal alignment, and masked bidirectional cross-modal reconstruction.

light156/Sensori.description: A self-supervised foundation model that learns general-purpose representations of human health and disease directly from 24 hours of raw tri-axial wrist movement.

software-competence-center-hagenberg/PCF.description: PCFM is a **topology-constrained, any-variate time-series foundation model** for industrial process telemetry. Unlike existing time-series foundation models, it accepts a **directed, lag-annotated causal graph** `G(A, T)` — the physical topology of a plant — as an **inference-time structural prompt**: a GNN-style spatial router restricts cross-variate information flow to the graph's edges and reads each driver at its physical cause–effect lag, at a spatial cost linear in the edge count. Its learned parameters are independent of the number of input variates, so one set of pre-trained weights serves arbitrary sensor configurations.

JTF2000/ChorusTIC.description: ChorusTIC is a classification-native foundation model for training-free univariate and multivariate time series classification. It uses labeled context examples to predict query labels without fitting a target-specific classifier or updating model parameters.

SII-GAIR-NLP/RIBOSPAN-FM.description: Many full-length RNAs, particularly mRNAs, exceed the ~1K context lengths used to pretrain representative dense RNA encoders, forcing long transcripts to be truncated and preventing their 5′ UTR, CDS, and 3′ UTR from being modeled jointly at single-nucleotide resolution. **RiboSpan** is a **1.61B-parameter bidirectional Transformer** with **single-nucleotide tokenization**, **dense self-attention in every layer**, and **native long-context pretraining at up to 10,240 nt**. It is trained on **67.6 million RNA sequences comprising 85.7 billion nucleotides** from RNAcentral, Ensembl, and Ensembl Genomes.

akhverm/Klint-32M.description: **Klint-32M** is an open research causal autoregressive foundation architecture for generative financial time-series modeling. It decomposes raw market candlesticks into three stationary causal factor streams (**Price-Path**, **Range-Shape**, and **Activity**), quantizes them into discrete token codes with Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), models their joint transition distribution with a causal Transformer, and decodes them with strict mathematical guarantees preserving candle geometry:

lyqun/SPARC.description: SPARC is a foundation model that reconstructs a three-dimensional CT volume from sparse X-ray projections. This repository holds the pretrained weights from which every SPARC reconstruction model is adapted. They accompany the manuscript *A foundation model for three-dimensional anatomical reconstruction from sparse X-ray projections* (2026).

sensifai/cfd2vec.description: A self-supervised pretraining architecture for 3-D steady and time-averaged flows, built as a general foundation model: one encoder is pretrained by **masked field modelling** on solved cases; the learned representation then serves field prediction at arbitrary query points, solver warm start (super-fidelity), frozen-embedding probes and case retrieval. The core is independent of any solver or dataset: solvers and data sources are plug-ins.

yhatlabs/ChakraTS.description: **ChakraTS is a zero-shot probabilistic time-series forecasting model from [YHat Labs](https://yhatlabs.com), served as a hosted API. This repository holds the model card; there are no weights to download.**

yhatlabs/ChakraTS-Lab.description: **ChakraTS-Lab is the research configuration of [ChakraTS](https://huggingface.co/yhatlabs/ChakraTS), YHat Labs' zero-shot probabilistic forecasting model. It is the same mixture of expert forecasters with models that are not part of YHat-Labs model family. It exists to show what the approach reaches when every strong open model is admitted, and it is available for research and benchmark evaluation only. This repository holds the model card; there are no weights to download.**

VITRA-VLA/VITRA-VLA-3B.description: VITRA is a novel approach for pretraining Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation using large-scale, unscripted, real-world videos of human hand activities. Treating human hand as dexterous robot end-effector, we show that in-the-wild egocentric human videos without any annotations can be transformed into data formats fully aligned with existing robotic V-L-A training data in terms of task granularity and labels. We create a human hand V-L-A dataset containing over 1 million episodes. We further develop a VLA model with a causal action transformer trained on this dataset. It demonstrates strong zero-shot human-hand action prediction in entirely new scenes and serves as a cornerstone for few-shot finetuning and adaptation to real-world robotic manipulation.

juliannunezb/crisp3b-v8-ckpts.description: Base language model (no instruction tuning). 2.67B parameters, Llama-style architecture, custom 49k byte-level BPE tokenizer with **single-digit numbers**, trained on **6.67B tokens** of [crisp-v8](https://huggingface.co/datasets/juliannunezb/crisp-v8) — a corpus built for this run from Nemotron-CC-v2.1 (organic web + synthetic rephrasings + diverse-QA), FineWeb-Edu, FineMath-4plus, StarCoderData and peS2o — in **38.4 GPU-hours on a single NVIDIA B200 (≈$193 of GPU time)**.

LLM-OS-Models/gdn2-1.3B-fineweb-edu-100b.description: > A pure-recurrent linear-attention language model trained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu. > Architecture: **Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2)** — decoupling erase and write gates in linear attention.

wcamon/circus-0.2-stem-architecture.description: **Wei Ciao Wu** (independent researcher), with Claude (Anthropic) as AI research assistant.

tucan9389/nanochat-jax.description: Model checkpoints for [**nanochat-jax**](https://github.com/tucan9389/nanochat-jax), a JAX/Flax port of Andrej Karpathy's [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) that reproduces the reference recipes on **spot TPU** (e.g. v6e-8) instead of 8×H100, matching the reference model *quality*.

ncgc-mila/GeoNexus-130M-pilots.description: Checkpoints from **GeoNexus**: an experimental study of *geometry-aware common-minima regularization* (Nexus, arXiv:2604.09258) — testing whether the Nexus inner-loop transform Φ should measure cross-source gradient agreement in the **outer optimizer's geometry** (AdamW: D^(−1/4); Muon: the polar factor) instead of raw-gradient cosine.
