Lambent/influence-taste-56m.description: A 56M-parameter predictor that scores web documents by their predicted **training influence** on 17 held-out text categories — not "quality" as a scalar, but a 17-dimensional taste vector. Trained to predict gradient-alignment influence labels: for each document, the cosine between its training gradient and the mean held-out gradient of each category, measured at a mid-training reference checkpoint.

pre-to-post-olmo/Math-Models.description: Checkpoints from a **pretraining → post-training** study on a **1B-parameter OLMo-2** model trained on math. The repo bundles, for 15 pretraining anchors, the model at every stage of the pipeline:

capotej/WikipediaGutenberg-0.5B.description: A **from-scratch** GPT-2-style language model (nanoGPT), **530M params**, trained for **1 epoch** on a combination of **English Wikipedia** ([wikimedia/wikipedia](https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikimedia/wikipedia), 20231101.en) and **Project Gutenberg** ([common-pile/project_gutenberg_filtered](https://huggingface.co/datasets/common-pile/project_gutenberg_filtered)) — ~9.0B tokens, ~17 tokens/parameter (near the [Chinchilla](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.15556) compute-optimal ratio).

Efekan35/axonlm-jepa.description: A 124M-parameter GPT-2-style language model exploring whether **JEPA-style self-supervised pretraining** (Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, LeCun 2022) produces more usable representations than standard next-token pretraining — tested through a neuroscience-grounded probing methodology.

zzkai098/gpt2-124m-ckpt.description: A from-scratch reproduction of OpenAI's **GPT-2 (124M)** in PyTorch — architecture, distributed training, and evaluation all written by hand. Trained on **10B tokens of DCLM-baseline for 4 epochs** on 8×RTX 4090D (~13 h, ~$27).

piyushptiwari/bytical-3d-instag-pretrain.description: > **Dimension: 3D** · Framework: [InsTaG](https://github.com/Fictionarry/InsTaG) (CVPR 2025) — few-shot 3D talking-head adaptation > **This repo = the 3D _pretrain weights_** (multi-identity base for fast few-shot). Public.

ChrisMcCormick/decoderstack-d24.description: A 1.38B-parameter d24 model pre-trained from scratch with [**DecoderStack**](https://github.com/chrisjmccormick/stacks) — a single-file training stack with a handwritten forward/backward and a written-out optimizer: no autograd, no `torch.optim`, no `nn.Module`. bf16, varlen FlashAttention, 8xH100, 1h51m.

inaciose/inacio-d16v1.description: `inacio-d16v1` is the first public base model of the **nanochatpt** project, an effort to train compact language models from scratch with **European Portuguese (PT-PT)** as the primary language while retaining English competence.

Impliedhomeland/midtrain-bridge-backbone.description: Training-state checkpoints for the **C4-only reference runs** used in midtraining intro-timing experiments. In that setup a single C4-only trunk is trained, then *forked* at various points to introduce a new data mixture (code). `branch_A` is the control: the run that never sees code at all.

Impliedhomeland/midtrain-bridge-1B-cosin.description: A **C4-only 1B-parameter pretraining run to 60B tokens**, published with **all 17 intermediate checkpoints** along the trajectory. This is the `W=0` reference arm of a study on *when* to introduce a new data distribution (code) during pretraining; the checkpoints are the fork points from which code-mixed branches are launched.

Impliedhomeland/midtrain-bridge-1B-wsd-b.description: A **C4-only 1B-parameter pretraining run to 60B tokens under a Warmup-Stable-Decay schedule**, published with **13 checkpoints** along the trajectory. This is the `W=0` reference arm of a study on *when* to introduce a new data distribution (code) during pretraining; the checkpoints are the fork points from which code-mixed branches are launched.

lilywchen/lucky-initialization-atlas-100.description: Private, continuously synchronized model-only checkpoints for the prospectively frozen OLMo-3-ladder 100M initialization atlas. Every visible checkpoint was converted with the pinned `olmo_core.nn.hf.save_hf_model`, serialized with its pinned tokenizer, and SHA-256 manifested before upload.

joey00072/ohara-chat-d12.description: A 124M-parameter chat model trained from scratch with [ohara](https://github.com/joey00072/ohara), replicating the nanochat pipeline end to end: pretraining on ClimbMix, then supervised finetuning into a chat model.

joey00072/ohara-base-d12.description: The **pretrained base model** from a nanochat-style run with [ohara](https://github.com/joey00072/ohara). 124M effective parameters, trained from scratch on 1.48B tokens of ClimbMix on 2xA100-80GB in about 3.3 hours.

lixiaochuan2020/latent-wm-160m-suite.description: Four ~160M-parameter decoder LMs trained from scratch on DCLM-baseline under one recipe, for comparing architectures at a matched parameter budget. Kingrane/Bobik-2B-Base.description: **Bobik-2B-Base** - это русская дообученная языковая модель на базе Qwen3.5-2B. Создана разработчиком [Kingrane](https://huggingface.co/Kingrane) как продолжение претрейна на русских данных.

khursanirevo/smolagent-ms-800m-base.description: Dense decoder-only Transformer trained **from scratch** on **8.0B tokens** of Malay-domain text (97% Malay / 43 domains incl. Hansard, laws, news, wiki).

bekhruzsuleyman/alethic-151m.description: Alethic is an experimental /~151M-parameter decoder-only language model pretrained from scratch on **FineWeb-Edu**.

darkstudio009/Vanessa-1B.description: **A ~1.1B-parameter decoder-only transformer, pretrained fully from scratch — original tokenizer, original model code, original training loop.**

Najongs/vlanext-droid-pretrain.description: Pretraining weights from the DROID stage of VLANeXt, before task-specific finetuning on Meca500 needle insertion.

VertexAGI/experiment-a1-pico.description: A **1,009,920-parameter** decoder-only transformer, pretrained completely from scratch (no distillation, no base model) on [tinyshakespeare](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/char-rnn/master/data/tinyshakespeare/input.txt) -- ~1.1MB / ~1M characters of Shakespeare -- in **188 seconds** on an Apple Silicon Mac using [MLX](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx).

VertexAGI/experiment-a2-pico.description: A **1,009,920-parameter** decoder-only transformer, pretrained from scratch on [tinyshakespeare](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/char-rnn/master/data/tinyshakespeare/input.txt), trained **4x longer** than [Experiment A1 Pico](https://huggingface.co/VertexAGI/experiment-a1-pico) (12,000 iterations vs 3,000) to see how much further the same tiny model + tiny dataset combination could go.

leibnitz-lab/cosmopedia-distributed-trai.description: Two 98.4 M parameter language models trained on Cosmopedia for 10 epochs, differing only in the psi hyperparameter.

leibnitz-lab/wiki300m-nxd-grid.description: 201 language-model checkpoints from a grid over parameter count N and training tokens D, trained on English Wikipedia to fit scaling laws. Each `.pt` is one completed run.

leibnitz-lab/wiki300m-colinear.description: 197 language-model checkpoints trained on English Wikipedia along fixed tokens-per-parameter ratios, for fitting scaling laws where N and D are not independent. Each `.pt` is one completed run.

leibnitz-lab/wiki300m-holdout.description: 72 language-model checkpoints trained on English Wikipedia and held out from the scaling-law fits, for testing predictions made from the grid and colinear sweeps. Each `.pt` is one completed run.

Chillilly88/EXP01-AnyHaidass-0920-0.6B.description: **haidass** 系列 EXP01 实验:基于 **Lance 架构**(Mixture-of-Transformers 统一理解 + 生成)的原生多模态预训练,语言基座 **Qwen3-0.6B**,训练规模 **20B token**,硬件 **8 节点 × 8 昇腾 Ascend 910B3(64 NPU)**,训练时间 2026-09-20 ~ 09-21(纯计算约 16.9 小时)。

Caesar216/GDN-1.3B-100B.description: Final native GDN/HLA repository checkpoint, trained from scratch on approximately 100B SlimPajama tokens (100,000,595,968 tokens), with 4,096-token sequences and global batch size 512. Completed optimizer step: 47,684.

Caesar216/HLA-1.3B-C256-P16-100B.description: Final native GDN/HLA repository checkpoint, trained from scratch on approximately 100B SlimPajama tokens (100,000,595,968 tokens), with 4,096-token sequences and global batch size 512. Completed optimizer step: 47,684.

machinekind/Matcha-TTS-PL-Pretrain.description: > **Intermediate checkpoint for fine-tuning.** Not intended for production: the reader voices belong to the readers. > For a usable model with four synthetic voices, see **[Matcha-TTS-PL](https://huggingface.co/machinekind/Matcha-TTS-PL)** > ([try it](https://huggingface.co/spaces/machinekind/matcha-tts-pl)), which was fine-tuned from this checkpoint. > Formerly published as `machinekind/Matcha-TTS-PL`; browser demo: [matcha-tts-pl-pretrain](https://huggingface.co/spaces/machinekind/matcha-tts-pl-pretrain).

webstar34/goblin-slm-250m.description: Fresh Edge model with the SLM 32,768-token tokenizer. Target: 10 billion processed training targets. This is an experiment in progress, not a claim that 10B targets have completed or that the model is ready for chat.

RaunakSeksaria/anlp-a2-optimizers.description: The dense 26.45M-parameter decoder of Task 1 (variant v1), pretrained from scratch on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus for 1x the training data (44.43M tokens) with AdamW, MARS, Lion and Muon (one per category of 'Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers'), plus Sophia-H from its Hessian-based category as a bonus.

rihim/icl-selfplay-vs-text-checkpoints.description: These are byte-level language models trained on ordinary web text (DCLM-Baseline). They use exactly the architecture and model sizes of the self-play learners from ([weights](https://huggingface.co/nourya-cohen/solomonoff-paper)). I trained them to answer a question the paper leaves open: does ordinary pretraining produce the same in-context learning that self-play does, at the same size and the same number of training tokens?

liangyue36/minimind-stop-token-study.description: PyTorch state dicts (`.pth`) from a paired pretraining experiment: does the document-end token used during pretraining affect whether a model stops after LoRA SFT? Code and write-up: [github.com/cassieliang6709/stop-token-study](https://github.com/cassieliang6709/stop-token-study). Load with the MiniMind model code in that repo.

Viv0605101/anlp-a2-part2-optimizers.description: The dense Part 1 architecture pre-trained for next-token prediction on for one full pass (1x the dataset), once per optimizer. Every optimizer is implemented from scratch (only `torch.optim.Optimizer` is used, as a base class), one per category of Table 1 of *Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them*; Sophia-G is the bonus Hessian-based optimizer.

Sami-on-hugging-face/anlp-a2-part2-optim.description: The same 8-layer decoder-only transformer (d_model 512, 37.8M parameters; the dense configuration of Part 1) pretrained from scratch for next-token prediction on `browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus` (revision `b514ff64`) with optimizers implemented from scratch (Wen et al. 2025, *Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers*, Appendix A). Every run uses the same initial weights, the same batches (one epoch, 37.7M tokens) and the same learning-rate schedule; hyperparameters come from a sweep on a quarter of the data (`sweep_best/`).

Usaidddddddddddddd/TinyGPT-500M-Archive.description: This private repository is the cloud backup for raw PyTorch pretraining checkpoints, optimizer states, and tokenized datasets for **TinyGPT-500M / Usaid AI (500M)** developed by **Mohamed Usaid**.

Ba2han/mini-qwen-next-31b.description: Training starts with one complete pass over `Ba2han/tokenized_mix_0507` and stops at its exhaustion. The learning-rate schedule spans 31 billion input tokens; the packed long dataset is a later continuation. Two GPUs use 1 packed row each per forward and 32 accumulation passes: 655,360 input tokens per update. Activation checkpointing is disabled. N-gram gradients accumulate in FP32 and communicate in BF16. The full 1.8B n-gram table remains on GPU; measured steady throughput is about 41k input tokens/s. Adam groups use AdamW8bit at a peak LR of 0.001; Muon groups use the selected 8-step Polar Express recipe at 0.024. Warmup lasts 500 updates. Linear decay starts at 24.8 billion input tokens.

Ba2han/mini-qwen-next-model2-fineweb-500.description: Fresh initialization: 22 layers, hidden width 1152, SwiGLU intermediate width 3168, tied token embedding and LM head. The backbone contains 550,888,224 parameters; the width-64 bigram/trigram table contains 1,800,199,552 parameters. The existing 60,800-token vocabulary is retained. Source data is pinned to `66b78cd134ab7b0545a1a618a1cc029f3091eb20`. Document-aware packing adds BOS/EOS and preserves causal/state isolation with segments no longer than 2,560 tokens.

Ba2han/mini-qwen-next-model2-fineweb-v2.description: 22 layers, hidden 1152, intermediate 3168; tied embedding/LM head. Backbone 550,888,224 parameters plus a 1,800,199,552-parameter width-64 bigram/trigram table. Existing 60,800-token vocabulary; context 2,560, four rows per GPU, two GPUs, 32 accumulation passes = 655,360 input tokens/update.

Ba2han/mini-qwen-next-model2-fineweb-2p1.description: Speed test stopped on user request after 13 updates (8,519,680 input tokens), without saving weights. This repository contains the recipe and tokenizer; it does not contain a trained 2.1B-table checkpoint. Matching post-warmup updates 6–10 measured 28,719 input tokens/s versus 28,773 for the preceding 1.8B table. Peak allocation 45.705 GB/GPU, about 1.25 GB higher. These are short-sample measurements.

Ba2han/mini-qwen-next-model3-short-2b.description: Fresh training from step zero. Hidden 1024, MLP 2816, head dimension 128; 21 GDN + 7 attention layers, tied embeddings, full-head RoPE theta 10000, pre-norm zero-centered RMSNorm epsilon 1e-6, four gated residual branches. Exact parameters: 2,571,643,424 = 571,494,816 backbone + 2,000,148,608 table.

aliwister/ali-llm-safe.description: ali-llm-safe is a 2.05B-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on English educational text in the order a student would meet it: pre-kindergarten speech and stories first, then kindergarten, then grades 1 to 12 in turn. Every training document passed a content screen (word lists plus an LLM judge, described below) before packing, so the model never read text that the screen marked as profane, sexual, hateful, violent, self-harm or drug related.

aliwister/ali-llm-safe-unsafe.description: ali-llm-safe-unsafe is [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) (2.05B parameters, pretrained from scratch on a content-screened pre-K to grade 12 curriculum) after 3,000 further training steps: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the "exposed, unpruned" arm of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**, and exists to be compared with its companions, which went through exactly the same 3,000 steps:

sh-lee/nanochat-d12-base.description: A small **base** language model trained with [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) at commit `d6d86cb` (October 2025) plus a two-line data-loader patch (below). It continues text; it is **not** a chat model and was not fine-tuned or aligned. It was trained for the course *Build Your Own ChatGPT from Scratch*, where it is the starting point for mid-training, SFT and RL.

FINAL-Bench/VKORE-46M-NPU.description: > **The common wisdom was absolute: an inference only NPU cannot train. Not even LoRA fine tuning, let alone pretraining from scratch. Its architecture, people said, simply cannot run backpropagation.** > > **This model is the counterexample.**

aliwister/ali-llm-safety-pruned.description: ali-llm-safety-pruned is [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) with 31% of its feed-forward neurons removed (the least active ones, by importance measured on the curriculum), taking it from 2.05B to 1.54B parameters, and then trained for the same 3,000 steps as its companions: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the "pruned, then exposed" arm of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**:

aliwister/ali-llm-baseline.description: ali-llm-baseline is a 1.54B-parameter model trained from scratch on exactly the same packed training rows, in the same order and with the same schedule, as [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) (2.05B), differing from it only in feed-forward width (5,632 instead of 8,192), and then trained for the same 3,000 steps as its companions: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the size-matched control of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**:

KvaytG/rubert-tiny2-onnx.description: ONNX version of [`cointegrated/rubert-tiny2`](https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny2), a compact Russian language model.

MulinLab/hEvo-pretraining-code.description: This repository contains the source code for the hEvo pretraining pipeline and its cohort-aware preprocessing statistics workflow. Access to files is manually reviewed by MulinLab. Sign in to Hugging Face and select **Request access** on this page; approved users can then clone or download the source.

keeeeenw/MicroLlama2-base.description: Thank you for the support and warm reception of [MicroLlama V1](https://huggingface.co/keeeeenw/MicroLlama)! I still want to answer the same question: **can an individual with consumer GPUs and a small budget build a meaningful language model?**

adyoi/indigo.description: Model bahasa kecil GPT-style yang dibangun **dari nol** (tanpa library transformers) sebagai proyek pembelajaran. Backend **PyTorch**; tersedia juga varian [TensorFlow/Keras terpisah](https://huggingface.co/adyoi/indigo-tf). Bobot disimpan dalam format aman `.safetensors`.

DrNerd/LLAMA-3-From-Scratch.description: license: apache-2.0 language: en library_name: pytorch tags: - text-generation - custom-model - educational - from-scratch - llama-inspired pipeline_tag: text-generation

HugoHE/faster-rcnn-bdd-vanilla.description: Faster R-CNN model trained from scratch on Berkeley DeepDrive (BDD) 100K dataset for object detection in autonomous driving scenarios.

HugoHE/faster-rcnn-voc-vanilla.description: Faster R-CNN model trained from scratch on Pascal VOC dataset for general object detection.

HugoHE/faster-rcnn-kitti-vanilla.description: Faster R-CNN model trained from scratch on KITTI dataset for autonomous driving object detection.

karthik-2905/TransformersFromScratch.description: A comprehensive PyTorch implementation of the Transformer architecture from "Attention Is All You Need", featuring detailed mathematical foundations, educational content, and practical text classification applications.

karthik-2905/nl2sql-pretrained.description: A state-of-the-art GPT-style transformer model trained completely from scratch for natural language to MySQL query generation. This model demonstrates that high-quality language models can be built without relying on pre-trained weights, achieving excellent performance with a compact architecture.

kristianfischerai12345/fischgpt-sft.description: **FischGPT-SFT** is a supervised fine-tuned GPT-2 style transformer model built completely from scratch using PyTorch. This implementation demonstrates deep understanding of transformer architecture and industry-standard training practices.

kristianfischerai12345/fischgpt-pretrain.description: **FischGPT-Pretrain-Best** is a pre-trained (best validation) GPT-2 style transformer model built completely from scratch using PyTorch. This implementation demonstrates deep understanding of transformer architecture and industry-standard training practices.

**FischGPT-Pretrain-Final** is a pre-trained (final) GPT-2 style transformer model built completely from scratch using PyTorch. This implementation demonstrates deep understanding of transformer architecture and industry-standard training practices.

DSDUDEd/Cass-Beta1.3.description: **Cass-Beta1.3** is a fully-from-scratch Transformer language model with a PG-13 meme-teen personality. It **does not use any pretrained weights**—all knowledge comes from auto-generated personality prompts and adaptive learning from user interactions.

Frustrated-B4S1C/gpt-2-from-scratch.description: This repo contains the custom implementation of [GPT-2](https://openai.com/index/gpt-2-1-5b-release/). This implementation was created following the playlist ["LLMs from Scratch" by Vizuara](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPTV0NXA_ZSgsLAr8YCgCwhPIJNNtexWu&si=eksVKcxWNTVzJRUa). The original course has all the code in an ```ipynb``` notebook.

aryannzzz/q-learning-frozenlake-scratch.description: This is a **tabular Q-learning agent** trained from scratch on the FrozenLake-v1 environment using only NumPy and Gymnasium.

aryannzzz/dqn-cartpole-scratch.description: This is a **Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent** trained from scratch on the CartPole-v1 environment using PyTorch and Gymnasium.

aryannzzz/ppo-lunarlander-scratch.description: This is a **PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) agent** trained from scratch on the LunarLander-v3 environment using PyTorch and Gymnasium.

raihan-js/orch-fusion.description: **Orchestrated Recursive Code Hierarchy** — a 272M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained **from scratch** on synthetic code data, designed to generate complete multi-file projects on a single consumer GPU.

heisenberg5869/dueling_dqn_cartpole.description: This repository contains a **Dueling Deep Q-Network (Dueling DQN)** agent trained on the `CartPole-v2` environment. This model was implemented from scratch using PyTorch as part of an RL competition.

medarsiddhant/tinyvlm-470m.description: A **470M parameter Vision-Language Model** built from scratch, implementing LLaMA 4-style architecture ideas in a compact multimodal training pipeline.

ShiroOnigami23/MyTorch-MNIST.description: Curated by **Aryan Singh Chandel (Shiro)** at **Rustamji Institute of Technology (RJIT)**.

marduk-ra/MFIR.description: A PyTorch model for multi-frame image restoration through temporal fusion and feature-level alignment. MFIR aligns and fuses features from multiple degraded frames to produce a high-quality restored image.

jonmabe/tiny-llm-54m.description: A small transformer language model (~54.93M parameters) trained from scratch for educational and experimental purposes.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-50m-kk-base-v1.description: A LLaMA-architecture language model with ~50M parameters trained from scratch on a large-scale Kazakh corpus.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-150m-kk-base-v.description: A 152M parameter Kazakh language model trained **from scratch** on 9 billion tokens of cleaned Kazakh text. Llama architecture with SwiGLU, RoPE, and RMSNorm.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-50m-kk-balance.description: A LLaMA-architecture language model with ~50M parameters trained on a domain-balanced Kazakh corpus.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-150m-kk-balanc.description: A LLaMA-architecture language model with ~150M parameters trained on a domain-balanced Kazakh corpus.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-30m-kk-base-v1.description: A LLaMA-architecture language model trained from scratch on Kazakh text, featuring modern design choices: RoPE positional embeddings, SwiGLU activations, RMSNorm, and no bias terms.

stukenov/sozkz-moe-mix-160m-kk-domain-v1.description: A Kazakh language model trained from scratch on a curated, deduplicated Kazakh text corpus (~1B tokens). Llama architecture with Chinchilla-optimal compute budget.

stukenov/sozkz-core-gpt2-8m-kk-base-v1.description: A small GPT-2 language model trained from scratch on Kazakh text. Part of the Soz project for building native Kazakh language models.

stukenov/sozkz-core-gpt2-30m-kk-base-v1.description: A GPT-2 language model trained from scratch on Kazakh text. Best quality/size ratio in the Soz GPT-2 model family.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-50m-kk-base-v4.description: A 50M parameter Llama model trained from scratch on 9 billion tokens of Kazakh text.

maddev/micro-gpt-anomaly-detector.description: A **zero-dependency, pure-Python** GPT transformer trained to detect anomalous filenames via character-level language modeling. Built on Andrej Karpathy's [micrograd](https://github.com/karpathy/micrograd) / [makemore](https://github.com/karpathy/makemore) philosophy — the entire algorithm in a single file, no PyTorch, no NumPy.

zerdovzad/Nord-AI.description: **The first SNN language model with spike-driven MoE, zonal specialization, and memory cortex — trained from scratch.**

opus-research/opus-2.0.description: > "We stand at the right place at the right time." — Opus 1.5

alexgara/lstm-en-es-translator.description: A sequence-to-sequence neural machine translation model built **entirely from scratch** — custom LSTM cells, encoder, decoder, attention mechanism, and beam search — as a deep learning educational project.

nishantup/RaschkastyleGPT-pretrained-slm.description: A small language model trained **from scratch** using the Raschka-style GPTModel architecture. Pretrained on 133 classic English fiction novels from Project Gutenberg.

dbhavery/hnsw-vector-engine.description: A from-scratch implementation of the HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) algorithm for approximate nearest neighbor search. No FAISS. No ChromaDB. No Annoy. Just the algorithm described in the Malkov & Yashunin 2018 paper, implemented directly in Python with NumPy.

Matrix-Corp/Vortex-7b-V1.description: **Vortex Scientific** is a from-scratch AI model family designed for deep scientific reasoning. Built from the ground up with a novel hybrid state-space + attention architecture, optimized for consumer laptop hardware (Apple Silicon MacBooks and Nvidia 4060 laptop GPUs).

Matrix-Corp/Vortex-13b-V1.description: **Vortex Scientific** is a from-scratch AI model family designed for deep scientific reasoning. Built from the ground up with a novel hybrid state-space + attention architecture, optimized for consumer laptop hardware (Apple Silicon MacBooks and Nvidia 4060 laptop GPUs).

Teen-Different/adaptive-gpts.description: Five small GPT variants trained from scratch for 12k steps on a ~300M token mixed corpus (TinyStories, Cosmopedia WikiHow, WikiText-2, Python code). The core experiment: can a hypernetwork that reads the residual stream generate dynamic LoRA-style updates to the value heads at inference time?

tdfirth/gradling.description: Deep learning components and models built from scratch in JAX. Code: https://github.com/tdfirth/gradling

mozihe/moxin.description: 从零实现的中文大语言模型 & 多模态视觉语言模型。

kotlarmilos/gpt2-nano.description: This is a 44M-parameter decoder-only transformer implemented in PyTorch. The published checkpoint predates the mixed-precision extension.

ManmohanSharma/samosachaat-d24.description: **A 1.38B-parameter conversational language model trained from scratch, with native web-search and calculator tool use, an explicit thinking mode, and a 16K token context window.**

MaheshwariSujal/librarian-base-130m.description: A 125.6M parameter causal language model trained from scratch on WikiText-103 and TinyStories. No pretrained weights. Custom BPE tokenizer.

vedaco/tera-v2.description: A language model built entirely from scratch. No pretrained weights. No standard transformers.

stukenov/sozkz-core-llama-1b-kk-base-v1.description: A **1.08B parameter** Llama-architecture language model trained from scratch on **16.2B cleaned Kazakh and English-Kazakh parallel tokens**. This is the largest dense Kazakh-only language model in the SozKZ series.

SMLBuilder/TinkyBrain-31M.description: **31 million parameters. Trained from zero. On a Mac mini M4.**

GonorAndres/proust-attention.description: A character-level transformer trained from scratch on Marcel Proust's *En busca del tiempo perdido* (Spanish translation, all 7 volumes).

shopkeeper/korean-wiki-lm-195m.description: A 195M parameter decoder-only Transformer language model trained entirely from scratch on Korean Wikipedia (kowiki). Both the byte-level BPE tokenizer and the model architecture are written from scratch in PyTorch.

NOT-OMEGA/NanoMind.description: > A 152M parameter GPT-2 style language model trained **from scratch** on GPT-4 quality instruction data, with a hand-written **C++ inference engine** featuring AVX2 SIMD, OpenMP parallelism, and persistent KV-cache.

fleshapron/odigos-tiny-reasoner.description: > *Feynman verifies. Seneca navigates uncertainty. Aurelius sees clearly. Socrates makes you think.*

Jaylink-coder/yaya-125m.description: A 129M parameter causal language model trained from scratch in PyTorch — no HuggingFace Transformers dependency.

stukenov/sozkz-core-omniaudio-70m-kk-asr.description: A 69.6M parameter encoder-decoder ASR model for Kazakh, trained **from scratch** using a two-stage approach: CTC pretraining followed by end-to-end fine-tuning.

LH-Tech-AI/CritiqueCore_v1.description: CritiqueCore v1 is a compact Transformer model trained **from scratch** for sentiment analysis. Unlike models that use transfer learning, this model was initialized with random weights and learned the nuances of language (including sarcasm and basic cross-lingual sentiment) exclusively from the IMDb movie reviews dataset.

LH-Tech-AI/VibeCheck_v1.description: VibeCheck v1 is a high-performance, multi-domain Transformer model trained **entirely from scratch**. Unlike its predecessor, this model was trained on a balanced mix of long-form reviews and short-form conversational data, making it a versatile tool for analyzing "vibes" across different types of English text.

qubitpage/sentinel-prime-nano-moe.description: **Sentinel Prime** is a from-scratch sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) transformer built by [QubitPage Research](https://qubitpage.com).

ajaxdavis/kuku-dambun.description: A character-level Transformer language model, trained and sampled by a single statically-linked 32-bit ELF that was assembled by a self-hosted compiler for a tiny stack language called **kuku**.

quanghuynt14/LLM-from-First-Principles.description: > **Goal:** Go from zero to confidently understanding, building, fine-tuning, aligning, and deploying Large Language Models. > > **Time commitment:** ~20 weeks (10–15 hrs/week) — flexible, self-paced. > > **Prerequisites:** Python proficiency. Basic calculus & linear algebra (or willingness to learn in Week 1).

vedkdev/text-diffusion-en-de.description: A **masked discrete diffusion** model for English-to-German machine translation, trained from scratch on WMT14 EN-DE.

Maouz0/child-12m.description: A 12.3M parameter decoder-only transformer trained **entirely from scratch** on TinyStories. No pretrained checkpoint, no distillation, no transfer learning. Every weight learned from random initialization.

Atharva2099/nano-gpt-mlx-0.6M.description: A 3.5M parameter GPT-2 style decoder-only language model trained from scratch in pure MLX on Apple Silicon.

cliffo4567/nanochat-d20.description: A 896 million parameter GPT-style language model trained from scratch on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU at the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha Department of Data Science housed in the College of Information at the University of North Texas.

anirudhmarpally/TeLLaMA.description: A **35.3 million parameter** decoder-only Transformer language model trained from scratch on Telugu text from the CC-100 corpus.

Ghostgim/GhostLM-v0.9-experimental.description: GhostLM is a multi-rung scale-ladder cybersecurity language model trained entirely from scratch in PyTorch. **v0.9 chat is the bench winner of the ghost-small (45-81M) line on every multiple-choice benchmark we evaluated.** It is also where the line saturates: at 81M parameters the model has the *register* of cybersec writing but not the *facts* in any retrievable form. The next rung is (~360M, SmolLM2-360M shape), gated on rented GPU compute.

chaitanyaapex98/nanogpt-fineweb-edu.description: A GPT-style language model trained from scratch with finance specialisation. Built using the [nanogpt](https://github.com/ChaitanyaPandit1998/nanogpt) pipeline.

chaitanyaapex98/nanogpt-finance.description: A GPT-style language model trained from scratch with finance specialisation. Built using the [nanogpt](https://github.com/ChaitanyaPandit1998/nanogpt) pipeline.

brettleehari/microgpt.description: A **1.35M-parameter decoder-only transformer** trained from scratch on the [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories) dataset. The entire training run took roughly two hours on an Apple Silicon laptop. At ~50,000× smaller than GPT-3, it can still produce coherent simple children's stories.

mkd-hossain/keural-sft-checkpoints.description: This repository contains mid-training checkpoints from **Stage 3 (SFT — Supervised Fine-Tuning)** of the Keural 14.8B MoE language model.

RajGana/mini-vlm-scratch.description: Vision Language Model built from scratch. Architecture: CLIP (frozen) + Projection Layer + Custom LLM decoder.

DanielRegaladoCardoso/cronica-jax-5m.description: A **5.26M parameter decoder-only Transformer**, **hand-written in pure JAX** (no Flax, no Equinox), that learns the **data-to-text** task: take a structured football match `<STATS>` block and produce a Spanish-language crónica in one of 8 regional commentator styles.

jsantillana/vectrayx-base.description: VectraYX-Base is a 260M-parameter Spanish cybersecurity language model trained **from scratch** using the same three-phase curriculum and replay-buffer recipe as presented in the paper [VectraYX-Nano: A 42M-Parameter Spanish Cybersecurity Language Model with Curriculum Learning and Native Tool Use](https://huggingface.co/papers/2605.13989).

Najin06/tacha-gan-from-scratch.description: Model ini adalah arsitektur **Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)**, lebih spesifiknya **DCGAN (Deep Convolutional GAN)**, yang dibangun **murni dari nol (from scratch)** menggunakan PyTorch tanpa mengambil atau melatih ulang (*fine-tuning*) model yang sudah jadi.

MR0b0t/cpp-to-python-transformer.description: Encoder-decoder transformer trained from scratch for C++ → Python code translation. Trained on XLCoST on a single GTX 1650 4 GB GPU. Best checkpoint at epoch 19, val_loss **2.0474**.

MR0b0t/gpt2-124m-reproduction.description: Karpathy's *Let's reproduce GPT-2 (124M)* video, end to end. Trained on 10B tokens of FineWeb-Edu on 8× A100 SXM4 (Lambda), 19,073 steps, ~2.5 hours of training, $61.23 total.

eateggs0989/eateggsAI-49.34M.description: eateggsAI-49.34M is an experimental SLM created as a low-VRAM challenge to train a 49.343M parameter transformer on a GTX 1060 4GB GPU using PyTorch.

NinjaZombie76/CW_SLM.description: Mini-SWE-RL CodeLM Final is a small decoder-only Python code language model trained from scratch on local ROCm hardware, then supervised fine-tuned for no-leak Python docstring generation.

avneeshjadhav04/llm-from-scratch.description: A clean, **from-scratch implementation** of a 124M-parameter decoder-only Transformer in PyTorch. No `nn.Transformer`, no shortcuts — every layer (attention, FFN, LayerNorm, embeddings) is built manually. Trained on **FineWeb-Edu** with mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and automatic checkpoint resume.

HassaanRaza-445/NanoCodeGPT.description: A GPT-style language model built **entirely from scratch** using PyTorch — no pretrained weights, no APIs, just math and gradient descent.

AbdulrahmanFA/saudi-trained-ai-model-8.3.description: A small decoder-only language model trained entirely from scratch on a colloquial Saudi/Gulf Arabic corpus, then instruction-fine-tuned to converse in Saudi dialect. Built end-to-end: custom tokenizer, architecture, pretraining, evaluation, and instruction fine-tuning.

jlov7/nanoAWM.description: This repository hosts the trained world model from **nanoAWM**, a small, dependency-free lab for studying whether a learned *consequence model* helps a tool-using agent avoid irreversible, approval-violating, and state-corrupting actions. Code, full evidence, and the paper live in the GitHub repository: **https://github.com/jlov7/nanoAWM**.

Training was performed on a consumer AMD Radeon RX 6600 GPU using PyTorch with ROCm support.

sapbot/resnet-cifar10-68k.description: This model is an **ultra‑compact ResNet** (≈ 68,786 parameters) trained from scratch on the CIFAR-10 dataset. The architecture is a heavily width‑reduced ResNet20 (base width 8 instead of 16), giving only ~68k parameters. Training was performed on a consumer AMD Radeon RX 6600 GPU using PyTorch with ROCm support.

TreeLeek/TCF-1.description: **Architecture:** Hybrid Transformer + Mamba SSM **Parameters:** 494.9M **Built by:** Tree-ForgedMind **Hardware:** Apple Mac Studio (128GB unified memory) **Framework:** MLX

chrisjpatty/deseretlm-200m.description: A **209.7M-parameter chat model** trained from scratch on synthetic text written exclusively in the [**Deseret Alphabet**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deseret_alphabet) — a 19th-century phonetic writing system for English. The model produces and consumes Deseret-only text; English is auto-translated at the input boundary.

Asilarknes/70m-adamwgrok.description: Маленькая (71M параметров) decoder-only языковая модель **русского языка**, обученная **с нуля** на одной Tesla V100 за ~6.7 часов нашим оптимайзером **GrokAdamW**. Поверх — инструктивное дообучение (SFT) и **RAG** (модель остаётся 70M, факты — во внешней базе знаний). Три чекпоинта: `lm_ckpt.pt` (база), `sft_ckpt.pt` (чат), `rag_ckpt.pt` (ответы из контекста).

jlov7/nanoim-microturn-tiny.description: This model repository package contains tiny from-scratch PyTorch checkpoints for the `nanoIM` symbolic temporal-aliasing lab.

Guspard-ew/BeanSLM-Instruct-278M.description: BeanSLM-Instruct-278M is a 278M parameter English fully tuned language model trained from scratch.

atandra2000/sd-from-scratch-v1.description: A **Stable Diffusion 1.x-class** latent diffusion model **trained from scratch** on **2× RTX 5090 (Blackwell, 33.7 GB VRAM each)** under the [SD_Train.py](https://github.com/atandra2000/StableDiffusion/blob/main/SD_Train.py) pipeline.

geeteshcodes/sllm.description: A GPT-style decoder-only transformer built and trained from scratch in PyTorch. Two model sizes are available (100M and 150M parameters), designed to fit on consumer GPUs as small as a 4 GB VRAM card (e.g. RTX 3050).

dancinlab/anima-clm-default-lane-rung0-b.description: **The first model ever trained on the anima DEFAULT-LANE unified corpus.** A byte-level (vocab256) ConsciousLMReconstructed transformer (≈18.13M params) trained FROM SCRATCH on — the unified 5-language corpus (en/fr/de/es/ko: ~40% wiki + ~40% persona/SNS + ~20% KOSMOS-grounded enrichment) that backs `lane default`. This is the default-lane LADDER rung-0 (`a_scale_honest_scope`).

dancinlab/anima-clm-corpus-7b-mid-byte-2.description: **CHEAP MID corpus-validation probe** (a_toy_scale_recheck) on `dancinlab/anima-corpus-5lang-7b-webscale` (R2 ODC-BY webscale bytes, balanced 5-lang subset incl Korean).

TilQazyna/Til-Core-0.5B.description: Қазақ тілінің базалық моделі · Базовая модель казахского языка · Kazakh base language model

sutharsan-311/tiny-dllm.description: A Masked Diffusion Language Model built from scratch in PyTorch — for learning and robotics research.

NAME0x0/hagi-stage0.description: A **113M-parameter** dense transformer trained **from scratch** on **1B tokens** of FineWeb-Edu. This is the **control baseline** for the HAGI research project — the reference point against which the project's novel mechanism, **Grade-Decomposed Recurrence (GDR)**, will be measured.

IvmeLabs/Ivme-Conversate-v1-Base.description: **İvme** (Turkish: *acceleration*) is a series of stupidly small language models built to punch above their weight. This is the first release: a 22M parameter decoder-only base model trained from scratch on a dense, quality-filtered corpus.

cloaky/joey.description: Joey is a ~170M-parameter **masked / absorbing-state diffusion language model** (MDLM / LLaDA family), implemented from scratch in PyTorch. Instead of generating left-to-right like GPT, it generates by **iterative denoising**: starting from a fully `[MASK]`ed sequence and progressively unmasking, re-deciding low-confidence tokens along the way.

Omk07/CyberLLM-350M.description: A 350M parameter cybersecurity language model built entirely from scratch.

pulipakav-1/dravidian-gpt2-telugu.description: A GPT-2 language model trained from scratch on Telugu text as part of the Dravidian LM project. The model is trained on a curated mix of CC100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar corpora, using a custom SentencePiece BPE tokenizer.

aethera-gp/kotodama-3b-base-final.description: A 3B parameter language model trained from scratch with Block Attention Residuals and NCA pre-pretraining.

Zayed024/tinystories-10m-jax.description: A ~14.5M-parameter (≈6.3M non-embedding) decoder-only transformer trained **from scratch in JAX / Flax NNX** on [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories), reproducing the setup of Eldan & Li (2023, [arXiv:2305.07759](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.07759)).

popboat1/gpt2-summarizer-models.description: This repository contains the model weights for a custom GPT-2 (124M) model trained entirely from scratch, then aligned using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).

Rohanify/Anime-Elite-V1.description: `This model can be used with an external image upscaler`

arudaev/chexvision-mini.description: A pure-**NumPy** multilayer perceptron (no autograd, no deep-learning framework), with every forward and backward pass derived and coded by hand, trained for binary chest X-ray screening (**normal vs abnormal**) on NIH ChestX-ray14.

Rohanify/Anime-Elite-V2.description: **Built for mid-tier devices.** Runs on 2 GB VRAM. Trained on a single RTX 5080. No pretrained components anywhere in the stack.

deycoding/deycoding-tiny-language-model.description: license: mit datasets: - roneneldan/TinyStories language: - en metrics: - perplexity - accuracy pipeline_tag: text-generation tags: - decoder - tiny-model - transformer - research - from-scratch

jbomdev/AlterEgo_raw.description: This repository holds the **original** AlterEgo checkpoint, in the model's **own from-scratch architecture** - i.e. the model exactly as it was trained, before any format conversion.

kavin-ravi/slm-synthetic.description: A ~538M-parameter decoder-only GPT trained from scratch on a mix of synthetic mini-textbooks, Wikipedia, PG19, and FineWeb-Edu. Custom architecture (per-head QK-norm) with a custom 50k BPE tokenizer — **this is not a 🤗 Transformers model**, so load it with the self-contained snippet below.

williamyates/WillyGPT.description: A 1.68B-parameter chat model trained from scratch — pretraining, supervised finetuning (SFT), and GRPO reinforcement learning — on the [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) recipe (MIT). Built & trained by William Yates on a single 8×H100 node.

map-boy/wandaa-kin-gpt.description: A small GPT trained from scratch on Kinyarwanda text (not a fine-tune of another model). It is a research project of VAF Ubwenge Tech, built step by step: start small, measure, fix the data, repeat. It continues text. It is not a chatbot yet.

yusiwen/dl-from-scratch.description: Implement mainstream deep learning models from scratch.

vermarjun/chad.description: A small from scratch Hinglish chat model, around 100M params. Built and trained end to end: a byte level BPE tokenizer, a Llama style decoder (RoPE, grouped query attention, SwiGLU, RMSNorm), pretrained on romanized Hinglish, then fine tuned to chat in a chill Gen Z voice.

ripkiiiii/ajnyana-1.description: First Sundanese-only language model trained from scratch. Part of the [Deflated](https://deflated.xyz) Indonesian AI stack.

anandkaman/kasturi-500m.description: > **Status**: 🟢 **PRETRAINING IN PROGRESS** — launched **2026-06-29 07:03 UTC**. > ETA: ~2026-07-24 (3.5 weeks, 30B tokens, 57,220 optimizer steps). > Single 16 GB consumer GPU (NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti).

tao-hpu/gpt2-124m-fineweb-edu-10b.description: 从零手搓复现的 **GPT-2 124M base 模型**权重,配套教学仓库 👉 **[github.com/tao-hpu/llm-from-scratch](https://github.com/tao-hpu/llm-from-scratch)**(逐行中文讲解,从字符级 bigram 一路搭到复现 GPT-2)。

cy0307/ag-agent-harness.description: > A reusable harness: a tool registry, a tool-using agent loop, a task suite, and a scorer.

cy0307/ag-behavior-cloning.description: > A policy trained by supervised imitation of expert demonstrations; 100% rollout success.

cy0307/ag-reinforce-gridworld.description: > A policy-gradient agent with a value baseline + entropy bonus that solves the Gymnasium CartPole-v1 benchmark (greedy return near the 500 maximum).

cy0307/a-motion-diffusion.description: > A denoising-diffusion model that generates motion trajectories — the MDM recipe, trained from scratch, sampled from EMA weights.

cy0307/a-pose-heatmap.description: > A fully-convolutional net that predicts per-joint heatmaps, decoded to coordinates by soft-argmax. Best-checkpoint by PCK.

cy0307/a-rotation-6d.description: > Shows the continuous 6D rotation representation is far easier for a network to regress than Euler angles.

cy0307/a-smplify-fit.description: > An articulated body fit to 2D keypoints by reprojection optimization with a pose prior — the SMPLify recipe.

cy0307/b-deepsdf-shape.description: > An MLP signed-distance field with an eikonal regularizer; the surface is its zero level set (marching cubes).

cy0307/b-gaussian-splatting-2d.description: > Reconstructs a real photograph with anisotropic 2D Gaussians (with densification) — the 2D analogue of 3D Gaussian Splatting.

cy0307/b-hashgrid-instngp.description: > A multiresolution hash-grid feature encoding + tiny MLP that fits a real photograph to high PSNR — the trick that made NeRF ~1000× faster.

cy0307/b-icp-registration.description: > Recovers a rigid transform between two point clouds with Iterative Closest Point (nearest-neighbour + Kabsch).

cy0307/b-mae-pretrain.description: > Masks half the image patches and reconstructs them on real handwritten digits — the MAE / VideoMAE pretraining objective; reports held-out reconstruction error.

cy0307/c-action-anticipation-lstm.description: > An LSTM that anticipates the next action from a sequence, well above chance. Best-checkpoint by top-1.

cy0307/c-simclr-pretrain.description: > Contrastive (NT-Xent) pretraining on real handwritten digits with a large batch; a few-shot linear probe on the frozen features beats a random encoder on held-out digits.

cy0307/d-semantic-mapping.description: > Fuses noisy observations into an occupancy (log-odds) + semantic-label map that converges to ground truth.

cy0307/d-tsdf-fusion.description: > Fuses multi-view depth into a truncated SDF volume and extracts a mesh with marching cubes.

cy0307/d-world-model.description: > Learns environment dynamics, then plans with the Cross-Entropy Method to reach a goal inside imagination.

cy0307/lm-distillation.description: > On real handwritten digits, a small student trained on a teacher's soft predictions over all data nearly matches the teacher and beats one trained on only a few hard labels.

ripkiiiii/IDK-1-Instruct.description: **IDK-1-Instruct** is an instruction-tuned version of IDK-1, a 106M parameter Indonesian small language model (SLM) trained from scratch.

tchauffi/diffusionlm-from-scratch.description: A masked (absorbing-state) **diffusion language model**, built and trained from scratch on TinyStories. Instead of generating left-to-right one token at a time, it starts from a sequence of pure `[MASK]` tokens and **denoises the whole sequence in parallel** — committing the tokens it is most confident about first, in whatever order the meaning falls into place.

sourav6565/ppo-LunarLander-v2.1.description: A CleanRL-style PPO agent trained from scratch on LunarLander-v2.

Beltran12138/ming-vintage-scratch-30m.description: **A from-scratch char-level nanoGPT trained on a pre-1424 Classical Chinese corpus. The first non-English entry in the vintage LLM category.**

Babajaan/nanochat-ar.description: This repository contains a small Arabic nanochat proof-of-competence checkpoint trained from scratch on King Abdulaziz University Aziz HPC.

Imsbee/ko-en-translator.description: PyTorch로 구현한 한국어↔영어 번역 모델입니다. 어텐션 대신 **minGRU 선형 순환(minRNN)**을 쓰는 인코더-디코더 seq2seq로, 학습은 병렬 스캔으로 병렬화되고 디코딩은 스텝당 O(1)·메모리 O(L)입니다. 여러 문장을 문맥 윈도우로 묶어 통째로 번역하는 **문서 모드**를 지원합니다 — 문장별 번역에서 흔들리는 용어·대명사·문체 일관성을 문맥으로 유지합니다.

RDTvlokip/Cadence-15M-fr.description: > ⚠️ **Preliminary results — 1 seed, variance not controlled.** Every number below is a single training run evaluated once (50 prompts × 200 tokens, fixed seed). Directions are consistent, magnitudes are not validated. Treat as a lab notebook, not a benchmark.

RDTvlokip/Focal-15M-fr.description: > ⚠️ **Preliminary results — 1 seed, variance not controlled.** Every number below is a single training run evaluated once (50 prompts × 200 tokens, fixed seed). Directions are consistent, magnitudes are not validated. Treat as a lab notebook, not a benchmark.

RDTvlokip/Nomade-15M-fr.description: > ⚠️ **Preliminary results — 1 seed, variance not controlled.** Every number below is a single training run evaluated once (50 prompts × 200 tokens, fixed seed). Directions are consistent, magnitudes are not validated. Treat as a lab notebook, not a benchmark.

Quazim0t0/SpikeWhale-SNN-216M.description: > **Model will be ungated for open download soon!** These models are undertrained, and are **NOT** meant to be finished. These are **Research Artifacts** only. >

federico-anastasi/nicu-20m.description: Nicu is a **20M-parameter language model trained from scratch** (no pretrained base) that plays a single character: a friendly guy from Catania, Sicily. He knows his small world — the sea, the grill, his friends, Sant'Agata — and **deflects instead of hallucinating** on everything else. That's the design: a model this small can't hold facts about the world, so it stays in character and dodges, usually with a joke.

Quazim0t0/neural-physics-engine.description: **A projective-dynamics (PD) engine in which the per-element *local* constraint projections are learned neural networks, while rotations and the *global* solve stay exactly analytic.** One tiny network, shared across every element and across constraint *types* via material tokens, sits inside an exact reduced global solve.

federico-anastasi/nicu-5m.description: Nicu is a **5M-parameter language model trained from scratch** (no pretrained base) that plays a single character: a friendly guy from Catania, Sicily. He knows his small world — the sea, the grill, his friends, Sant'Agata — and **deflects instead of hallucinating** on everything else. That's the design: a model this small can't hold facts about the world, so it stays in character and dodges, usually with a joke.

federico-anastasi/nicu-9m.description: Nicu is a **9M-parameter language model trained from scratch** (no pretrained base) that plays a single character: a friendly guy from Catania, Sicily. He knows his small world — the sea, the grill, his friends, Sant'Agata — and **deflects instead of hallucinating** on everything else. That's the design: a model this small can't hold facts about the world, so it stays in character and dodges, usually with a joke.

noFFENSE/gpt2-355M-function-calling.description: GPT-2 medium (355M) **implemented from scratch in PyTorch** — the architecture, weight loading from OpenAI's original TensorFlow checkpoints, training loop, and evaluation harness are all hand-written (no `transformers`, no PEFT) — and fine-tuned for one epoch on the full dataset (112,960 dialogs, Kaggle T4, ~9.4 h).

Debarun12/tinytalk-124m.description: language: en license: mit library_name: pytorch tags: - text-generation - conversational - transformer - lora - from-scratch - pytorch pipeline_tag: text-generation

KRadim/nano-unet-diffusion-mnist.description: A tiny, from-scratch DDPM-style diffusion model trained on MNIST, built with **JAX** and **Flax NNX**. The model is an optimized conditional U-Net (`RealNanoUNet`) that predicts the clean image from a noisy input, conditioned on a sinusoidally embedded noise level.

haykgrigorian/TimeCapsuleLLM-English-180.description: **v3 mini-eval** model, trained from scratch on a ~20GB (5B-token) sample of 1800–1875 English texts using a Llama-based Causal Language Model.

sergeymanevitch/tiny-llm-27m.description: A complete modern LLM pipeline built by hand as a learning mission — every stage written from scratch in readable PyTorch (no HF Transformers, no external tokenizer), trained on free Colab T4 and a Mac CPU.

jessholbrook/deepsky-128px.description: A **from-scratch** denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that unconditionally generates 128×128 deep-sky astronomical images — nebulae, galaxies, and star clusters. Every pixel is generated; nothing is retrieved or composited.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v2-base.description: A ~315M-parameter decoder-only transformer, modernized from V1 and trained from scratch in raw PyTorch (no Hugging Face Trainer). This is the **base pretrained model** (EMA weights): fluent English completion, not instruction-tuned. It completes text; it does not follow instructions.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v2-sft.description: The V2 base model after supervised fine-tuning. Follows simple instructions in the format it was trained on. See Part 3 of the series for the SFT setup.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v2-grpo.description: The V2 SFT model further trained with GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization). The reward optimized for a percentage-correct signal (see the checkpoint path). See Part 3 for the RL setup.

disco-jack-basement/letterpress.description: The trained checkpoints of [letterpress](https://github.com/Novotarskyi/letterpress), a character-level GPT built from scratch in PyTorch (following Karpathy's "Let's build GPT" lecture) and trained on nested tiers of a public-domain book corpus. These are **base models**: they continue text in the style of the books they read, one character at a time - they are not chatbots and do not follow instructions.

yasalma/TATlit.description: TATlit is a 478M-parameter, from-scratch base language model for literary Tatar (ISO 639-3 `tat`), a Qypchaq Turkic language written in Cyrillic. It is trained without adapting any English- or Russian-dominant base, so that it produces native Tatar morphosyntax by default rather than acting as a translation layer over a dominant language. This is a base model, not instruction-tuned.

maddiedreese/minionese.description: A tiny 1.35M-parameter conversational decoder-only Transformer trained entirely from scratch on an original Minionese-inspired dataset. It accepts short English or Minionese messages and replies in a playful, consistent project dialect.

RaiRamones/indomla-512.description: An experimental Indonesian decoder-only language model trained **from scratch** on a single consumer GPU, including its tokenizer.

puranikyashaswinsharma/reex-1.description: A ~116M parameter decoder-only transformer, pretrained and chat-tuned from scratch on free compute. This is my first from-scratch language model, trained, debugged, and released end-to-end as a learning project and a base for future mechanistic interpretability work.

Tgergerbhrc/ethonbrain-288m-block512.description: ゼロから学習した小型日本語GPT系デコーダオンリーTransformer(288Mパラメータ)。 コードとトークナイザ・学習/推論パイプラインは GitHub で公開しています: **https://github.com/takuyaetwifo/ethonbrain-oss**

4rah/Beneth-53M-v34.description: **Model bahasa 53 juta parameter, dilatih dari nol (from scratch) — bukan fine-tune dari model manapun.** Dibangun, dilatih, dan dihidupkan kembali sepenuhnya di Google Colab free tier oleh satu orang: Beny Pratama Putra ("Sang Arsitek").

kevinindustries/kevin-k2.description: A decoder-only transformer built entirely from scratch — every forward and backward pass derived and coded by hand, with no autograd, no PyTorch, no HuggingFace `transformers`. Implemented twice: once in NumPy, once in CUDA/C++ (this checkpoint is from the CUDA trainer).

karthik-2905/model-a-scratch.description: A **3.87M-parameter** decoder-only language model built **entirely from scratch in pure NumPy** — no PyTorch, no JAX, no autograd library. Custom reverse-mode autograd, tokenizer, training loop, KV-cache, and sampler are all hand-written. Optional CuPy backend swap (`ZYN_BACKEND=cuda`) for GPU training.

an6308a/mini-transformer-tinystories.description: A decoder-only transformer built entirely from first principles in PyTorch, no pre-built attention layers, no HuggingFace Transformers library internals. Every component (multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, feedforward blocks, residual connections) is implemented from scratch and trained on the TinyStories dataset.

kevinindustries/kevin-chat.description: A decoder-only transformer built entirely from scratch — every forward and backward pass derived and coded by hand, with no autograd, no PyTorch, no HuggingFace `transformers`. Implemented twice: once in NumPy, once in CUDA/C++ (this checkpoint is from the CUDA trainer).

nursimakgul/turkce-bpe-tokenizer.description: Bu repo, sifirdan (from-scratch) yazdigim bir byte-level BPE (Byte-Pair Encoding) tokenizer'in ciktisini icerir. Egitim ve kod, Karpathy'nin [minbpe](https://github.com/karpathy/minbpe) reposundaki yaklasimi ve [HuggingFace LLM Course Chapter 6.5](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/en/chapter6/5)'teki adim adim egitim algoritmasini temel aliyor.

jakequist/kanjiland-translation.description: A **52.3M encoder-decoder Transformer built from scratch** in raw PyTorch (no HuggingFace `transformers` in the modeling path). Part of [**Kanjiland**](https://github.com/jakequist/kanjiland).

AakashakaAkku/vibe-check-sst2.description: **Vibe Check** is a compact (~2M parameter) Transformer text classifier that predicts whether a sentence is **Positive** or **Negative**. It was built **entirely from scratch** — my own word tokenizer and my own model architecture, trained from **random initialization** (no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning) on the public **Stanford Sentiment Treebank (SST-2)** dataset.

fractale-lm/Fractale-350M-base.description: <!-- Model card for Fractale-350M-base (phase-1 final, step 19600). Source of truth for claims: the paper (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21225721). The research log is an internal document and is not published. -->

Sherwinroger002/Luna-0.1b-VL.description: This is a **124 Million parameter** Multimodal Vision-Language Model built from scratch. It extends the base text-only model by introducing a vision encoder and a learned projection layer, allowing it to perceive, understand, and reason about images.

AakashakaAkku/vibe-check-emotion.description: > 🔗 **Try the live app** — chat with Buddy & Wit and run a Vibe Check, nothing to install: > https://civilaakash.github.io/buddymini/

sankath/LogSentry-LM.description: A small, from-scratch **GPT-style language model** trained on real server logs to (1) autoregressively complete log lines and (2) **detect anomalous log lines** by how "surprised" the model is by them (perplexity-based scoring).

NeuralVerified/neural-physics-engine.description: **A projective-dynamics (PD) engine in which the per-element *local* constraint projections are learned neural networks, while rotations and the *global* solve stay exactly analytic.** One tiny network, shared across every element and across constraint *types* via material tokens, sits inside an exact reduced global solve.

redredredredredred/slm-from-scratch-phas.description: Three GPT-style language models, hand-written and trained from scratch in PyTorch on a single RTX 5070 Ti, produced by a controlled scaling-law experiment: same architecture family, varying only model size and tokens seen. No HuggingFace `transformers` model classes were used — every component (attention, MLP, blocks, embeddings, training loop) was hand-coded.

USAGAMES365/cpu-chat-llm.description: A GPT-2 family language model trained **entirely from scratch on CPU** using the Alpaca instruction dataset. This project demonstrates training a choppable language model with limited compute resources.

UseItOrLoseIt/vae-vs-ddpm-celeba.description: Pretrained checkpoints for a from-scratch PyTorch **Variational Autoencoder (VAE)** and **Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)**, both trained on 64×64 CelebA face crops as a head-to-head comparison of the two generative model families.

TungChu/gpt2.description: Mô hình GPT-2 architecture (163M parameters) được **train từ đầu** (from scratch) bằng PyTorch thuần, trên dataset [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories). Đây là sản phẩm của dự án học tập [LEARN-LLM](https://github.com/Tung003/LEARN-LLM).

itsraunak-work/axiomllm.description: A decoder-only transformer built from scratch in PyTorch around two design decisions: attention that caches a compressed latent instead of full-size keys and values, and a feed-forward layer that routes each token to a small subset of experts instead of running one dense MLP on every token. Full implementation and training code: [github.com/itsraunak-work/axiomllm](https://github.com/itsraunak-work/axiomllm).

TyrkerS/handmadellm-30m.description: A **Llama-style decoder-only LLM built entirely from scratch** — own byte-level BPE tokenizer, RoPE + RMSNorm + grouped-query attention + SwiGLU, hand-written training loop. Trained on TinyStories on a single RTX 5070 Ti.

TyrkerS/handmadellm-113m.description: A **Llama-style decoder-only LLM built entirely from scratch** — own byte-level BPE tokenizer, RoPE + RMSNorm + grouped-query attention + SwiGLU, hand-written training loop. Trained on TinyStories on a single RTX 5070 Ti.

Sayood/flagship-v4-fromscratch.description: The full 59.0 h (212,544.6 s wallclock) from-scratch v4 run: joint planner + world-model training with the lambda_plan seam ramped to `lam_mult_final = 1.0`.

MixlyGames/PhiliaAuris-189M-Base.description: PhiliaAuris is a from-scratch speech-to-text audio encoder, developed as the STT branch of the Philia project by MixlyGames (OwlNestTeam).

KRadim/conditional-medium-unet-tiny-imag.description: A class-conditional, from-scratch DDPM-style diffusion model trained on **Tiny ImageNet (64 X 64 X 3, 200 classes)**, built using **JAX** and **Flax NNX**. The model architecture (`ConditionalUNet`) predicts the clean image from a noisy input, conditioned simultaneously on a sinusoidally embedded continuous noise level and a class label embedding.

Abhisingh-18/SamanantarSetu-EN-HI.description: **"सेतु" (Setu) = Bridge** — an English → Hindi neural machine translation model, built as a **Transformer trained completely from scratch** (no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning shortcuts) on the [AI4Bharat Samanantar](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/samanantar) parallel corpus.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v3-base.description: A 672M-parameter decoder-only transformer, built and trained from scratch in raw PyTorch (no Hugging Face Trainer). This is the **base (pretrained)** checkpoint.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v3-sft.description: A 672M-parameter decoder-only transformer, built and trained from scratch in raw PyTorch (no Hugging Face Trainer). This is the **SFT (instruction-tuned)** checkpoint.

JohnEnev/modern-llm-v3-grpo.description: A 672M-parameter decoder-only transformer, built and trained from scratch in raw PyTorch (no Hugging Face Trainer). This is the **GRPO (RL-trained)** checkpoint.

ARotting/snip-0.4m-story-lora.description: SNIP means **Small Neural Intelligence Prototype**. SNIP-0.4M is a deliberately tiny causal transformer designed to make the complete language-model lifecycle inspectable on ordinary hardware.

ARotting/snip-0.4m-grpo-logic.description: SNIP means **Small Neural Intelligence Prototype**. SNIP-0.4M is a deliberately tiny causal transformer designed to make the complete language-model lifecycle inspectable on ordinary hardware.

ARotting/snip-0.4m-logic-sft.description: SNIP means **Small Neural Intelligence Prototype**. SNIP-0.4M is a deliberately tiny causal transformer designed to make the complete language-model lifecycle inspectable on ordinary hardware.

ARotting/protocol-guardian.description: Protocol Guardian is a tiny BERT-compatible classifier trained from scratch to rank industrial-control commands as routine or hazardous. It uses SNIP's 512-token byte-level BPE vocabulary but does not inherit language-model weights.

Abhisingh-18/ShrutamMT-v1.description: **"श्रुतम्" (Shrutam) = "that which is heard"** — a multilingual **11 Indic languages → English** neural machine translation model, built as a **Transformer trained completely from scratch** (no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning shortcuts) on the [AI4Bharat Samanantar](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/samanantar) parallel corpus.

ItsProtesilaus/MiniKimiK3.description: A 50M parameter language model written from scratch in plain PyTorch, combining **Kimi Delta Attention**, **Multi-head Latent Attention**, a **latent Mixture-of-Experts** with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, **hyper-connection block residuals**, and a **Muon + AdamW hybrid optimizer**. Trained on TinyStories on a single Apple Silicon GPU.

bishnoiyash/SmolLM2-135M-reproduction.description: A single-file PyTorch reimplementation of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M, written from the architecture up and checked against the official Hugging Face weights.

bishnoiyash/Qwen3-0.6B-reproduction.description: A single-file PyTorch reimplementation of Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base, written from a blank file and checked against the official Hugging Face weights.

VijayShinde1996/VRS-Foundation-LLM.description: A ~28M-parameter, Qwen3-style decoder-only language model **trained entirely from scratch on a single 8 GB laptop GPU**, plus its fine-tuned variants. Small, fully open, and designed so you can actually understand and run every piece.

mikahniehaus/Tern.description: A GPT-2 small architecture language model, **trained entirely from random initialization** on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4070 SUPER, 12GB VRAM) — no pretrained weights anywhere in this checkpoint's lineage. This is the fine-tuned checkpoint (base pretraining + SFT), the one meant to actually be talked to.

vous99/mini-diffusion.description: A denoising diffusion model written from scratch in plain PyTorch. The U-Net, the noise schedule, four samplers and the training loop are all in the repository — `diffusers` is never imported.

vous99/mini-llm.description: A decoder-only GPT written from scratch in plain PyTorch. No `transformers`, no `accelerate`, no `fastai` — the model, the tokenizer training and the training loop are all in the repository.

prplguyy/ru-en-transformer.description: A compact **encoder–decoder Transformer trained from scratch** (no pretrained weights) for Russian→English translation. Built as a learning project — the tokenizer, model, training loop, and beam-search decoding are all hand-written.

sur950/tinystories-slm.description: A ~12.4M-parameter decoder-only transformer, **written from scratch** — no `transformers`, no `tokenizers`, no `lightning`. Tokenizer, model, training loop, and sampler are all hand-written PyTorch. Full source, training logs, and design writeup: **[github.com/sur950/tinystories-slm](https://github.com/sur950/tinystories-slm)**.

fillay/LWT-80M.description: An 80M-parameter language model written from scratch in Rust and HIP — no PyTorch, no JAX, no ML framework of any kind. Every matrix multiply goes through hipBLAS; everything else is a hand-written GPU kernel. Trained on a single AMD Strix Halo APU (gfx1151, RDNA 3.5).

sekund0chka/sane-118m.description: A 118.5M-parameter English language model **trained from scratch** — architecture, tokenizer, training code and behaviour data are all original. No existing weights were fine-tuned, distilled or merged.

hasyarshad/roman-urdu-translator.description: The trained weights for an 81M-parameter encoder–decoder transformer written from primitives in PyTorch — no `nn.Transformer`, no `AutoModel`, no training framework.

amanm10000/chessllm.description: A decoder-only transformer trained from scratch on Lichess games written in SAN notation. It has never seen a board: no FEN, no piece list, no legal-move generator. It reads the text of a game and predicts the characters that come next. Everything it does with chess it inferred from move notation alone.

amanm10000/minillm.description: A Llama-3-shaped decoder-only language model trained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu, on a single **RTX 4060 Laptop (8GB)**. No distillation, no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning off someone else's base model — tokenizer, data pipeline, architecture, and training loop are all in the repo.

lattice-research/lattice-quark-1.5b.description: A 1.5B-parameter decoder-only language model **trained from scratch** by [Lattice](https://lattice-site-lime.vercel.app) — no pretrained weights used. Pretrained on consumer hardware (RTX 5090), then instruction-tuned.

dangeA/mpu-30m-base.description: **mpu-30m** is a 30.3M-parameter GPT-style language model trained from scratch on 400M tokens of [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories). It is the first model in the **mpu** series and the proof-of-concept run for an elastic, checkpoint-driven training platform that migrates a single training job across free and disposable GPU sessions (Colab/Kaggle) without losing progress.

BallerKnowledge/koachie-312m.description: Koachie is a 312M-parameter GPT-style language model built entirely from scratch by [Baller Knowledge](https://koachiefitai.co.uk) in Glasgow, Scotland — own tokenizer, own architecture implementation, own training loop. It is not a fine-tune of any existing model and no external model's weights were used at any point.

kmehrad/gpt1-project-gutenberg.description: A 116.5M-parameter decoder-only Transformer created from scratch by **Kamron M** ([Hugging Face: kmehrad](https://huggingface.co/kmehrad), [Kaggle: kammehr](https://www.kaggle.com/kammehr)) at **PyM Studio**.

akshay0689/nlemon-14.description: **nLemon-14-sft** · a 13.8M-parameter decoder-only transformer, pretrained from scratch and instruction-tuned, on one 4 GB laptop GPU. *"Born to speak, disciplined to behave."*

neemon/anlp-a1-c3.description: attention: MHA -> grouped-query (8 query heads, 2 KV groups)

neemon/anlp-a1-c5.description: tokenization: subword -> token-free BLT (raw bytes + patches)

Fallovski/french-serer-transformer-scrat.description: Part of a benchmark of six configurations for French→Serer neural machine translation. Serer is a critically low-resource Niger-Congo language (~1.2M speakers, Senegal/Gambia), phylogenetically close to the well-resourced Wolof.

sanhuo11/BeginVLA-12M.description: BeginVLA-12M is the project-owned model from [Begin with VLA](https://github.com/tlysanhuo/begin-with-vla). Its vision encoder, byte-level language encoder, multimodal fusion stack, and flow-matching action decoder are implemented in the repository and trained end to end from random initialization.

SBDO1/SBD_o1.description: A 355M parameter GPT-2 model, built from scratch in PyTorch following Sebastian Raschka's [Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)](https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch), starting from OpenAI's pretrained GPT-4 medium weights and instruction fine-tuned on the [Stanford Alpaca dataset](https://github.com/tatsu-lab/stanford_alpaca) (52k instruction/response pairs).

Arihant25/anlp-a1-transformer-ablations.description: Encoder-decoder Transformers built **from scratch** in PyTorch (no `nn.Transformer`, no `nn.MultiheadAttention`, no fused SDPA), trained to decrypt binary cipher sequences into English plaintext, with a controlled five-configuration ablation study. The BPE tokenizer is also implemented from scratch, with no tokenizer library.

RDTvlokip/RDTChess.description: <style> /* width et border-collapse sont AUSSI en inline sur chaque table, et ce n'est pas une redondance: la feuille du site cible ses tables avec une specificite superieure a une simple classe, donc une largeur declaree ici seule se fait ecraser et la table se retracte sur son contenu en laissant un vide a droite. L'inline, lui, gagne toujours.

RaiRamones/indomla-1024.description: **IndoMLA-1024** is an experimental Indonesian decoder-only causal language model trained **from scratch** using an **MLA-inspired low-rank key/value attention mechanism**.

yadavkapil7155/nexa-smallgpt.description: A GPT-style autoregressive language model built entirely from scratch in PyTorch - no `AutoModelForCausalLM`, no `GPT2LMHeadModel`, no pretrained Transformer implementation. Every component (causal self-attention, grouped-query attention, transformer decoder blocks, training loop) is hand-written and independently verified.

ayushmaninbox/artificial-stupidity-tiny.description: Six character-level language models **built from scratch** — no GPT-2, no pretrained anything — that are identical in every respect except **how many bits each weight is allowed**. The smallest is **83 KB**.

ayushmaninbox/artificial-stupidity-image.description: A text-to-image latent diffusion model trained **entirely from scratch** on a laptop. No Stable Diffusion, no CLIP, no pretrained weights of any kind.

0Curious0/faster_rcnn_resnet50.description: A from-scratch PyTorch implementation of Faster R-CNN (Ren et al., 2015), aiming to closely — not exactly — reproduce paper-level results on Pascal VOC under real compute constraints.

avi1o1/anlp-a1.description: This repo hosts the model checkpoints for a from-scratch (no `nn.Transformer` / `nn.MultiheadAttention`) sequence-to-sequence Transformer trained to decode a binary-cipher → plaintext mapping derived from the Brown corpus, across a 5-way architectural ablation (**C1–C5**).

euclidstellar/tinystories-1bit-llm.description: An **11,159,360-parameter BitNet b1.58 language model built from scratch** — no `nn.Transformer`, no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning. Trained on a free Kaggle T4.

OliverSundaram/MoE-Study.description: Two decoder-only language models trained **from scratch** under identical conditions, differing in exactly one thing: whether the feed-forward block is a **dense MLP** or a **sparse top-2-of-4 MoE**.

aijadugar/qwen2.5-0.5b-sql-lora.description: This model is `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` fine-tuned on a small slice of `b-mc2/sql-create-context` using a **LoRA adapter implemented from scratch in plain PyTorch** (no `peft` library was used for training -- see the `LoRALinear` class in the training notebook), then merged back into the base weights.

open-source-dimas/modelo-jogo-velha-zero.description: Este é um pequeno modelo causal treinado a partir de pesos aleatórios para responder a pedidos de geração de código web, com foco em um jogo simples da velha. Ele não usa Qwen, Llama, GPT ou qualquer peso pré-treinado. O tokenizer também foi treinado localmente.

00x61/uyum-v3.description: **Türkçe için sıfırdan eğitilmiş bir dil modeli.** Hazır bir model ince ayarlanmadı — tokenizer, mimari, eğitim döngüsü ve değerlendirme seti baştan yazıldı.

YMmim/faster-rcnn-voc-scratch.description: torchvision의 완성된 탐지기(`fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn`)를 쓰지 않고, **Faster R-CNN의 핵심 구성요소를 밑바닥부터 직접 구현**하여 원리를 학습하기 위한 저장소입니다. 학습 + 평가(mAP) + 추론 전체 파이프라인을 포함합니다.

YMmim/object-detection-scratch.description: 객체탐지를 **밑바닥부터 직접 구현**(Faster R-CNN)하고, 이를 실무 표준인 **YOLO와 비교**하며 학습하는 교육용 저장소입니다. 2-stage 탐지기의 내부 원리를 손으로 구현해보고, 1-stage 탐지기(YOLO)와 결과·철학을 대조합니다.

Arsen4ikVar/tlab-looped-transformer.description: Weight-tied looped transformer: one 3-layer Qwen3-style block applied `r` times, 448-dim, **9,064,608 parameters**, trained from scratch on FineWeb next-token prediction. T-Lab test task submission. Run `full_control90_kaggle`, 90.0M tokens, step 43944.

AuthRan/AshuGPT-124M-base.description: The **base** checkpoint of [AshuGPT](https://github.com/AuthRan/AuthLLM) — a decoder-only transformer written from scratch in PyTorch, with no `transformers`, no `AutoModel`, and no `Trainer`.

rasa04/tinylm-1m.description: Языковая модель на **1.22M параметров** (1.09M без эмбеддингов), обученная с нуля на одной RTX 5090. Младшая сестра [TinyLM-11M](https://huggingface.co/rasa04/tinylm-11m).

adyoi/indigo.tf.description: Versi **TensorFlow/Keras** dari proyek [Indigo](https://huggingface.co/adyoi/indigo) — model bahasa GPT kecil yang dibangun dari nol (tanpa library `transformers`).

simak31/tinyzero-countdown-19m.description: A ~18.9M-parameter decoder-only transformer, pretrained from scratch and post-trained with GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) to solve Countdown-style arithmetic puzzles: given a set of numbers and a target, find an equation using each number exactly once that reaches the target.

N8Programs/lil-bard-checkpts.description: This repository contains 25 loadable Transformers checkpoints from the pretraining run for [`N8Programs/lil-bard`](https://huggingface.co/N8Programs/lil-bard). The final step-25,485 model is kept in that separate repository so ordinary users do not download the full checkpoint history.

NethranjaliSE/Pali_Sinhala_From_Scratch.description: An encoder–decoder Transformer implemented **from scratch** in PyTorch — no `nn.Transformer`, no pretrained weights — for Pāli → Sinhala translation. Both languages are written in Sinhala script in this corpus, so a single shared subword vocabulary is used and the embeddings are tied across the encoder, decoder and output projection.

ye476/mini-llm-132m.description: A 132M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch — tokenizer, data pipeline, model, and training loop all written by hand, with no `transformers` and no `tiktoken`. Source: [FengYe476/mini-LLM](https://github.com/FengYe476/mini-LLM).

adimunot/transformer-from-scratch.description: Weights for [github.com/adimunot21/transformer-from-scratch](https://github.com/adimunot21/transformer-from-scratch), a decoder-only Transformer built from first principles in PyTorch — attention, multi-head projections, positional encoding, blocks and training loop written by hand, plus a BPE tokenizer also implemented from scratch.

adimunot/diffusion-from-scratch.description: Weights for [github.com/adimunot21/diffusion-from-scratch](https://github.com/adimunot21/diffusion-from-scratch), a DDPM/DDIM implementation written from scratch in PyTorch — forward process, noise schedules, U-Net denoiser, samplers and classifier-free guidance, no diffusers dependency.

mohjkhan/anlp-a1-transformers.description: Custom encoder–decoder Transformer built from fundamental PyTorch ops (no `nn.Transformer` / `nn.MultiheadAttention`) for a repeating-XOR cipher → plaintext decryption task, plus an ablation over five configurations:

Viv0605101/anlp-a1-transformer-blt-ablat.description: Encoder–decoder Transformers built from scratch in PyTorch (no `nn.Transformer`, no `nn.MultiheadAttention`) for the task of mapping **encrypted binary sequences to plaintext**, plus a controlled five-way architectural ablation.

samvaran/2025801013_anlp_assignment1.description: Encoder–decoder transformers built from fundamental PyTorch operations (no `nn.Transformer`, no `nn.MultiheadAttention`) for ANLP Assignment 1.
