maddiedreese/swedish-chef.description: A tiny decoder-only conversational language model trained entirely from scratch on an original mock-Swedish-chef-style corpus. It responds to short English prompts with playful, semi-comprehensible mock-Swedish speech and always ends with `Børk børk børk`.

neemon/anlp-a1-c5_fixed.description: C5 variant: token-free BLT with fixed-width patches instead of entropy

mdhvm/anlp-m26-a1-cipher-transformers.description: Checkpoints for **Advanced NLP Assignment 1** — An encoder–decoder Transformer, written from elementary PyTorch operations, is trained to recover plaintext from a repeating-key XOR cipher. Five configurations differ from the base model in exactly one component each — rotary positions, grouped-query attention, RMSNorm, and a token-free Byte Latent Transformer with entropy-based dynamic patching — and are compared at an identical step budget over three seeds.

RaunakSeksaria/anlp-a1-transformers.description: Five encoder-decoder transformers trained from scratch to map an XOR-encrypted binary sequence to English plaintext. Each configuration differs from the base by exactly one architectural component.

JBalwaySUS/anlp-a1-transformer-ablation.description: Encoder–decoder Transformers built from basic PyTorch operations (no `nn.Transformer` or `nn.MultiheadAttention`), trained to map encrypted binary sequences to plaintext. C2–C5 each change exactly one component from the C1 base.

sahoosk/anlp-a1-transformer-blt-ablation.description: Five architectural configurations of an encoder–decoder Transformer built from scratch (no `nn.Transformer` / `nn.MultiheadAttention`), evaluated on a character-level decipherment task. Each of C2–C5 changes exactly one component from the C1 base so the effect of each change can be measured in isolation.

skimo2022/anlp-a1-transformers.description: Encoder–decoder Transformers built from scratch in PyTorch (no `nn.Transformer`, no `nn.MultiheadAttention`) for the task of mapping **encrypted binary sequences to plaintext**, plus a controlled five-way architectural ablation.

VenyaVel/anlp-a1-transformers-blt.description: Custom Encoder-Decoder Transformer checkpoints for a controlled 5-config architectural ablation study, trained from scratch (no `nn.Transformer` / `nn.MultiheadAttention`) on an encrypted-binary-to-plaintext sequence-to-sequence task. Task: IIIT-H Advanced NLP, Assignment 1.

aadith-warrier/anlp-a1-cipher-transforme.description: Encoder-decoder Transformers built from scratch (no `nn.Transformer` or `nn.MultiheadAttention`) that decrypt a position-periodic substitution cipher back to English. Five configurations differing from the C1 base by exactly one component each.

mgbao/envi-nmt-scratch-transformer.description: Đồ án môn học. **Toàn bộ kiến trúc do nhóm tự cài bằng PyTorch thuần** — không dùng `nn.Transformer`, `nn.MultiheadAttention`, `F.scaled_dot_product_attention`, `nn.LayerNorm` hay `nn.RMSNorm`.

Aleksander22/Koliber-v1.0-Base-copy.description: **Koliber v1.0 Base** is a compact Polish decoder-only causal language model developed by **OrisTeam** and trained from scratch.

hardik300/LMA_mini_project.description: Ten checkpoints from five independently pretrained decoder-only Transformers, written from scratch in PyTorch (no `nn.Transformer*`, no HuggingFace model classes, no pre-built attention). Each model is ~25M parameters, trained for one epoch over its own monolingual corpus.

Prateek-Tiwari10/LMA_phase2.description: Decoder-only Transformers trained **from scratch** on Hindi and Nepali, on corpora collected and cleaned for this project. No pretrained weights were used, and the two languages share no data, no vocabulary and no parameters — only the model code and the training recipe.

bardiaegz/gpt2-124m-fineweb.description: GPT-2 124M pretrained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu, then supervised fine-tuned for instruction following. Trained on a single rented RTX 4090 for about $6.

manyajain111/lma-phase2.description: Pretrained decoder-only Transformer language models (~24.2M parameters each) built and trained from scratch in PyTorch without third-party framework abstractions.

mixailplastinin/llm-from-scratch-1b.description: GPT-style decoder-only transformer trained from scratch with custom framework.

Harish241412/llama-3.2-1b-from-scratch.description: A PyTorch implementation of **Llama 3.2 1B built from scratch** for educational and research purposes.

neemon/anlp-a2-part1-dense.description: Decoder-only transformer with dense two-layer MLP feed-forward (the baseline).

neemon/anlp-a2-part2-adamw.description: Decoder-only transformer with AdamW, implemented from scratch.

neemon/anlp-a2-part2-mars.description: Decoder-only transformer with MARS (variance-reduced AdamW variant), implemented from scratch.

neemon/anlp-a2-part1-moe_4e1a.description: Decoder-only transformer with Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward, 4 experts, top-1 routing.

neemon/anlp-a2-part2-lion.description: Decoder-only transformer with Lion (memory-efficient sign momentum), implemented from scratch.

neemon/anlp-a2-part1-moe_4e2a.description: Decoder-only transformer with Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward, 4 experts, top-2 routing.

neemon/anlp-a2-part2-muon.description: Decoder-only transformer with Muon (matrix-based, Newton-Schulz orthogonalised momentum), implemented from scratch.

neemon/anlp-a2-part1-moe_shared.description: Decoder-only transformer with 1 shared expert always active plus 3 routed experts, top-1 routing.

neemon/anlp-a2-part2-sophia.description: Decoder-only transformer with Sophia-G (Hessian-based, clipped diagonal preconditioner), implemented from scratch.

neemon/anlp-a2-part1-moe_active_matched.description: Decoder-only transformer with Mixture-of-Experts, 4 experts, top-2 routing, active parameters matched to the dense baseline.

mxv456/klitzeklein-europarl-translator.description: *klitzeklein* (German): teeny-tiny. Four transformer translators of 23–25M parameters, trained **from scratch** on Europarl on a single RTX 3060, from the research repo **https://github.com/Marvel4U/klitzeklein-europarl-translator** — a systematic small-scale comparison of specialization vs. general pretraining, encoder-decoder vs. decoder-only, language direction and architecture. Read the repo README for the full results, findings and limitations; this card documents the weights.

oli-mebberson/lattice-cadence.description: Cadence is a 26M-parameter decoder-only transformer, trained from scratch on MIDI music. Given a short text prompt (tempo, time signature, instrument), it composes original multi-track MIDI under a grammar-constrained sampler that keeps every generation structurally valid.

javimosch/mtlm-7m-base.description: **MTLM** (machin tiny language model) is an experiment in building an LLM with no ML framework at all: the tokenizer training, the pretraining loop (AdamW, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings), the int8 export and the inference server are all written in [machin](https://github.com/javimosch/machin) (MFL, a machine-first language that compiles to C), and the whole thing was trained on a 6-core CPU shared with other services.

KrynexLabs/KrynexAI-vNS-Overfitting-Mobi.description: **KrynexAI** is a GPT-style language model written **from scratch in pure NumPy**. No PyTorch. No TensorFlow. No datasets. No common sense.

huangyusi/MiniSystemOne.description: **Train a probabilistic decision model from scratch — no LLM, no decoding, no JSON generation.**

Dhevenddra/slm-lab-base-15m.description: A **12,587,904-parameter** decoder-only transformer, trained from scratch on TinyStories on a free Colab T4 — this repo is the pretrained base model.

ianaldenjones/notes-you-cant-delete.description: Small from-scratch symbolic-music transformers from the study **[Notes You Can't Delete](https://notes-you-cant-delete.vercel.app)**: take a musical idea out of *everything* a model is trained on, and it rebuilds the idea anyway.

wangyue114514/small-agent-1b.description: 这是从头训练约 1B 参数、面向基础代码、数学与工具使用能力的研究模型预留仓库。

eakeakxandro/Lucky-Paud-13M-indonesia.description: Model bahasa 13 juta parameter, decoder-only GPT-style, dilatih dari nol (bukan fine-tune) untuk bahasa Indonesia. Dibangun solo sebagai proyek belajar: tokenizer, korpus, dan training loop semuanya ditulis dan dijalankan sendiri di Kaggle (GPU T4, gratis).

umutonuryasar/microclip-checkpoints.description: Every trained checkpoint behind the results in [github.com/umutonuryasar/microclip](https://github.com/umutonuryasar/microclip): a CLIP-style image–text model built from scratch on a single-GPU budget, used to test whether SigLIP's sigmoid loss keeps its small-batch advantage over softmax (InfoNCE) at small scale. At this scale it does not: softmax matched or beat sigmoid at every batch size from 128 to 512.

Compactbot/logo-gan.description: A small **DCGAN** trained **from scratch** to generate 64×64 company-logo-style images. Trained on 1,500 real logos resized to 64×64×3.

Circuits-V2/Meridian-Mini.description: > **Status: training in progress.** Weights will be uploaded when the run finishes. This card describes the plan and will be updated with results.

abidlabs/mnist-from-scratch-1min.description: A small CNN trained from **random initialization** (no pretrained weights) on [`ylecun/mnist`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ylecun/mnist) for **~1 minute of GPU time**.

AkkiMaharaj/slm-30m-base.description: A 30M-parameter decoder-only GPT model, built and pretrained entirely from scratch as a personal learning project to understand how language models work under the hood — not intended for production use.

FrameXlabs/fragment-2.description: A **36.3M-parameter System-One decision model**, built by FrameXlabs on the original fragment build and trained **entirely from scratch** — own BPE tokenizer, own encoder, own RLCD loop. No pretrained weights, no fine-tune of Laya or any other model.

ParallaxOpen/ParallaxOpen.description: A collection of small language models trained from scratch on consumer hardware.

asikrshoudo/demo-ai.description: A tiny GPT-style language model, built completely from scratch — no pretrained weights, and no external AI API involved anywhere in the model itself. This is a personal project to understand how a language model actually works under the hood: tokenization, attention, backpropagation, training loops, checkpointing, all of it implemented and trained from zero.

yoshio-aono/a-gpt.description: **A-GPTプロジェクト**は、LLM の仕組みを、最小のモデル(モデル1。重み1,361個)から 約10億パラメータ(モデル10。約10億7千万個)まで、AI と一緒に、自分の手で順番に作って確かめる、学習用のプロジェクトです。 Transformer の計算・BPE のトークナイザー・学習の仕組みは、既製のモデルを使わず一から作成しています (学習は、モデル9までは Mac の GPU(MLX)、モデル10はクラウドの GPU(NVIDIA B200、PyTorch))。

dharandhamo/Forge-20M.description: A 20.75M parameter, GPT-2-style decoder-only transformer, architected and trained completely from scratch — no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning of an existing model. Trained end-to-end on a single NVIDIA T4 GPU (Kaggle, free tier).

balaji9043/zeromem-pointer.description: About 34M parameters, trained from scratch on a laptop. Reads a question plus a chunk whose sentences are tagged [A] [B] [C] ... and answers `<KNOW>[C]` or `<REFUSE>`, so it never retypes (or invents) text. `best.pt` is a PyTorch checkpoint for the ZeroMem code (not a transformers model); `tokenizer.json` is its byte-level BPE tokenizer.

Bayernator/horst-ai.description: HORST ist ein Encoder-Decoder-Transformer (**209 Mio. Es gibt kein Fine-Tuning und keine vortrainierten Gewichte oder Tokenizer anderer Modelle.

Demonstrates that content-addressable memory removes the retrieval bottleneck but not the working-memory bottleneck, and that format resolution determines measured capability.

nandutt/mini-llm-tinystories.description: A 12.2M-parameter Llama-style language model trained **from scratch** on TinyStories, following the Stanford CS229 lecture *Building Large Language Models*: BPE tokenizer → pretraining → scaling laws → SFT → DPO → evaluation, all in plain PyTorch. It writes simple children's stories; it is an educational model, not a general assistant.

yadelew/amharic-skipgram-from-scratch.description: A lightweight, pure-Python implementation of a Skip-gram word embedding model trained on a small Amharic corpus. Built entirely from first principles without external numerical or machine learning libraries (no NumPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).

Bytephilosopher/amharic-skipgram-embeddi.description: A Skip-Gram word embedding model trained from first principles on an Amharic corpus without neural network libraries, autograd, or NumPy.

nazib61/coreflow-1.9m.description: A 1.9 MB int8 language model that decodes **3,400+ tokens/second on a single CPU core** — trained from scratch in pure PyTorch, served by a dependency-free C11 runtime. No Hugging Face wrappers, no llama.cpp, no GPU.

thefinalboss/fractus-cte-atom.description: A fork of the Hugging Face Fractus Continuous Thought Engine. The only change to the brain is the tokenizer: GPT-2 BPE is gone, the Atomizer is the id stream. This is a new model, trained from zero. It is not a resume of the x8 run.

Frankenstein-Labs/Cortex-0.description: > **FR** — **Cortex-0** : IA multimodale (texte · image · audio · vidéo) construite > **entièrement from scratch**, sans **aucun** modèle pré-entraîné ni API externe. > **EN** — **Cortex-0**: multimodal AI (text · image · audio · video) built > **entirely from scratch**, with **no** pretrained model and **no** external API.

Samuka007/reclor-qa-from-scratch-10m.description: Course project (CITS4012 A2). Transformer-encoder model trained **from scratch** (random init, BPE tokenizer trained on the train split only) for 4-way multiple-choice logical reasoning on ReClor.

57Ajay/tinystories-gpt-51m.description: A small GPT-2-style language model (51.2M parameters) trained **from scratch** on [TinyStories](https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories). Give it the start of a story and it continues it in the simple, child-friendly style of the dataset.

singhpratech/emc2-lesson-02-attention.description: Read the attention maps of Tiny Storyteller (Lesson 01, 5.85M parameters, 6 blocks x 4 heads). No training: the notebook loads the public weights, plots heatmaps, and measures all 24 heads over the 200 held-out quiz stories.

singhpratech/emc2-lesson-03-four-sizes.description: Four GPT-style models (0.95M, 3.06M, 5.85M and 12.3M parameters) trained from random weights with the same recipe, data, tokenizer and 1,500 steps as Lesson 01 (Tiny Storyteller), to see where verbatim recitation of training stories begins.

singhpratech/emc2-lesson-07-decider.description: A 0.83M-parameter GPT (the Lesson 01 class, smaller) trained from scratch to pick which pankhllm catalog operation answers a question: the next token after `<sep>` is the decision. Trained on 15,205 template questions from pankhllm's generator (fictional pharma products), tested on 2,000 questions from held-out templates.

mxv456/spatial-wave-search-512m-hero.description: *Figure. A free-running search by this network on a synthetic house maze (512 m window, 2 m cells). Each frame is one pass: the orange cells are the network's whole output, fed back verbatim as its next input. The state token it emits (SEARCH → BACK → DRAW → DONE) chooses the next pass; nothing outside the network decides anything between passes. Route of 431 m walking, 26 passes. The network was trained only on Amsterdam map layers.*

mxv456/spatial-wave-search-256m.description: *Figure. A free-running search by this network on a district it never saw (Zuid + Centrum, Amsterdam; 256 m window, 2 m cells): start and goal lie on opposite sides of one building, the route is 295 m, 2.4 × the straight line. Each frame is one pass; the orange cells are the network's whole output, fed back as its next input; its own state token (SEARCH → BACK → DRAW → DONE) picks the next pass.*

XXVICK/Myst-Super-Coder-75M.description: A 75M-parameter multi-language instruction-tuned decoder-only transformer trained from scratch.

vishal24p/30k.description: A small next-token language model built in PyTorch, with one causal self-attention head and a tokenizer I trained separately. This is a text-continuation experiment, not a chat model.

devilart1980/NOVA8-53M.description: > **Runs only with the NOVA-EVO program.** NOVA is not a transformer and does not load in `transformers`, > llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio. The program, the whole experiment and every measurement are on GitHub: > **https://github.com/roppikevo/AI-NOVA-EVO** — how to run it is below, under "Running it".

adarsh-007/chess-gpt-board.description: Transformers trained **from scratch** in PyTorch on **3.0M human games from Lichess** to predict the move a human would play. They are never told the rules of chess and do **no search**: one forward pass gives a probability for each of the 1,968 possible moves.

korokoboom/billm-474m-fc.description: A 474M parameter language model fine-tuned to produce structured function calls from user queries and tool schemas. The base model was pretrained from scratch on a Qwen3-0.6B style architecture, then fine-tuned over three iterations. This repository contains three checkpoints, the tokenizer, the model definition, and the training and evaluation results.

saroj479/tenslam-minilm-60m.description: This page describes the project; model files are not hosted here. See the [GitHub source repository](https://github.com/sbartaula/Minillm-pretrain) for code and instructions. The source code is MIT-licensed; that licence does not apply to the datasets or trained weights.

sumitkClasses/nanochat-d20-chat.description: Every stage was trained from random initialization with [karpathy/nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) (commit `92d63d4`): **no pretrained weights or tokenizer were used**. Training run, scripts, logs and serving code: [github.com/rsumit123/private-llm](https://github.com/rsumit123/private-llm). Try it in the [Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/sumitkClasses/scratchq-110).

mildlysty/the-broker-v1.description: A crypto-native language model, pretrained from scratch on data crawled and consensus-verified by the SynthSynd swarm.

MrCookieJos/prism-brain.description: PRISM is a small language model built and trained from scratch: its own tokenizer, its own architecture code, and no weights borrowed from any other model.

kamel-sa/ar-en-transformer.description: This is a Transformer base model (60.5M parameters) **trained from zero**, with no pretrained weights. One model translates in both directions between Arabic and English, and it also understands **Levantine dialect** (Syrian, Lebanese, Palestinian).

devilloots/cat-dcgan-oxford.description: Trained from scratch on Oxford-IIIT Pet (cats only, 200 images, 128x128).

devilloots/cat-vs-dog-classifier.description: Simple CNN trained from scratch on 100 cat + 100 dog images. Input size: 128x128.

kadirnar/arabic-stt-runs.description: Training runs of small (about 5-30M parameters) Arabic and Arabic + English speech recognition models, trained **from scratch** on a small amount of labeled audio. Every technique is tried as a one-change ablation against a frozen current best. These are research artifacts, not a product.

vishal24p/single-head-residual-50k.description: A small next-token language model built in PyTorch, with one causal self-attention head and a permanent residual connection. This is a text-continuation experiment, not a chat model.

NoeFlandre/GPT2-From-Scratch.license_body_excerpt: ODC-By 1.0 applies to the model weights in `model.safetensors`. NoeFlandre/GPT2-From-Scratch.description: A GPT-2-style transformer implemented in PyTorch. `model.safetensors` contains float32 weights from training step 19,072.

muaibinrah/ppo-LunarLander-v2-from-scrat.description: This is a from-scratch PyTorch implementation of PPO (HF Deep RL Course Unit8 Part1), trained on LunarLander-v3 (Kaggle gymnasium removed v2; checker tags kept as LunarLander-v2 to match the exact env-id string the course checker expects).

Arko007/Zenyx-100M-Base.description: A **151M-parameter** dense decoder-only language model trained from scratch on web, code and math text (the "100M" in the name is the original plan; the trained model is 151M).

delvek/researcherbot-1.description: por Delvek de Sousa — Engenheiro de IA, Pesquisador & CTO

Murzik344/CLOD-149M.description: A 148.9M-parameter decoder-only language model trained **from scratch on a single RTX 5050 8 GB Laptop GPU** in 8 days. 20B tokens: ~18.2B of ClimbMix-400B (single epoch, no repeats) followed by a ~10% terminal annealing phase of procedurally generated arithmetic word problems (55%) mixed with held-out ClimbMix text (45%), scheduled to coincide with LR warmdown.

88Jerry/mimolite-sft-v8.description: **从零预训练、106M 参数、无蒸馏**的代码生成大语言模型（数据工程主线）。全部实验在单张 **RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB** 上完成。本模型页发布 GGUF 权重（FP16 + Q4_K_M）。

robloxianer/babble.description: A family of 5 tiny character-level GPTs trained from scratch on the same data (FineWeb-Edu + everyday conversations). They ramble. That's the point.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-360m-a75m-v4.1-mo.description: **[Try it in your browser](https://huggingface.co/spaces/nkthebass/tinybrainbot-360m-moe-chat)**: the Q8_0 GGUF runs locally on your device with WebGPU, and nothing you type is sent anywhere.

jfrick/simple-llm-124M-10.879B.description: Public inference release of the latest completed **124,389,632-parameter** Simple LLM checkpoint, trained on **10,878,562,619 next-token targets**. This is a base language model, not an instruction-tuned assistant. Generations can be inaccurate, incorrect as code, and severely repetitive, especially with greedy/low-temperature decoding. The new multilingual continuation is not included in this release.

nkthebass/tinybrainbot-3m-base.description: A **2.94M-parameter** language model trained from scratch on **5.2B tokens**. It is a plain Llama architecture (`LlamaForCausalLM`), so no custom code is needed.

edumoraes/devaneio.description: GPT pequeno (6,8M parâmetros) treinado do zero em português com o [MiniGPT](https://github.com/edumoraes/minigpt), uma implementação de GPT feita pra estudo. Escreve com a gramática e o vocabulário do português, mas não guarda fatos: o texto sai fluente e sem compromisso com a verdade.

AAJ007/kiyotaka-ayanokoji-56m.description: A **10-layer, 640-wide decoder-only transformer trained from random initialisation** on a single 6 GB RTX 4050 laptop GPU. No pretrained weights, no fine-tuning of an existing model: the architecture, BPE tokenizer, pretraining corpus and SFT data were built for this project.

Phips/4xmssim_hma_pretrains.description: Since no official [HMA](https://github.com/korouuuuu/HMA) model releases exist yet, I am releasing my [hma](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/blob/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3/neosr/archs/hma_arch.py#L1148) and [hma_medium](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/blob/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3/neosr/archs/hma_arch.py#L1386) mssim pretrains. These can be used to speed up and stabilize early training stages when training new hma models. Trained with mssim on [nomosv2](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/tree/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3?tab=readme-ov-file#-datasets).

Phips/4xDRCT-mssim-pretrains.description: Since no [DRCT](https://github.com/ming053l/DRCT/tree/main) model releases exist yet, I am releasing my drct-s, drct and drct-l pretrains. These can be used to speed up and stabilize early training stages when training new drct models. Trained with mssim (and augs, and color and lumaloss) on downscaled [nomosuni](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/tree/0ecbeb98dcefd97801da0ea39ca2cd03a87fce21?tab=readme-ov-file#datasets). Training files are also provided additionally.

Phips/4xSPAN_pretrains.description: [Neosr](https://github.com/muslll/neosr)'s latest update from yesterday included a [new adaptation of the multi-scale ssim loss](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/wiki/Losses#mssim_opt). This was an experiment to test out the difference between making a SPAN pretrain with pixel loss with L1 criteria (as often used in research) vs mssim loss as its only loss. Models are provided so they can be used for tests or also used as a pretrain for another SPAN model.

Finisha-F-scratch/Charlotte-1.0.description: Bienvenue dans la documentation du modèle **Charlotte-1**, un Small Language Model (SLM) entraîné *from scratch* par Clemylia, utilisant l'architecture Aricate (GRU + Attention).

FiShota/hinomoto-100m-v15-wsd-zloss-ema.description: 100M parameter Japanese language model trained from scratch with WSD + z-loss schedule and EMA decay=0.999.

FiShota/hinomoto-100m-v12-wsd-zloss-seed.description: Sister model of v15. Same architecture/training as v15 but seed=2.
